article.articleHeadline: 专家提示做好流感防护！流感季出现新特点 这些防护要点请收好
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts urge proper flu protection! The flu season has new characteristics—keep these protective precautions in mind.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-23, influenza activity in China has entered a rising phase with three strains co-circulating: Influenza A(H1N1), A(H3N2), and influenza B. Among positive samples, A(H1N1) and A(H3N2) together account for 65.4%, influenza B 34.6%, marking a shift from the usual single-dominant-strain pattern. The season is starting earlier, with southern provinces showing rising positivity from late September and northern regions from late October. Cross-protection between strains is weak, increasing the risk of sequential infections and potentially prolonging the season. High-risk groups—older adults (65+), children ≤5, pregnant/perinatal women, immunocompromised individuals, those with chronic diseases, and obesity—should be vaccinated early and maintain protective measures. In older adults, fever may be absent; fatigue, poor appetite, confusion, or worsening chronic conditions warrant prompt evaluation, and pneumonia signs are more common with nasal congestion also prevalent.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家がインフルエンザ対策を呼びかけ！インフルエンザシーズンに新たな特徴—これらの予防ポイントを押さえて
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの複数株同時流行という通常とは異なる特徴が見られるが、既知の病原体による季節性流行であり重大な公衆衛生上の緊急事態とは言えないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの3株共存流行（A(H1N1)、A(H3N2)、B型）で、通常の単一優勢株パターンと異なる点が特徴。重症度や死亡者数などの具体的なデータは記事に記載なし。既知の季節性病原体であり、新規病原体や渡航制限等には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO vädjar om fred i eboladrabbade Kongo-Kinshasa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO appeals for peace in Ebola-stricken Kongo-Kinshasa.
article.articleSummary: Violence in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has intensified since late October, hampering Ebola response efforts in Ituri, near the area where the outbreak began. Hard fighting near a hospital in Ituri forced health workers to shelter inside a maternity ward for more than a day. The World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus appealed for peace, saying 'The best medicine is peace.' The Ebola outbreak, which began in May, is the worst in the DRC’s history, with over 11,000 confirmed cases and almost 5,700 deaths. Ongoing conflict-endangering vaccination, case isolation, and treatment activities risks continued transmission in eastern provinces and complicates international and local public health responses.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ流行下のコンゴ（キンシャサ）で和平を訴える
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪規模（11,000例超、死者約5,700人）のエボラ流行が紛争により対応困難となっており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の複数該当、国際的関心の高さからフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 紛争により予防接種・症例隔離・治療活動が妨げられ、感染拡大継続リスクが高い。WHO事務局長が直接和平を訴えるなど国際的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO vädjar om fred i eboladrabbade Kongo-Kinshasa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO appeals for peace in Ebola-affected Congo-Kinshasa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is the worst in the country’s history, with over 11,000 confirmed cases and almost 5,700 deaths. Violence in the eastern DRC has escalated since late October, hampering the Ebola response. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus states that hard fighting has continued near a hospital in Ituri, an area close to where Ebola first broke out. Health workers have had to shelter inside a maternity ward for more than a day. He concludes with, 'The best medicine is peace.' The outbreak began in May and ongoing violence complicates containment and response efforts in the affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラに見舞われたコンゴ・キンシャサでの平和を訴える
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で史上最悪規模のエボラ出血熱流行（11,000例超、死者5,700人近く）が継続中であり、武力紛争により対応が妨げられているため、国際的拡大・公衆衛生への深刻な影響の懸念がありフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部（イツリ州）でのエボラ流行と治安悪化による対応への支障を報じている。致死率が高く（約52%）、史上最悪規模とされる点が重大。

article.articleHeadline: 三医话健康：气温骤降，中小学生如何防流感
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three Doctors Talk Health: As temperatures drop sharply, how can primary and secondary school students prevent the flu?
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-23, influenza is in a high-incidence phase in Qingdao as temperatures fluctuate. Primary and secondary school students are a key at-risk group due to crowding and developing immunity. Qingdao Municipal Third People's Hospital cautions that influenza differs from the common cold: flu presents with abrupt onset, high fever, widespread body aches, fatigue, and sometimes gastrointestinal symptoms, and can lead to pneumonia or bronchitis in children, requiring timely treatment. Winter classrooms promote spread because of cold, dry air, reduced ventilation, and close contact. Preventive measures for students include strict hand hygiene, covering coughs and sneezes, regular ventilation of homes and classrooms, and wearing masks in crowded or enclosed settings. Vaccination against influenza is the most effective preventive tool and should be offered to eligible students. Also, maintain regular routines, avoid sharing personal items, and stay home when feverish; seek medical care early for persistent fever, malaise, or muscle pain.

triage.headline_ja: 三医話健康:気温急降下、小中学生はどうインフルエンザを予防すべきか
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに関する一般的な予防啓発記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの予防啓発記事であり、特定の異常な流行や重症化事例の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief calls for peace amid heavy fighting in Ebola-hit DR Congo region
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains centered in Ituri and North Kivu. As of November 17, 2026, WHO data show 11,613 cases and 5,678 deaths. Heavy fighting near a hospital in Ituri disrupted the Ebola response, forcing medical staff and aid partners to shelter in a maternity ward for more than 24 hours; WHO is organizing a safe exit and protection for facilities, staff and patients. The virus transmits via contact with bodily fluids, and high-level transmission persists despite some local declines. Ongoing clashes involving armed groups, including ISIL-affiliated factions and the Rwanda-backed M23, hinder transport and access to remote areas, hampering containment. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged peace, calling it “the best medicine.”

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、エボラ流行地のコンゴ民主共和国で激しい戦闘が続く中、和平を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は11,613症例・5,678死亡と深刻かつ継続中であり、武力紛争により対応が妨げられ国際的な懸念とWHOの直接関与がみられるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ルワンダは発生地域として記載されているが、記事中ではM23（ルワンダ支援を受ける武装勢力）による紛争の文脈のみで、ルワンダ国内でのエボラ発生は言及されていないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: หมอมนูญ" เตือน ไข้หวัดใหญ่สายพันธุ์ A ระบาด พบผู้ป่วย 66 ปี คลื่นไส้พะอืดพะอมร่วมด้วย แนะรีบฉีดวัคซีน - สยามรัฐ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dr. Manoon warns that influenza A is spreading; a 66-year-old patient has nausea and vomiting; urges prompt vaccination - Siam Rat
article.articleSummary: 66-year-old female at Vichaiyut Hospital tested positive for influenza A by nasal swab after two days of fever (38.7°C) with body aches, mild cough, runny nose, and nausea/vomiting. She has hyperlipidemia and does not consume alcohol or smoke. Oxygen saturation was 99% on room air and lungs were clear. Diagnosis: influenza A infection. Treated with baloxavir marboxil (Xofluza) 40 mg as a single-dose antiviral. The report, released by Dr. Manoon Leechawongwong, underscores that influenza A is spreading this season and urges prompt vaccination to prevent illness, particularly in older adults. The patient had not received this year’s influenza vaccine. This case highlights ongoing transmission and the public health emphasis on vaccination as a preventive measure.

triage.headline_ja: マヌーン医師が警告、A型インフルエンザが流行中。66歳患者に吐き気・嘔吐の症状も、早期ワクチン接種を推奨
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの単発症例報告であり、異常性・国際的拡大リスク・公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA型の通常の流行シーズンにおける単発症例報告。患者は軽症で回復傾向、抗ウイルス薬治療済み。ワクチン接種呼びかけが主旨の記事。

article.articleHeadline: 'หมอยง' ห่วง 'โรคคอตีบ' ระบาดหนัก แนะฉีดวัคซีน กระตุ้นทุก 10 ปี
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'Dr. Yong' concerned about a severe diphtheria outbreak; recommends vaccination and booster shots every 10 years.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 November 2026, Thailand faces a diphtheria outbreak along the southern border. Diphtheria causes throat infection with white patches, potential airway obstruction requiring tracheostomy, and cervical lymphadenopathy (bull neck); myocarditis and neuropathy are feared complications, with historical mortality around 50%. The diphtheria toxoid vaccine prevents toxin-mediated disease but not infection; high vaccine coverage is essential for herd immunity. Optimal herd immunity is cited at ≥85%, with coverage ideally above 90%. Immunity wanes over time, hence boosters every 10 years. Two waning-immunity groups are identified: those never vaccinated and those vaccinated but not boosted; many older adults may have natural immunity from past exposure. Studies suggest individuals vaccinated in childhood should receive boosters in adulthood, particularly ages 20–50, to curb ongoing transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 『ヨン医師』がジフテリアの大流行を懸念、10年ごとのワクチン接種・追加接種を推奨
triage.triage_reason: タイ南部国境地域でのジフテリア流行が報じられているが、具体的な症例数・死亡者数などの定量的情報がなく、流行の規模や深刻度が不明なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は専門家による一般的な疾病解説・ワクチン接種推奨が中心で、具体的な症例数や地理的拡大状況など疫学データが欠如している。続報で症例数・地域拡大の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: "Cel mai bun medicament este pacea" / Șeful OMS cere pace după lupte violente în regiunea din RD Congo afectată de Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "The best medicine is peace" / The WHO chief calls for peace after violent clashes in the Ebola-affected region of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues with high transmission in the eastern provinces of Ituri and North Kivu. As of 17 November 2026, the outbreak has recorded 11,613 cases and 5,678 deaths, the largest and deadliest in the country’s history. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged peace after violent clashes near a hospital in Ituri disrupted the response; medical staff and humanitarian partners sheltered for more than 24 hours in the maternity ward, with evacuation plans and protective measures for staff, patients, and facilities under preparation. The virus spreads through contact with bodily fluids. Ongoing fighting between government forces and the M23 rebels, allegedly supported by Rwanda, has hindered transport and delivery of medical resources to remote areas, hindering outbreak control. No details on imported or exported cases were provided.

triage.headline_ja: 「最良の薬は平和」WHO事務局長、エボラ被害を受けるコンゴ民主共和国の地域での激しい戦闘後に平和を訴える
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大・最悪のエボラ流行（11,613症例、5,678死亡）が継続中で、紛争により対応が妨げられており、国際的拡大・人道危機のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: ルワンダは紛争関与国（M23支援疑惑）として言及されているのみで、感染発生地域ではないため verified_locations から除外した。紛争によりアクセス制限・対応遅延が続いており、既存の重大流行がさらに悪化する懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19: detectaron una nueva variante en Argentina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19: a new variant detected in Argentina.
article.articleSummary: PJ.2.1, a COVID-19 variant derived from Omicron lineage JN.1, was added to the WHO Variants Under Monitoring category due to rising detections worldwide, notably in North America, with cases in Brazil. It carries 25 mutations versus its predecessor and shows increased ACE2 binding in laboratory tests, raising potential transmissibility, though epidemiological data are insufficient to confirm this. In a Nov 19 assessment, WHO deemed the global health risk of PJ.2.1 as low, with limited confidence because clinical data comparing severity, hospitalizations, or deaths are not yet available. Vaccines updated for other variants (LP.8.1 and XFG) neutralized PJ.2.1 in vitro, but protection levels remain unclear. No distinctive clinical symptoms separate PJ.2.1 from other COVID-19 variants; guidance emphasizes up-to-date vaccination, ventilation, hand hygiene, and protection of vulnerable groups.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19: アルゼンチンで新たな変異株を検出
triage.triage_reason: WHOはPJ.2.1変異株の世界的リスクを低いと評価しており、重症度や伝播性増加を裏付ける疫学データも不足している。ルーチンの変異株監視報告であり、緊急のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事見出しはアルゼンチンでの変異株検出を伝えるが、本文はPJ.2.1変異株に関するWHOの世界的評価が主題で、北米での検出が中心。ブラジルでの症例は一例として軽く言及されているのみで記事の主題ではないため、ブラジルも含め対象国はverified_locationsに含めなかった。アルゼンチンは対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Competitive Landscape of the Coxsackievirus Infections Treatment Market Examined Among Top Global Companies
article.articleSummary: Coxsackievirus Infections Treatment Market is forecast to reach $4.51 billion by 2030, up from $3.1 billion in 2025 and $3.35 billion in 2026 (CAGR 7.8–8.0%). Growth is driven by rising hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) incidence, the absence of specific antivirals, pediatric vulnerability, hospital-based care models, and seasonal infection patterns. Treatments remain primarily supportive—rest, hydration, fever and pain relief—with more serious cases potentially requiring management of complications such as viral meningitis or myocarditis. HFMD, mainly caused by Coxsackievirus A16 and Enterovirus 71, is a key market driver. North America led the market in 2025, while Asia-Pacific is expected to register the fastest growth. The Indonesian HFMD outbreak in early 2024 (about 6,500 cases in Q1) illustrates high prevalence driving demand for symptom-relief and preventive care. Diagnostic advances and expanded pediatric care underpin the outlook.

triage.headline_ja: コクサッキーウイルス感染症治療市場の競争環境、世界大手企業間で分析
triage.triage_reason: 市場調査レポートであり、具体的な公衆衛生イベントの報告ではない。2024年初頭のインドネシアHFMD流行への言及は過去の事例紹介に過ぎず、現在の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は市場分析・ビジネスレポートであり、感染症の発生状況を報告するものではない。インドネシアの2024年HFMD流行（約6,500例/Q1）は市場成長要因としての過去事例引用であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイク情報ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 死亡率近50%、无疫苗可用：刚果埃博拉疫情现状
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Case fatality rate nearly 50%, no vaccine available: the current status of the Ebola outbreak in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is experiencing an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus, with more than 5,000 deaths and a case fatality rate near 50%. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC and is the most severe to date, spreading faster than the 2013–2016 West Africa epidemic, which had about 28,600 cases and 11,300 deaths ( CFR ~40%). There is currently no validated vaccine or therapy for Bundibugyo Ebola. Conflict-affected eastern Congo faces attacks on clinics and burial teams, and aid funding has been reduced compared with a decade ago, hindering response. The UN warns the outbreak could outpace containment, with ending possibly taking up to 12 months even with funding. Western Africa’s experience shows local religious leaders—priests and imams—can help shift burial practices and build trust, a critical element for Congo’s outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: 死亡率近50%、ワクチンなし：コンゴのエボラ流行の現状
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、致死率約50%・死者5000人超の大規模流行であり、緊急のフルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ東部でのエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）流行を主題としている。発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、サマリー中に言及がないため除外。史上最悪規模（5000人超死亡、CFR約50%）で、紛争下での対応困難、ワクチン・治療法未確立、国連も封じ込めの遅れを警告しており、UN・国際支援の必要性が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Tamil Nadu's dengue decline has an El Niño link
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Tamil Nadu, India, shows a decline linked to El Niño and a prolonged dry spell, with fresh cases about 250–300 per day in November 2026, down from 700–1,000 during the monsoon; cumulative cases exceed 30,000 as of November 22, 2026. Chennai, Tiruvallur, Kancheepuram and Chengalpattu reported higher incidence. Absence of rainfall reduced Aedes breeding, contributing to the drop, while sporadic rains have arrested breeding and the northeast monsoon remains active in parts of the state. Health authorities have intensified surveillance and vector-control measures, sustaining field inspections, identifying stagnant-water pockets, and eliminating breeding sites. Two years ago, dengue cases were over 45,000; the article provides no laboratory confirmation details or information on imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州のデング熱減少にエルニーニョとの関連
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例は減少傾向にあり、既知の季節性・気候要因による通常の流行パターンであるため、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱症例の減少とその気候要因（エルニーニョによる乾燥）を報じるもので、公衆衛生上の新たな脅威や異常事態ではない。地元保健当局による通常の媒介蚊対策・サーベイランスが継続されている状況。

article.articleHeadline: பெரும்புதூர் அருகே டெங்கு காய்ச்சலுக்கு பெண் உயிரிழப்பு; ஒரே தெருவில் 9 பேர் பாதிப்பு - Dinakaran - Dinakaran
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death of a woman due to dengue fever near Perumpudur; 9 people affected on the same street - Dinakaran - Dinakaran.
article.articleSummary: Death of a 33-year-old woman from dengue fever near Perumpudur in Koozhangalcheri village, Vaippoor panchayat, Kanchipuram district, Tamil Nadu. Saritha had fever for over three days and died after admission to a private hospital; laboratory tests confirmed dengue. On the same street, Muthalamman Street, nine people have dengue, including Nagalingam (55), Kasturi (60), Kalavathy (55), Jeenath (32), Renuga (50), Tamilselvan (25), and Dayana (40), who are receiving treatment at private hospitals in Tambaram, Potheri, and nearby areas. Residents report fear and panic as multiple cases appear in a single locality, and district health authorities have not yet conducted medical camps or implemented preventive measures in the area, according to villagers. This cluster is localized to one street, with no broader district-level interventions described as of 23 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ペルンプドゥール近郊でデング熱により女性が死亡；同じ通りで9人が感染 - Dinakaran
triage.triage_reason: 単一地区での局地的クラスター発生で死亡例もあるが、国際的拡大や渡航制限の懸念はなく、地域的な散発事例として継続注視が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドの多くの地域で流行しており、本事例はカンチープラム県の一地区（1本の通り）に限局したクラスターである。地元住民の不安はあるが、行政による対策（医療キャンプ等）は未実施と報告されており、地域保健当局の対応状況を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Đà Nẵng 1 tuần hơn 2.200 ca mắc sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Da Nang: More than 2,200 dengue cases in one week.
article.articleSummary: Da Nang reports 2,219 dengue fever cases in the week of 16–22 November (week 47), up 15% from the previous week, with year-to-date total exceeding 12,500 cases, about 3.7 times higher than the same period last year. Ngũ Hành Sơn ward has the most cases this year (1,363), including 230 in week 47; other high-burden wards are An Khê (150), Điện Bàn Đông (149), and Sơn Trà (128). The city recorded 86 small outbreaks in the week; since January there have been 796 small outbreaks, five times the prior year. The Da Nang Center for Disease Control (CDC) notes intensified surveillance, zoning, and outbreak response, with 554 active vector surveillance/investigation points, 85 of which have high indices. Challenges include shortages of insecticide chemicals, limited healthcare staffing, dispersed high-risk areas, and variable community participation in larval source reduction, hindering control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ダナン市、1週間で2,200件超のデング熱症例
triage.triage_reason: ダナン市でデング熱症例が前年比3.7倍に急増し、小規模流行も多発しており、現地CDCが人員・殺虫剤不足などの対応課題を報告していることから、WPRO基準複数該当かつ行政の関心も高い。
triage.notes: 症例の重症度（入院率・死亡者数）に関する情報が記事内になく、重症度基準は不明と評価した。デング熱はベトナムにおいて季節性の既知流行病だが、前年比での急増と対応リソース不足の指摘から継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Manila Reports 5,164 Dengue Cases in 2026: Health Department Urges Precautions
article.articleSummary: 5,164 dengue cases in Manila from January–November 2026, per the WILD Diseases Report, with 44 new dengue cases reported on 23 November 2026. The Manila Health Department urges precautions during the rainy season: keep surroundings clean, eliminate stagnant water, stay hydrated, and seek medical attention if symptoms persist. The report also shows 3,284 influenza-like illness cases in Manila (26 new on 23 Nov) and 94 typhoid fever cases (one new), with no new cholera, COVID-19, severe acute respiratory infection, or leptospirosis. Quezon City records the region’s highest dengue burden with 7,652 cases and 43 deaths as of November 2026. The data underscore ongoing dengue transmission in Metro Manila, prompting continued public health guidance to reduce vector habitats and seek care for symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: マニラのデング熱症例が2026年に5,164件に到達：保健当局が注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: マニラ首都圏で季節性デング熱の継続的な流行が報告されており死亡例もあるが、例年の雨季パターンの範囲内で社会的関心の急激な高まりは確認できないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: ケソン市で43人の死者と7,652件の症例が報告されており、マニラ首都圏全体でのデング熱負担が高い。雨季の季節性流行であり、インフルエンザ様疾患・腸チフスも併記されているが、コレラ・COVID-19・レプトスピラ症の新規例はない。

article.articleHeadline: Rasa Sakitnya Buat Enzy Storia Menderita, Dugaan Awal Sang Artis Terinfeksi Amuba Dibeberkan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The pain that makes Enzy Storia suffer, the artist's initial suspicion of amoeba infection was revealed.
article.articleSummary: Suspected amoebic infection (amebiasis) in Enzy Storia, a 34-year-old Indonesian presenter, leading to hospitalization in Jakarta. Doctors’ examination reported amoeba infection; she endured high fever and diarrhea. The update, shared on November 19, 2026, shows her in hospital with an IV, and she later teased it as an “elite” disease. Amoeba parasites infect the large intestine and cause amebiasis, typically transmitted via contaminated food or water; symptoms include diarrhea (sometimes bloody or with mucus), abdominal cramps, nausea, and fever, though some cases are asymptomatic. Enzy suspects a raw salad as the possible source of transmission. The report originates from BanjarmasinPost.co.id and mentions Enzy in Central Jakarta’s Senayan area during follow-up. The article does not provide official case counts or fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: エンジー・ストリアを苦しめた痛み、アーティストがアメーバ感染の疑いと判明
triage.triage_reason: 著名人1個人の散発的なアメーバ症疑い症例に関する芸能ニュースであり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 有名人個人の病気に関する芸能記事であり、公衆衛生イベントとしての広がりは確認されていない。汚染された食品（生野菜サラダ）が感染源として疑われているが、他の感染者の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: 最新研究：帶有特殊細菌的蚊子能防治登革熱
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Latest Research: Mosquitoes Carrying Special Bacteria Can Prevent and Control Dengue Fever.
article.articleSummary: Brazil, a major dengue hotspot, saw markedly lower dengue fever and chikungunya infection risk among school-aged children in communities releasing Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti mosquitoes. In a four-year trial involving over 5,700 children, infection rates for dengue and chikungunya fell about 69% in Wolbachia communities versus similar areas using standard control methods. The protective effect persisted through Brazil’s severe 2024 dengue outbreak. The World Mosquito Program deploys releasing Wolbachia-carrying mosquitoes to establish bacterial infection in local populations; Wolbachia reduces a mosquito’s capacity to transmit certain viruses, and is passed to offspring. The bacterium is not harmful to humans and is not found in dengue-carrying mosquitoes. Half the communities were randomized to release Wolbachia mosquitoes. Zika cases were too few to assess impact. In Florida, USA, over 650 locally acquired dengue cases were reported as of November 20.

triage.headline_ja: 最新研究：特殊な細菌を持つ蚊がデング熱の予防・制御に効果
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はWolbachia感染蚊によるデング熱・チクングニア熱予防効果に関する研究報告であり、新規の公衆衛生上の緊急事態や異常な流行を示すものではない。
triage.notes: フロリダ（米国）の症例報告も含まれるが対象国リストに米国は含まれないため除外。本記事は研究成果の紹介であり、ブラジルの既存のデング熱流行状況を背景とした予防策の効果検証が主題。

article.articleHeadline: Polio drive targets 26 lakh children in 17 Odisha districts
article.articleSummary: Polio drive in Odisha, India targets more than 26 lakh children under five across 17 districts under the Intensive Pulse Polio Immunisation (IPPI) campaign, SNID. The three-day drive began Sunday and runs through November 24, inaugurated by Health Minister Mukesh Mahaling at the Urban Primary Health Centre in IRC Village. Odisha has been polio-free since 2008 and India since 2014, and officials stress sustaining high immunity until global eradication. A total of 12,908 vaccination booths are operational, supported by 739 transit teams, 400 mobile teams, and about 2,000 supervisors. In the first phase in June, about 37.48 lakh children received polio drops. Door-to-door visits will occur November 23–24 to reach children missed initially, with a special kiosk at Bali Jatra grounds in Cuttack for fairgoers. Districts covered include Anugola, Baleshwar, Bhadrak, Boudh, Kataka, Gajapati, Ganjam, Jajpur, Jharsuguda, Kalahandi, Kendujhar, Khurda, Malkangiri, Mayurbhanj, Puri, Sambalpur and Sundaragada.

triage.headline_ja: オディシャ州17県で260万人の子供を対象にポリオ接種キャンペーン実施
triage.triage_reason: これは定期予防接種キャンペーン(IPPI/SNID)の報道であり、実際の感染症発生事例ではない。インドは2014年にポリオフリー認定済みで、記事は予防活動のルーティン報告に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 記事はポリオの新規症例発生ではなく、予防的なワクチン接種キャンペーンの実施報告である。インドは既にポリオフリー国(2014年認定)であり、本イベントは疾病発生シグナルに該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: പൾസ് പോളിയോ ; ശബരിമല തീർത്ഥാടനത്തിനെത്തിയ 168 കുഞ്ഞുങ്ങൾക്ക് പമ്പയിൽ തുള്ളി മരുന്ന് നൽകി
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pulse Polio; 168 children who arrived for the Shabarimala pilgrimage were given polio drops.
article.articleSummary: 168 children arriving for the Shabarimala pilgrimage were given oral polio vaccine drops from a Pulse Polio booth at Pampa on Sunday. Of these, 100 were from various districts within Kerala and 68 from other states. The inauguration was led by ADM Dileep K. Kainikkar, with attendees including Pampa Police Special Officer Niyas, Additional Special Officer Dr. Nandagopan, Forest Department Assistant Conservator Manu Sathyan, District Shabarimla Nodal Officer (Health) K. K. Shyamkumar, and medical officers Dr. Sajin and Dr. Jijo, along with health workers and officials from multiple departments. The drive aims to immunize children heading to the pilgrimage against polio and to deliver health services and awareness at pilgrimage centers, under the campaign titled “Swasthyam Sharanam, Aarogyathode Sharanayathra.”

triage.headline_ja: パルスポリオ；シャバリマラ巡礼に訪れた168人の子供たちにパンバーでポリオ経口ワクチンが投与された
triage.triage_reason: これはポリオ発生事例ではなく、巡礼者向けの定期的なポリオワクチン接種キャンペーンの報道であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態は確認されない。
triage.notes: 記事はポリオ感染症例の報告ではなく、ワクチン接種（予防）活動の紹介記事。疾患発生地域としてインドが挙げられているが、実際のポリオ症例発生の記載はないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Kolhapur News: बोरिवडेतील चिमुरडीचा 'रेबीजसदृश' लक्षणांनी मृत्यू ,प्रतिबंधक लस नव्हती घेतली , महिन्यापूर्वी घटना
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kolhapur News: Little girl from Borivade dies with rabies-like symptoms; had not taken the rabies vaccine; incident occurred a month ago.
article.articleSummary: Eight-year-old Revati Santosh Chaugale from Borivade, Panhala taluka, Kolhapur district, Maharashtra, died of rabies-like symptoms during treatment. About a month earlier, a stray dog chased her; she fell and injured her knee, but it was unclear whether she was bitten, so rabies prophylaxis was not given. She developed fear of water and crowds before deteriorating and dying at Kolhapur’s CPR hospital around 2:30 am on Saturday. This marks the district’s third rabies-related death since March 2024 (Srishti Sunil Shinde, 21, died after a dog attack near Nagala Park; attack Feb 3, 2024; death Mar 4, 2024). In Borivade, 6–7 people were bitten by roaming dogs last month, and in Pajjarwadi 25–30 residents were attacked. Doctors advised rabies prophylaxis for 34 contacts and urged stray-dog control.

triage.headline_ja: コールハープルニュース:ボリヴァデの少女が「狂犬病様」症状で死亡、予防接種は未接種、事件は1か月前に発生
triage.triage_reason: 個別の狂犬病疑い死亡例であり、インドでは狂犬病は風土病的に発生しているため国際的異常性は低いが、野良犬による複数人咬傷（34名への予防措置勧告）があり地域的な感染リスクの継続が懸念されるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はインドで風土病的に発生しており、本件は地方紙報道による個別死亡例。ただし同地区で複数の野良犬咬傷事例（6-7名、25-30名）が発生しており、地域的な狂犬病対策の必要性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Global dengue cases rise 34-fold in three decades
article.articleSummary: Global dengue cases have risen 34-fold since 1990, with 74 million infections across 143 countries through 2024. About 10.7 million cases are missing from WHO databases, signaling undercounting in surveillance. Bangladesh faces a major outbreak: by November 22, 2026, 173,473 hospitalizations and 518 deaths; in the prior 24 hours, 1,519 admissions and 2 deaths, with the Dhaka Division accounting for 755 new admissions. The findings were presented at the ASTMH meeting in National Harbor, Maryland, by Dr. Ahyoung Lim of the London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine. South Asia shows the fastest growth, with rising cases in Africa and the Middle East; increases reflect both real spread and improved detection, not unique drivers. Dengue, transmitted by Aedes aegypti in urban areas, is influenced by climate, urbanisation, and travel, underscoring the need for stronger surveillance. Dataset includes Bangladesh, India, Pakistan, Nepal, and Sri Lanka.

triage.headline_ja: 世界のデング熱症例、過去30年間で34倍に増加
triage.triage_reason: グローバルなデング熱増加トレンドの学会報告で、主要な深刻事例はバングラデシュ（対象国外）に集中しており、対象国（India等）については具体的な症例データが示されていないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はグローバルなデング熱増加トレンドの学会発表で、具体的な深刻事例（173,473人入院、518人死亡）はバングラデシュに集中しているが、バングラデシュは対象国リストに含まれない。Indiaはデータセットに含まれる旨の言及のみで、具体的症例データは記載されていないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО заяви, че сражения в ДР Конго са прекъснали усилията в борбата с ебола, принуждавайки здравните работници да се укрият в болница за повече от 24 часа
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO said that fighting in the DRC has disrupted efforts to fight Ebola, forcing health workers to take shelter in a hospital for more than 24 hours.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ituri province, is experiencing intensified Ebola disruption as fighting near a hospital forces health workers and aid partners to shelter in a maternity ward for more than 24 hours. WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stated that late-October clashes near the outbreak origin have put patients, families, and medical staff at serious risk and hindered response efforts. WHO is coordinating safe evacuations and urging protection for health facilities, personnel, and patients. As of November 23, 2026, the outbreak has surpassed 11,000 confirmed cases, marking it the second-largest Ebola outbreak by scale and deaths, after West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (over 28,600 infections and more than 11,000 deaths). The outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no approved treatments or vaccines.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが発表、DRCでの戦闘がエボラ対応を中断させ、医療従事者が24時間以上病院に避難を強いられる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（1万1000例超）に加え、紛争による対応中断という異常事態であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当し国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Angolaは発生地域に含まれるが記事本文では言及なし。感染確認は11,000例超、ブンディブギョ株による稀なエボラアウトブレイクで治療薬・ワクチン未承認。治安悪化により対応が困難化している点が最大の懸念点。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết gây suy đa tạng, mất thị lực
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever causes multi-organ failure and vision loss.
article.articleSummary: Two dengue cases in Vietnam illustrate severe organ and ocular complications. At Binh Duong General Hospital, a 1982-born woman (BMI 29) developed dengue shock with recurrent shock, respiratory failure, acute kidney and liver failure after four days of fever. She underwent 45 days of treatment, including 30 days in the ICU, mechanical ventilation, continuous renal replacement therapy, plasma exchange, and multi-organ support. Around two weeks in intensive care, she faced pneumonia from multidrug-resistant bacteria; after about 30 days in ICU, she improved and was moved to internal medicine. In Ho Chi Minh City, an 8-year-old girl developed marked vision loss after dengue, with optic neuritis on MRI. Treated with anti-inflammatory therapy, vision recovered over two weeks (right eye 10/10, left 10/10 by two weeks). Eye complications may occur around day 7 post-onset, even after fever subsides, highlighting dengue’s potential for serious ocular involvement. Published 2026-11-23.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱により多臓器不全と視力喪失が発生
triage.triage_reason: 個別の重症デング症例2件に関する臨床啓発記事であり、アウトブレイクや症例数急増を示す疫学的異常性は認められない。デング熱はベトナムで流行性疾患であり、本記事は合併症の臨床経過を紹介する医療情報記事に留まる。
triage.notes: 記事は個別患者2名（成人女性・8歳女児）の重症合併症（多臓器不全、視神経炎による視力障害）に関する症例報告であり、集団発生や症例数増加の言及はない。デング熱はベトナムで季節性・地域流行性疾患として既知であり、本記事単独では新規シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes DIY Ingatkan 8 Penyakit yang Mengintai Saat Musim Hujan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yogyakarta Special Region Health Office Reminds of Eight Diseases That Lurk During the Rainy Season.
article.articleSummary: DIY (Yogyakarta Special Region), Indonesia, is urging heightened vigilance for eight diseases during the rainy season: dengue fever (DBD), chikungunya, leptospirosis, diarrhea, acute respiratory infection (ISPA), typhoid fever, hepatitis A, and influenza. Health Office chief Gregorius Anung Trihadi warns that clean-water stagnation fuels Aedes aegypti breeding, increasing DBD and chikungunya risk, while floodwater exposure and contaminated water or soil raise leptospirosis and gastrointestinal infections. The public is reminded that poor sanitation, crowding, and high humidity can elevate ISPA and influenza risk; dermatitis and athlete’s foot are also noted after contact with dirty water. Vulnerable groups include children under five, the elderly, pregnant women, and those with chronic diseases. Preventive measures include 3M Plus (drain and cover water containers, reuse waste items that can become standing-water sites), mosquito repellent, larval checks, safe water/food handling, handwashing, and seeking care for fevers over two days. Cross-sector coordination and weekly surveillance support early response.

triage.headline_ja: ジョグジャカルタ特別州保健局、雨季に警戒すべき8つの疾患を注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 特定の異常な流行事例ではなく、雨季における一般的な疾病予防の注意喚起であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 具体的な症例数や異常な増加傾向の記載はなく、季節性疾病に対する予防啓発記事である。

article.articleHeadline: 观健康周报｜北方流感阳性率升至16.3%；18批次化妆品检出禁用原料
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Watch Weekly | Northern influenza positivity rate rises to 16.3%; 18 batches of cosmetics detected with prohibited ingredients.
article.articleSummary: Northern influenza positivity rate rises to 16.3% for the week of November 9–15, 2026, with nationwide 144 influenza-like illness outbreaks reported. Subtype distribution shows influenza A(H1N1) dominating in the North at 78.0% of positives, while influenza B Victoria lineage is most common in the South at 39.7%, with A(H1N1) at 36.6%. The data indicate ongoing seasonal influenza activity with regional subtype differences. In related public-health news, 18 batches of cosmetics were detected with prohibited ingredients, triggering investigations by authorities and risk-control actions against manufacturers. The week also features various pharmaceutical industry moves and regulatory developments in China and abroad, but influenza surveillance constitutes the primary outbreak signal in this issue.

triage.headline_ja: 観健康週報｜北方のインフルエンザ陽性率16.3%に上昇；化粧品18バッチから禁止原料検出
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの定例サーベイランス報告であり、異常な病原性や国際的拡大のリスクを示す内容はなく、通常の季節流行の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: 通常の季節性インフルエンザサーベイランスデータであり、既知の亜型（H1N1、Bビクトリア系統）の流行で新規性や異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: 「最良の薬は平和」WHO事務局長、エボラ流行のコンゴ東部で戦闘停止訴え
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: “The best medicine is peace,” says the WHO Director-General, calling for a ceasefire in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo amid an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues with 11,613 confirmed infections and 5,678 deaths, the worst on record for the country. The eastern regions—Ituri and North Kivu—are hardest hit as the virus spreads northeast. The WHO reports that attacks since late October have disrupted outbreak response, including hospital operations and patient care. WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus called for a ceasefire to safeguard health workers and patients after hospitals, including obstetric wards, were sheltering for more than 24 hours near Ituri. Despite some regional declines, transmission remains high overall. The report notes high mortality among children treated outside specialized facilities, highlighting ongoing challenges in early detection and rapid treatment and the need to protect facilities, staff, and patients.

triage.headline_ja: 「最良の薬は平和」WHO事務局長、エボラ流行のコンゴ東部で戦闘停止訴え
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱が過去最悪規模（感染11,613例、死亡5,678例）で拡大しており、紛争による対応阻害も重なり公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 紛争により医療対応が妨げられており、WHOが停戦を呼びかけるなど国際的関心・支援の必要性が極めて高い事例。

article.articleHeadline: Nuevas variantes del Covid obligan a no bajar la guardia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New COVID-19 variants force us to keep our guard up.
article.articleSummary: Argentina reports a new coronavirus sublineage with higher transmissibility, identified by scientists in La Plata, Buenos Aires Province. It was detected in samples from two infants (1 and 2 months) and a 58-year-old hospitalized adult in Buenos Aires hospitals. The variant is also circulating in the United States, Canada, and Brazil. The World Health Organization has placed the sublineage under surveillance with a global risk assessment currently low as researchers evaluate its transmission potential and vaccine effectiveness. Sequencing was conducted by the Genomics and Molecular Area of the Public Health Laboratory at the Faculty of Exact Sciences; results confirm its presence in Argentina, with epidemiological follow-up planned to determine extent of spread. The report notes that COVID-19 persists and urges continued vigilance, referencing Omicron and the possibility of new variants, without inducing alarm.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスの新変異株、警戒継続を迫る
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチン等での新変異株検出だが、WHOのグローバルリスク評価は低く、対象国（日本周辺アジア・アフリカ等）に該当せず社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 発生地域はアルゼンチン・米国・カナダ・ブラジルで、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）のうちBrazilが言及されているが、記事の主題はアルゼンチンでの変異株検出であり、ブラジルは『循環している地域』として言及されるのみで主題ではないため除外。WHOのリスク評価は低いとされている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Chief Demands Peace as Fighting Paralyzes Ebola Response in Eastern Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues with sustained transmission in Ituri and North Kivu. Fighting around a hospital in Ituri forced medical teams to shelter for more than 24 hours in a maternity ward, halting containment activities. WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged an immediate cessation of hostilities to protect patients and staff and to secure safe exit for trapped personnel. As of November 17, the DRC reported 11,613 Ebola cases and 5,678 deaths—the largest and deadliest outbreak in the country’s history—with ongoing high‑level transmission despite some local declines. Ongoing clashes between government forces and the Rwanda‑backed M23 rebels, plus gun attacks in North Kivu, hinder vaccine and treatment campaigns and transport of supplies. The WHO seeks humanitarian corridors to resume vaccination and care, underscoring protection of health infrastructure under international humanitarian law.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、コンゴ東部でエボラ対応が戦闘により麻痺する中、停戦を要求
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行（11,613症例、5,678死亡）が継続しており、武力紛争により対応活動が妨げられ、WHOトップが介入を求めるなど国際的関心・深刻度ともに極めて高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にRwandaが含まれているが、記事本文はDRC（イトゥリ州・北キブ州）での流行継続とM23反乱軍との戦闘による対応妨害が主題であり、ルワンダ国内での発生については言及なし（対象国リストにもRwandaは含まれない）。

article.articleHeadline: Ruto, Tshisekedi call for regional cooperation to tackle Ebola epidemic
article.articleSummary: Kenya President William Ruto and Democratic Republic of Congo President Félix Tshisekedi urged stronger regional cooperation to eradicate the Ebola epidemic, issuing a joint communiqué after the Quadripartite Political Summit in Oyo, Republic of the Congo, on November 22, 2026. The leaders—joined by Denis Sassou N'Guesso of the Republic of the Congo and Faure Gnassingbé of Togo (AU mediator for eastern DRC security concerns)—emphasised that public health must be addressed through collective action. The communiqué recognises the particularly serious consequences of Ebola and calls for multi-country collaboration, though it does not outline specific measures, funding, or timelines. The summit also underscored broader regional cooperation through the ICGLR and the East African Community (EAC) and committed to diplomacy, dialogue, and African solidarity to prevent disputes from undermining stability. Public health cooperation was framed within strengthening bilateral ties and regional resilience.

triage.headline_ja: ルト氏とチセケディ氏、エボラ流行対策へ地域協力を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ流行に関し首脳級の地域協力要請が行われており、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクの観点でIHR基準を2つ満たすため。

article.articleHeadline: 今年流感季三种毒株同时活跃！医生提醒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three influenza strains are circulating simultaneously this flu season—doctors warn.
article.articleSummary: Three influenza strains—A/H1N1, A/H3N2, and B/Victoria—are circulating in China this flu season (as of November 2026). National CDC surveillance shows overall mid-level activity, with northern areas seeing rising positivity and the south fluctuating. In October A/H3N2 dominated; by November A/H1N1 rose to dominance, while A/H3N2 fell below 20% and B/Victoria remained relatively stable. Multi-strain circulation and rapid switching increase the risk of sequential infections and complicate vaccination expectations. Cross-protection between strains is weak; a trivalent vaccine can protect against all three. Children aged 5-14 currently have the highest influenza positivity; preventive focus is early recognition and avoiding crowding in schools and daycare. For seniors (65+), emphasis on preventing severe disease, timely vaccination, and early medical evaluation. After household exposure, oseltamivir can be used for seven days; antibiotics should not be self-administered.

triage.headline_ja: 今年の流感シーズンは3種類のウイルス株が同時に流行―医師が注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行状況を報じる内容であり、異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航貿易制限の懸念は認められず、通常の公衆衛生情報提供の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1・H3N2・B型)の複数株同時流行に関する通常の医療情報記事。中国国内のサーベイランス報告であり、重症例の急増や異常な事象の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: 看着可爱就无害？一旦发病 致死率100%！
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Looks cute, is it harmless? Once it develops, the fatality rate is 100%!
article.articleSummary: Rabies outbreak in Wuhan, China: two confirmed cases admitted to Wuhan Jinyintan Hospital's ICU in November 2026. Patient A was scratched by a two-month-old unvaccinated puppy two months prior; Patient B was licked by a less-than-one-month-old puppy in July. Both developed classic rabies symptoms (hydrophobia, fear of wind and water, throat tightness, difficulty swallowing) and died after symptom onset. Rabies virus is present in saliva and can infect via bites, scratches, or saliva contacting broken skin or mucosa; the extent of bleeding is not related to infection risk. Puppies can carry rabies through maternal transmission or exposure to infected animals. Post-exposure management follows the ‘rinse, disinfect, vaccinate’ protocol: wash wounds with soap and running water for at least 15 minutes, apply antiseptic, then seek prompt vaccination and, if indicated, rabies immunoglobulin. The claim that vaccination after 24 hours is ineffective is debunked; vaccination remains protective if started after exposure. Public health message: even cute puppies can pose serious risk; seek timely medical care after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 可愛く見えても無害ではない？発症すれば致死率100%！

article.articleHeadline: Banjir Lokal Intai 12 Provinsi Hari Ini, Kemenkes Ingatkan Bahaya DBD dan Leptospirosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Local floods threaten 12 provinces today; the Ministry of Health warns of the dangers of dengue fever and leptospirosis.
article.articleSummary: Localized floods threaten 12 Indonesian provinces on 23 November 2026 as BMKG warns of heavy rain with lightning, reduced visibility, and potential flash floods. The Health Ministry warns dengue fever and leptospirosis rise during the rainy season. Provinces affected include Nusa Tenggara Barat, Bangka Belitung Islands, North Sulawesi, Papua, Central Sulawesi, Central Kalimantan, South Sumatra, South Sulawesi, East Java, Lampung, West Java, and Bengkulu, with focus areas such as parts of West Java, Lampung, and South Sulawesi cited. Dengue remains a nationwide concern: by week 43 of 2024, 210,644 cases and 1,239 deaths across 259 districts/cities in 32 provinces; the 2024 expansion reached 482 regencies/cities, shortening the annual cycle. Leptospirosis risk rises when floodwaters contaminated by rat urine contact skin or wounds. 3M Plus PSN measures; Halo Kemenkes 1500-567; BMKG updates online. Also note diarrhea, ISPA, skin conditions in shelters, and typhoid as seasonal concerns.

article.articleHeadline: Review Identifies Broad Genetic Diversity and Virulence Profiles Across
article.articleSummary: Shiga toxin-producing Escherichia coli (STEC) shows broad genetic diversity and virulence profiles across 55 studies (2010-2025), reaffirming its status as a major foodborne pathogen capable of watery diarrhea, hemorrhagic colitis, and hemolytic uremic syndrome. An evidence-mapping synthesis using PRISMA 2020 screened 194 records from PubMed, Embase, Scopus, SciELO, and Web of Science and included 55 peer-reviewed studies. The Americas dominate the literature, with Brazil contributing the largest share, followed by the United States; other contributors include Argentina, Germany, China, Japan, Norway, and Canada. Animal reservoirs were most studied (32), then food (22), human (19), and environmental samples (6). Molecular methods varied: targeted PCR in 47 studies (85.5%) and whole-genome sequencing in 9. Notably, asymptomatic cattle at the rectoanal junction shed STEC, highlighting agricultural contamination pathways to human food chains. The regional clustering reflects surveillance capacity and research funding rather than true global burden.

triage.headline_ja: 文献レビュー、STEC(志賀毒素産生性大腸菌)研究全体にわたる広範な遺伝的多様性と病原性プロファイルを特定
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は特定の発生事例ではなく、2010-2025年の55研究を対象とした文献レビュー（エビデンスマッピング）であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態や新規アウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術的な系統的レビュー（PRISMA 2020によるエビデンスマッピング）であり、特定の国での発生・アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。ブラジル・中国は研究対象地域として言及されているが、実際の感染イベントの発生国ではないため、参考として記載するが実質的なシグナルとは判断しない。

article.articleHeadline: Piracicaba estima 14 mil casos suspeitos de dengue em 2027 em plano de contingência
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Piracicaba estimates 14,000 suspected dengue cases in 2027 as part of its contingency plan.
article.articleSummary: Piracicaba, São Paulo, Brazil, unveils a Municipal Contingency Plan for arboviruses predicting 14,107 suspected dengue cases in 2027, with 112 hospitalizations in general wards and 23 in ICU. By Sept 18, 2026, the city reported 82 confirmed dengue cases and 7,688 notifications, against 5,843 infections in 2025. The plan, to be discussed by the Municipal Health Council on Tuesday, Nov 24, 2026, includes house-to-house visits, elimination of Aedes aegypti breeding sites, educational campaigns, and neighborhood-level reporting on actions and findings. A nationwide study for the Health Ministry projects about 860,000 probable dengue cases in Brazil in 2027, similar to 2025–2026, highlighting uncertainty tied to El Niño. Experts from Fiocruz/InfoDengue warn that local control and the susceptible population will largely shape outcomes, with climate serving as a planning signal rather than a forecast.

triage.headline_ja: ピラシカーバ市、2027年に推定1万4000件のデング熱疑い例を見込み緊急対応計画を策定
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの一地方都市による将来予測に基づく行政計画の報道であり、現時点で異常な流行や国際的拡大の兆候はないが、デング熱は毎年流行する疾患であり継続的な観察対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・サンパウロ州ピラシカーバ市の2027年に向けた行政的な緊急対応計画の発表であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクではない。デング熱はブラジルで毎年流行する既知の疾患であり、ヒト-ヒト感染ではなく蚊媒介性であるため国際伝播リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: DKPP: 524 hewan di Barito Selatan telah divaksin rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DKPP: 524 animals in South Barito have been vaccinated against rabies.
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination completed for 524 animals in Barito Selatan (South Barito), Central Kalimantan, Indonesia, as of 23 November 2026. The local Department of Food Security and Agriculture (DKPP) Barito Selatan vaccinated 524 animals, comprising 512 dogs and 12 cats, in Buntok. Head of DKPP Barito Selatan Ida Safitri said the immunization is part of regional efforts to prevent the spread of rabies and protect residents from bites by infected animals. The initiative aims to reduce transmission risk and safeguard community health. Officials urged pet owners to maintain animal health, vaccinate on schedule, and monitor pets to prevent free roaming, reinforcing vaccination as a key measure to control rabies in Barito Selatan.
