article.articleHeadline: Espérance Kombi décrit le service Ebola à Biakato, Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Espérance Kombi describes the Ebola ward in Biakato, Congo.
article.articleSummary: Three-quarters of Ebola patients in Biakato, Democratic Republic of the Congo, have died as the outbreak expands to eight provinces, fragmenting into multiple foci across a region roughly the size of Great Britain. Biakato has at times accounted for up to a quarter of new national cases, while health workers have contained transmission at the origin and infections rise elsewhere. The New York Times reports that inadequate facilities and attacks by Islamic State–aligned militants worsen conditions in the Ebola ward. Detection first occurred in May, and the outbreak has since grown dramatically. Dr. Jean-Jacques Muyembe, longtime Ebola investigator and head of Congo’s National Biomedical Research Institute, laments repeating the same mistakes and says it feels like starting from zero. ISIS threats add to the challenges of containing the epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: エスペランス・コンビ氏、コンゴ・ビアカトのエボラ病棟の様子を語る
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で8州に拡大し致死率も高く、武装勢力の攻撃により対応が困難化しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 致死率約75%と報告されており、8州にまたがる複数の感染拡大地点、医療体制の不備、ISIS系武装勢力による攻撃がアウトブレイク対応を著しく困難にしている。国際的な支援ニーズが高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Pasaulio sveikatos organizacijos vadovas ragina siekti taikos Ebolos krečiamoje KDR
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General urges the pursuit of peace in the Ebola-stricken DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains the deadliest globally, with 5,678 deaths among 11,613 confirmed cases. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus on 2026-11-23 urged pursuit of peace as violence in eastern DRC intensified since late October, severely hampering the response. He noted that medical staff have sheltered for more than 24 hours inside a hospital maternity ward, disrupting operations and endangering patients, families, and health workers. WHO is working to organize a safe withdrawal and to protect hospital spaces, staff and patients. Ituri and North Kivu remain the hardest-hit provinces, with the virus spreading across eastern and northeastern DRC amid long-running conflict. Many deaths occur in communities outside treatment centers, especially among young children, due to late detection and gaps in care. The outbreak remains an international public health emergency.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、エボラ禍のコンゴ民主共和国で平和の追求を訴える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱の大規模流行（感染11,613例、死亡5,678例）が継続中であり、紛争により対応が著しく阻害され国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態とされているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 紛争により医療スタッフが病院内に24時間以上避難する事態が発生しており、対応能力の著しい低下が懸念される。既に国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態として扱われている継続中の大規模流行。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ituri : des équipes anti-Ebola bloquées dans un hôpital par des combats, alerte l'OMS | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ituri: Ebola response teams blocked in a hospital by clashes, WHO warns | mediacongo.net.
article.articleSummary: Ebola response teams are trapped for over 24 hours in the maternity ward of a hospital in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, after violent clashes on November 21 in the hospital's vicinity. The World Health Organization notes the hospital is near the zone where an Ebola outbreak has been detected, and the stoppage disrupts both patient care and response activities, risking patients, families, and healthcare workers. The situation follows a rise in attacks in eastern DRC since late October, hampering outbreak control efforts. WHO, with humanitarian partners, says it is in contact with the parties to secure safe departure of the teams and calls for immediate safe evacuation and protection of the hospital, its staff and patients. The agency emphasizes that peace remains the best remedy.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ:エボラ対応チームが戦闘により病院内に閉じ込められる、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州でのエボラ流行対応中に紛争により対応チームが活動停止に追い込まれ、感染拡大防止活動が阻害されている。国際的拡大リスクと管理可能性の観点から懸念が高く、WHOも警告を発している。
triage.notes: 紛争により対応活動が妨げられている点がエボラ制御の重大なリスク要因。続報でアウトブレイクの規模・感染者数等の情報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Bilim insanlarından sivrisinek kaynaklı hastalıklara sivrisinekle çözüm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists propose a mosquito-based solution to mosquito-borne diseases.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian researchers report that Wolbachia-infected Aedes mosquitoes, unable to transmit viruses, reduced dengue fever and chikungunya infections by about 69% among school-age children in neighborhoods with high densities of these mosquitoes. In a study of over 5,700 children in one of the world’s dengue hotspots, children in areas with Wolbachia-carrying mosquitoes had roughly 69% lower dengue and chikungunya incidence than comparable areas without them, with the protective effect persisting through Brazil’s severe dengue outbreak in 2024. The findings bolster the viability of releasing Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes as a complementary strategy to insecticides and bite avoidance. Separately, Florida is grappling with an unusually large dengue outbreak, likely the state's largest since the 1940s, with more than 650 locally acquired cases as of Friday, predominantly in Hillsborough County (Tampa); most U.S. dengue cases are travel-associated, but local transmission is evident.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者たちが蚊媒介感染症に対し蚊を用いた解決策を提案
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジルでのWolbachia感染蚊によるデング熱・チクングニア熱抑制効果を示す研究成果の紹介であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威やアウトブレイクの発生を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はWolbachia感染蚊を用いた媒介制御の研究成果とフロリダ州（米国、対象国外）のデング熱アウトブレイクに言及しているが、いずれも新規の緊急シグナルではなく、既知のデング熱流行状況の文脈的報道。フロリダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Red Betel Leaf Neolignan Inhibits Hepatitis C Virus in Cell Culture Models
article.articleSummary: Crocatin A, a neolignan from red betel leaves (Piper crocatum) collected in East Java, inhibits hepatitis C virus (HCV) replication in vitro, showing potent activity against the Japan fulminant hepatitis 1 (JFH-1) strain in cultured human hepatocytes. The study found antiviral effects from both the crude 70% ethanol leaf extract and the purified compound, with active constituents dispersed across multiple polarity fractions. From 228 g of dried leaves, 26.22 g of crude extract (11.5%) was obtained, then fractionated into nine pools; six fractions inhibited the virus by >80%. Fraction F4 yielded 8.2 mg of crocatin A (0.003% of starting material) after preparative HPLC, with structural confirmation by 1H/13C NMR (24 carbons). Indonesia bears ~1.4 million chronic HCV cases, contributing to a global burden of ~50 million infections and ~244,000 deaths in 2022. The findings highlight ongoing search for affordable antiviral candidates amid limited access to costly, IP-restricted direct-acting antivirals.

triage.headline_ja: 赤色ベテルリーフ由来ネオリグナンが細胞培養モデルでC型肝炎ウイルスを阻害
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は基礎研究（in vitro抗ウイルス化合物の発見）であり、公衆衛生上の緊急イベントや流行報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は植物由来化合物のHCVに対する抗ウイルス活性を示す基礎研究報告であり、インドネシアの慢性HCV罹患率の背景情報として言及されているのみで、実際の発生事象ではない。日本はJFH-1株（研究用ウイルス株名）に由来するもので、発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Un any després del primer cas de pesta porcina, els ramaders perden 38 euros per cada porc - 3CatInfo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A year after the first case of swine fever, farmers lose 38 euros per pig
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-23, Catalan pig farmers face a crisis triggered by the first African swine fever (ASF) case in a wild boar in Bellaterra a year earlier. Farmers lose about €38 per pig sent to slaughter; Mercolleida live-pig prices remain below production costs (costs around €1.42/kg vs price just over €1). Over 12 months, the gap widened and costs outpace price. Unió de Pagesos estimates that, had prices and markets not shifted, Catalan producers would have earned €400m; they have lost €300m, though not all losses are due to ASF. Slaughterhouses, especially in Barcelona, are in a critical situation: five of eight have filed temporary layoff schemes affecting hundreds of workers due to export restrictions on ASF-affected zones. Japan and Mexico halted imports; China restricted to Barcelona; European demand remains weak. Recovery hinges on lifting bans and market stabilization, with normalization not expected until a year after the last wild boar case.

triage.headline_ja: 豚熱(ASF)最初の症例から1年、養豚農家は豚1頭あたり38ユーロの損失
triage.triage_reason: 記事はスペイン・カタルーニャ州におけるASFの経済的影響に関する内容であり、対象国（中国等）は輸入制限措置の対象として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないため対象外。
triage.notes: 記事はスペイン国内の家畜経済影響に関する内容。中国・日本・メキシコは輸入停止措置の主体として登場するのみで、ASF発生国ではないため対象国リストに該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: V epicentre epidémie eboly vypukli ťažké boje. Zdravotníci sa už viac než deň ukrývajú v nemocnici
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak, heavy fighting broke out. Healthcare workers have been sheltering in a hospital for more than a day.
article.articleSummary: Heavy fighting near a hospital in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, disrupted the Ebola response as healthcare workers sheltered inside the hospital for more than 24 hours. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus called for a cessation of hostilities to protect patients, staff, and facilities. The outbreak has reached 11,613 confirmed cases with 5,678 deaths, the largest on record for the DRC. The virus continues to spread in the eastern and northeastern regions, with Ituri and North Kivu remaining the most affected provinces. WHO notes that high mortality is occurring in local communities outside specialized health centers, including young children, linked to delays in detection and timely care. Tedros stressed the emergency status of the outbreak with international implications and that the best medicine is peace; efforts continue to secure safe withdrawal of health workers and protect hospital infrastructure.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行の震源地で激しい戦闘が勃発。医療従事者は1日以上病院に避難
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模（11,613症例、5,678死亡）のエボラ流行が継続中で、武力衝突により対応が妨げられており、WHO事務局長も緊急事態として国際的影響を強調している。
triage.notes: DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行で、武力紛争により対応活動が妨げられている点が特に懸念される。WHO事務局長が直接介入を呼びかけており、国際的な注目度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Сражения в ДР Конго блокираха медици в болница за над 24 часа и спряха борбата с ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Clashes in the DR Congo blocked medics in a hospital for more than 24 hours and halted the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 November 2026, clashes near a hospital in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, blocked Ebola response efforts for more than 24 hours, forcing health workers and humanitarian staff to shelter in the maternity ward. The fighting occurred in close proximity to the area where the Ebola outbreak was first detected, placing patients, their families, and responders at high risk and complicating containment. Since late October, attacks in eastern Congo have intensified, hindering surveillance, case management, and control measures for the deadly Ebola virus. The World Health Organization is coordinating with humanitarian partners to secure the safe evacuation of staff trapped inside the facility and to safeguard hospitals and people within them, highlighting ongoing security challenges impacting the outbreak response in Ituri. There are no case or death counts provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国での戦闘により、医療従事者が病院に24時間以上閉じ込められ、エボラ対策が停止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の対応が武力衝突により阻害されており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが懸念されるため、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: イツリ州での武力衝突によりエボラ対応活動（サーベイランス・症例管理）が阻害されており、WHOが人道支援機関と連携して医療従事者の避難を調整中。症例数・死亡数の具体的データは記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Espérance Kombi describe la sala de ébola en Biakato, Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Espérance Kombi describes the Ebola ward in Biakato, Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Biakato, Democratic Republic of the Congo, has mortality among Biakato patients reaching about 75%, as the outbreak expands to eight provinces. The New York Times reports the outbreak, first detected in May, now spanning an area roughly the size of Great Britain. Biakato has at times accounted for up to a quarter of new national cases. Health workers have contained the virus at its origin, while infections rise in other areas. Dr. Jean-Jacques Muyembe, who helped identify Ebola in 1976 and now heads the National Institute of Biomedical Research in the Congo, says the response is repeating past mistakes and feels like starting from zero. The containment effort is further complicated by attacks from the Islamic State (ISIS).

triage.headline_ja: エスペランス・コンビ氏、コンゴ・ビアカトのエボラ病棟の様子を語る
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが8州に拡大し致死率約75%に達しており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心（NYT報道）も高いためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域に含まれるNew York・United Statesは記事主題と無関係のため除外。ISISによる攻撃が対応をさらに複雑化させている点も留意。

article.articleHeadline: Šéf WHO vyzval na zastavenie bojov v epicentre epidémie eboly v Konžskej demokratickej republike | Info.sk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Director-General of the World Health Organization called for an end to the fighting in the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo | Info.sk
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri and North Kivu) continues with 11,613 confirmed cases and 5,678 deaths. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus called on Sunday to end fighting in the epicenter, noting that heavy clashes near a hospital in Ituri have forced health workers to shelter in a maternity ward for more than 24 hours, disrupting the health response. The organization stresses the outbreak remains the largest Ebola epidemic in the DRC to date and a public health emergency of international concern, with transmission ongoing in Ituri and North Kivu. Although some areas show modest declines, many deaths occur in local communities outside specialized centers, including young children. WHO is working to ensure safe withdrawals of staff and protection of facilities, workers, patients, and the broader response.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行震源地での戦闘停止を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ流行はPHEICとして既に宣言されており、致死率の高さ・紛争による対応阻害・ヒト-ヒト感染継続など複数のIHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当するため、継続的なフルリスク評価対象とすべきシグナルである。
triage.notes: 本事案はWHOによりPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として既に認定されている既知の大規模アウトブレイクであり、本記事は紛争による対応への悪影響という新規動向を報じるもの。継続的なモニタリングと最新状況に基づくRRA更新が必要。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго сообщили, что число случаев заболевания Эболой превысило 11,7 тыс.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC reports that the number of Ebola virus disease cases has exceeded 11,700
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) reports Ebola virus disease outbreak ongoing since May 2026, with 11,762 confirmed cases and 5,775 deaths (case fatality 49.1%) as of November 23, 2026, per the National Institute of Public Health. The epicenter is Ituri Province, accounting for 68.3% of cases, with 68 of 178 medical zones affected across eight provinces. WHO notes that six months into Africa’s current flare-up in DRC and Uganda, response measures have expanded but transmission remains sustained and geographically widespread. High mortality outside health facilities, insecurity, population movement, and fragile health systems hinder control. The WHO Ebola Emergency Committee recommended extending the Public Health Emergency of International Concern, which Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus agreed remains in effect, with very high risk of further spread in the DRC. The outbreak is linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no licensed vaccines or treatments exist. Uganda’s outbreak ended in late July; Kenya reported a first Ebola case on Oct 6, and Nigeria detected Ebola on national territory on Oct 20, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: DRC、エボラ出血熱患者数が11,700人を超えたと報告
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、PHEIC継続、複数州・複数国(DRC、ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア)への拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアへの拡大も報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。WHOはPHEICの延長を決定しており、国際的関心が非常に高い事案。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО призова за мир в ДР Конго след сражения в епицентъра на ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO calls for peace in the DRC after clashes in the Ebola outbreak's epicenter.
article.articleSummary: WHO calls for peace as clashes near the Ebola outbreak epicenter in Ituri, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, disrupt response efforts. Health workers and humanitarian partners were forced to shelter in a maternity ward for more than 24 hours as intense fighting around a hospital disrupted medical operations. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stated the conflict undermines hospital functions and Ebola control measures, exposing patients, families and staff to serious risk, and called for safe extraction of personnel and protection of facilities. In a broader context, the outbreak—described as the largest and deadliest in the country—continues with high transmission, though some areas show a slight decline. As of 17 November, the DRC reported 11,613 cases and 5,678 deaths. The agency emphasizes that peace is the most effective intervention to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の震源地付近での衝突を受け平和を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで最大規模・最多死亡者数とされるエボラ出血熱の流行が続いており、武力衝突により対応活動が妨げられるなど、公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事態でIHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: Ituri州はDRC国内の行政区分であり、国としてはDRCのみ該当。武力衝突により医療・人道対応が妨げられている点が特に懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: ԱՀԿ ղեկավարն ահազանգել է Կոնգոյում էբոլայի բռնկման գոտում ընթացող ինտենսիվ մարտերի հետևանքների մասին
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The OSCE leader has warned about the consequences of the intense fighting underway in the Ebola outbreak zone in Congo.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that intense fighting in the Ebola outbreak zone in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, is disrupting control efforts. Medical staff and humanitarian partners have sheltered for more than 24 hours inside a maternity hospital. In a post on X, Tedros said clashes near the outbreak area have disrupted hospital operations and broader Ebola-response activities, putting patients, their families, and health workers at serious risk. Since late October, attacks in eastern Congo have increased, hindering normal health services. The WHO is in touch with parties to arrange safe evacuation of health workers and to protect the hospital, its staff, and patients. 'Peace is the best medicine,' he said. Reuters notes the eastern DRC Ebola outbreak remains uncontrolled with infections and deaths rising rapidly. Government data: since May 15, more than 11,000 infections and over 5,500 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、コンゴ(DRC)のエボラ流行地域で激化する戦闘の影響について警告
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部イツリ州のエボラ流行は5月以降11,000人以上の感染・5,500人以上の死亡という深刻な規模に達しており、加えて武力衝突により対応活動が妨げられWHO事務局長が公に警告するなど、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的関心の高まりが確認されるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 武力紛争によりエボラ対応活動（医療従事者の避難、病院の保護等）が妨げられている点が特に懸念される。死亡者数・感染者数の規模が非常に大きく、制御不能な状態が継続している。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H9N2

article.articleHeadline: Novel Avian Influenza Reassortant Virus Discovered in Chinese Poultry
article.articleSummary: Novel avian influenza NL04 (A/chicken/Henan/NL04/2025), a low-pathogenic H6N2 reassortant, was detected December 2025 in a 54-week-old commercial layer flock in Shangqiu, Henan Province, China, with 15% cumulative mortality and severe respiratory signs. Affected birds exhibited fever, lethargy, reduced feed intake, neck extension during respiration, and death within 3–4 days. Postmortems showed severe bronchial obstruction by long white exudative plugs and yolk sac peritonitis exceeding typical LPAI. Whole-genome sequencing revealed a two-lineage mosaic: HA from waterfowl-origin H6 Eurasian group I (ST339-like, 96.59% identity) and NA from H9N2 poultry lineage (Y280-like, 99.37% identity); all six internal genes from chicken-adapted H9N2 G57, with 96.38–99.12% identities. HA cleavage PQIETR↓G confirms low pathogenicity; Q226L/G228S absent. NA stalk deletion 62–64; K368N linked to immune escape; M2 S31N confers adamantane resistance. SPF-chickens challenged at 10^6 EID50 showed 100% survival with no clinical signs over 14 days.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の養鶏場で新規な鳥インフルエンザ・リアソータントウイルスを発見
triage.triage_reason: 新規H6N2リアソータント株が家禽で発見されたが、ヒト感染事例は報告されておらず、SPFチャレンジ試験でも無症状であったため、現時点では公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いが遺伝的モザイク構造（H9N2由来遺伝子を含む）から継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は家禽における低病原性H6N2リアソータント株の遺伝学的解析を報告する科学論文ベースの内容で、ヒトへの感染事例は確認されていない。ただしH9N2由来の内部遺伝子を持つモザイク構造であり、将来的な変異・ヒト感染リスクの観点から動向を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak: Satellite data reveals massive death toll undercount in Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo's Bunia and Mongbwalu is undercounted in official tallies, as satellite imagery of Nyamurongo and Mongbwalu cemeteries shows far more graves than reported deaths. Congo has logged more than 11,500 infections and over 5,500 fatalities countrywide since the May 15 declaration. In Bunia, around 600 graves were added since April, while officials recorded fewer than 200 Ebola deaths there by July. By early November Bunia’s excess mortality exceeded 1,000, more than 50% above the official Bunia toll of 707; by September the cumulative excess deaths reached about 950, roughly double the official total. In Mongbwalu, excess deaths by August were about 25% higher than the official toll for the town and surrounding villages. WHO suggests the outbreak may be 2–4 times larger than available data; excess deaths can include indirect outbreak effects.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク：衛星データがコンゴでの死者数の大幅な過小計上を明らかに
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ東部で進行中の大規模エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（感染11,500人超、死者5,500人超）であり、衛星画像分析により公式統計が大幅に過小評価されている可能性が指摘されている。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: WHOは実際の規模が公式データの2〜4倍に達する可能性を示唆しており、過小計上の実態把握と対応強化のためフルリスク評価が必要と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: O alerta do sarampo nos EUA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The measles alert in the United States
article.articleSummary: Measles alert: the Pan American Health Organization confirms United States, Mexico, and Bolivia are no longer considered measles-free after >12 months of transmission. The United States alone records more than 5,000 confirmed cases this year with deaths; the Americas total exceeds 58,000 cases and 82 deaths in 2026. The region, which had eliminated measles and regained status in 2024, faces a setback that underscores the need for sustained vaccination above 95%. Brazil remains free of endemic measles circulation, but risk persists: 70 confirmed cases in 2026, all imported or linked to importations, with clusters in São Paulo, Amazonas, Rio de Janeiro, and Acre. Bolivia loses the status. Year-end travel season raises reintroduction risk as Brazilians travel to the United States and Mexico and foreigners arrive. Vaccination, surveillance, and combating misinformation are emphasized; a free triple MMR vaccine is available through SUS, with calls to reach 95% coverage at the municipal level.

triage.headline_ja: 米国における麻疹警報
triage.triage_reason: 米州で麻疹排除状況が失われ（米国・メキシコ・ボリビア）、域内で5万件超・82人死亡という深刻な拡大が確認されており、ブラジルにも輸入例によるクラスターが発生し再導入リスクが高いため。
triage.notes: 記事は主に米国・メキシコ・ボリビアでの麻疹排除状況喪失を扱うオピニオン記事だが、ブラジルでは2026年に70件の輸入関連症例（サンパウロ、アマゾナス、リオデジャネイロ、アクレ）が確認されており、年末の渡航シーズンによる再導入リスクが強調されている。対象国以外（米国・メキシコ・ボリビア）は除外。

article.articleHeadline: Kanchipuram | பெண் மரணம்.. ஒரே தெருவில் 10க்கும் மேற்பட்டோருக்கு பாதிப்பு - கதிகலங்கவிடும் காய்ச்சல்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kanchipuram | Woman dies... More than 10 people on the same street affected — a staggering fever.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak reported in Kanchipuram district, Tamil Nadu, near Sriperumbudur. A young woman, Saritha, from Koozhaangalcheri village on Muthalammam Street, died in a private hospital after contracting dengue fever. In the same street, more than 10 residents are affected and receiving treatment. The cluster appears to be a localized transmission on a single street, with residents alleging no medical camps have been conducted. Public calls demand immediate medical camps, intensified mosquito control and disease prevention measures to curb further spread. The report highlights an urgent need for swift public health response, surveillance, and community engagement to halt dengue transmission and prevent additional fatalities as of 23 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: カーンチープラム | 女性死亡…同じ通りで10人以上が感染 — 蔓延する発熱
triage.triage_reason: タミル・ナードゥ州の単一街区での局地的デング熱クラスター（死亡1名、感染10人超）であり、風土病的性質が強く国際的インパクトは低いが、媒介蚊対策の不備や住民の懸念が報告されており続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 単一街区における局地的デング熱クラスターであり、インドでは季節性・風土病的に頻発する疾患。地元住民が医療キャンプ実施や蚊対策強化を要求しているが、全国的・国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。続報（感染者数拡大、州政府の対応状況）を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Araştırma: Wolbachia bakterili sivrisinekler, sivrisinek kaynaklı hastalıkları yüzde 69 azaltıyor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Study: Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes reduce mosquito-borne diseases by 69%.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian study involving over 5,700 children shows Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes reduce dengue fever and chikungunya infections by about 69% in neighborhoods where such mosquitoes are released, compared with similar areas without Wolbachia. The effect was observed among school-age children and persisted through Brazil's dengue peak in 2024. Wolbachia is a widespread bacterium in insects (roughly 50-60%), but Aedes aegypti mosquitoes, the primary dengue and chikungunya vectors, do not naturally harbor Wolbachia. Researchers, including Dr. David Hamer of Boston University, call the findings exciting and suggest integrating Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes with existing control measures could further curb transmission. Separately, Florida reports dengue outbreaks rising to over 650 cases, potentially the largest in the state since the 1940s, as the study appears amid the surge.

triage.headline_ja: 研究：ウォルバキア菌感染蚊が蚊媒介性疾患を69%減少させる
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジルでの研究結果を報じる科学ニュースであり、新規の公衆衛生緊急事態や異常な流行を報告するものではないため、トリアージ対象の感染症イベントには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱・チクングニア熱対策としてのウォルバキア菌感染蚊の効果に関する研究報告が主題。フロリダ州のデング熱流行拡大にも言及されているが、米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブラジルは研究実施地として主題に含まれるため記載。

article.articleHeadline: Dulu Cuma Saat Hujan, Kini DBD Mengintai Sepanjang Tahun Akibat Perubahan Iklim
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Used to be only during the rainy season, now dengue fever looms year-round due to climate change.
article.articleSummary: Year-round dengue risk in Indonesia as climate change expands Aedes aegypti breeding; Jakarta and nationwide. In 2025 Indonesia recorded >161,000 dengue cases; by October 2026, 98,946 cases and 265 deaths across 467 regencies/cities. Indonesia ranks second globally in dengue burden after Brazil and is the highest in Southeast Asia. Warmer temperatures accelerate mosquito life cycle and virus replication; La Niña raises rainfall creating more larval habitats; hot spells drive people to store water in open containers, sustaining transmission. Preventive measures emphasized: strict 3M plus—drain and scrub water-holding containers weekly, cover water storage, and reuse discarded containers to avoid standing water; home protection with insect repellent, screens, and mosquito-repellent plants. Support for innovations (Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes) and early-warning weather monitoring by BMKG; vaccination programs for dengue exist but are limited to certain children in some areas. Authorities call for intensified vector-control innovations beyond community action.

triage.headline_ja: 以前は雨季だけだったが、気候変動により今やデング熱は一年中流行の恐れ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおけるデング熱は既知の風土病であり、本記事は気候変動による季節性変化を解説する教育的記事。症例数・死亡者数は一定規模あるが、突発的・異常な公衆衛生事象とは言えず、継続的な流行状況として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: ブラジルはデング熱負担の国際比較（世界2位）として言及されているのみで、発生地域としての主題ではないためverified_locationsから除外。記事は気候変動とデング熱の季節性拡大に関する啓発的内容であり、年次の流行報告に近い性質を持つ。

article.articleHeadline: Pediatric Chikungunya Encephalitis Cases Documented in Northern Thailand
article.articleSummary: Two pediatric cases of chikungunya-associated encephalitis were documented in northern Thailand’s Chiang Mai Province during seasonal outbreaks. Case 1 involved a term neonate with vertical transmission from a mother who exhibited fever, rash, and arthralgia near delivery. On day 5 of life the infant developed high fever and edema; CSF showed pleocytosis (44 cells/mm³: 39% neutrophils, 61% lymphocytes) and elevated protein (147 mg/dL) with normal glucose; chikungunya RNA was detected by RT-PCR in serum and CSF, while dengue, Zika, and bacterial tests were negative. The neonate had neonatal jaundice requiring phototherapy and a 28-day hospitalization for pneumonia, followed by normal neurological development at 6 and 12 months. Case 2 was an 11-year-old from Hang Dong District, a community-acquired infection presenting with fever, rapid encephalopathy, conjunctival injection, and a morbilliform rash without arthritis; labs showed leukocytosis (13,100/µL) and systemic inflammation. Both recovered fully with supportive care. In 2025, Chiang Mai province reported 484 chikungunya cases (30/100k), with Hang Dong District accounting for 319 cases across two outbreaks and a local incidence of 346/100k.

triage.headline_ja: タイ北部で小児のチクングニア熱関連脳炎症例が報告される
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱による小児脳炎という稀な臨床像の症例報告であり、既存の季節性流行データも含むが、社会的関心や緊急の国際的対応の必要性を示す情報がなく、続報の注視が適切と判断した。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術的な症例報告（2例）であり、2025年のチェンマイ県における季節性チクングニア流行（484例）の文脈で報告されている。両症例とも支持療法で完全回復しており、現時点で深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威や国際的拡大の兆候は確認されない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO warns fighting in eastern Congo is disrupting Ebola response
article.articleSummary: Fighting in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo around a hospital in Ituri province is disrupting the Ebola response, with health workers sheltering in the hospital's maternity ward for about 24 hours. Ongoing clashes since Saturday have hampered hospital operations and the wider outbreak response, risking patients, families and medical staff. The current Ebola outbreak in the DRC has claimed around 5,700 lives. Access for humanitarian teams remains restricted due to armed clashes, especially in Ituri. WHO has called for peace to protect civilians and to allow health workers to continue life-saving operations and to contain the outbreak. These disruptions jeopardize ongoing containment efforts and patient care.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、東コンゴでの戦闘がエボラ対応を妨害していると警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行対応が武力衝突により妨害されており、公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 既存のエボラ流行（死者約5,700人）が武力紛争により対応が阻害されているという継続事案。WHOが人道支援アクセス確保を要請している。

article.articleHeadline: 'Vamos ter circulação do sarampo por muitos anos, os países precisam estar sempre em alerta', diz brasileira que participa de comissão da Opas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: We will have measles circulating for many years; countries must always be on alert, says a Brazilian who sits on a PAHO commission.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks persist in the Americas and globally, prompting PAHO to remove the disease-elimination certificates from the United States, Mexico, and Bolivia after 12 months of sustained transmission of the same measles genotype and lineage. The United States reports nearly 6,000 cases this year, a record since 1991. Brazilian virologist Marilda Siqueira (IOC/Fiocruz)—the sole Brazilian on PAHO’s Commission for Monitoring and Verification of Measles and Rubella Elimination—says the accumulation of susceptible individuals following waning vaccination coverage underpins the setback. The regional process evaluates reports from 47 countries on surveillance, vaccination, and molecular epidemiology; loss of status requires 12 months of continuous transmission with the same genotype. Canada lost last year; Guatemala and Peru are in critical condition. Global outbreaks span Africa, Europe, and Asia, with travel accelerating spread. Brazil has kept its certificate (elimination status in 2016, lost 2019, recovered 2024). Reaching elimination again requires high two-dose vaccine coverage, rapid 48-hour outbreak response, and cross-border collaboration, including Brazil–Bolivia efforts, ahead of holidays.

triage.headline_ja: 「麻疹の流行は今後何年も続くだろう。各国は常に警戒が必要だ」—PAHO委員会に参加するブラジル人研究者が語る
triage.triage_reason: 米州における麻疹排除認定の喪失（米国・メキシコ・ボリビア）と記録的な症例数増加が報告されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は主に米国・メキシコ・ボリビア・カナダ・グアテマラ・ペルーにおける麻疹排除認定喪失を扱っており、ブラジルは排除認定を維持している国として言及されるのみで、現在進行中の流行発生国ではないため対象国リストには含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية": القتال قرب منطقة تفشي "إيبولا" في الكونغو يعرقل جهود الاستجابة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Fighting near the Ebola outbreak area in the Congo hampers the response efforts
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says intense fighting near Ebola outbreak facilities in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is hampering outbreak response, forcing health workers and aid partners to shelter in a maternity ward for more than 24 hours. Clashes near the area where Ebola was first detected have exposed patients, families, and health staff to substantial risk. Attacks across eastern Congo have risen since late October, dangerously obstructing the response. WHO is coordinating with humanitarian partners to secure a safe exit for staff trapped at the facility and has urged protection of hospital workers, patients, and health facilities. The Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC remains out of control six months after first declaration, with over 11,000 cases and more than 5,500 deaths since May 15.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）：コンゴのエボラ出血熱発生地域付近での戦闘が対応活動を妨げている
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは5月15日以降11,000例超・死者5,500人超と深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、武力紛争により対応が阻害され制御不能な状況が続いているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が直接言及する重大事案。紛争により医療従事者・患者が24時間以上避難を強いられるなど、対応能力に深刻な支障が生じている。死者数・症例数から見て既にアウトブレイクが制御不能な段階にあり、継続的な国際支援が必要と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: 2025'te 57 ülkede büyük kızamık salgınları oldu, ABD arınmış ülke statüsünü kaybetti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There were major measles outbreaks in 57 countries in 2025, and the United States lost its measles elimination status.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks surged globally in 2025, with 57 countries experiencing major epidemics, including India, Pakistan, Indonesia, Ukraine, Nigeria, and Ethiopia. The United States lost its measles elimination status after more than 25 years. First-dose measles vaccination coverage fell from 86% in 2019 to 84% in 2025, far below the 95% herd-immunity target. Vaccine hesitancy and online misinformation are linked to lower uptake. WHO estimates vaccines prevent about 3.5–5 million deaths annually from diseases such as measles, tetanus, diphtheria, and influenza. The article emphasizes vaccines’ safety and effectiveness, explains how the MMR vaccine uses attenuated viruses, and outlines the rigorous testing process, including accelerated pathways seen during the COVID-19 pandemic.

triage.headline_ja: 2025年に57カ国で麻疹の大規模流行が発生し、米国は麻疹排除状態を失った
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹が57カ国で大規模流行し、米国が25年以上維持していた排除状態を喪失するなど、国際的拡大と異常事態の両基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事は世界的な麻疹流行動向に関する概況報道であり、個別国の詳細な症例数・対応状況は記載されていない。インドとインドネシアは対象国リストに含まれるため記載したが、具体的な現地状況は不明。米国・パキスタン・ウクライナ・ナイジェリア・エチオピアは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: ΠΟΥ: Έκκληση για ειρήνη σε περιοχές της ΛΔ του Κονγκό που έχουν πληγεί από τον Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Appeal for peace in areas of the Democratic Republic of the Congo affected by Ebola.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus appealed for peace in Ebola-affected areas of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where security in the eastern regions, notably Ituri and North Kivu, has deteriorated, hampering access and outbreak response. The Ebola epidemic has caused thousands of deaths—5,678 fatalities among 11,613 confirmed cases—making it the worst outbreak in the DRC’s history. Ongoing violence has disrupted health operations, with reports of medical staff sheltering for over 24 hours in a maternity ward, severely affecting hospital function and patient care. Despite a reported slight regional decline in cases, transmission remains high and the outbreak is still a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The appeal emphasizes protecting health workers, patients, and communities, and calls for safety, unhindered humanitarian access, vaccination, clean water, and reliable information to contain Ebola."

triage.headline_ja: WHO:エボラの影響を受けたコンゴ民主共和国の地域における平和への訴え
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪規模のエボラ流行でPHEIC指定中であり、致死者5,678人・症例11,613件という深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的関心の高さからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当。
triage.notes: 既にPHEIC指定済みの継続事案。治安悪化により対応が妨げられている点が新規情報として重要。

article.articleHeadline: Sud-Kivu : près de 600 cas de choléra, dont 7 décès, notifiés en une semaine (DPS)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Kivu: nearly 600 cholera cases, including 7 deaths, notified in one week (DPS).
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in South Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo. In week 46 of 2026, the provincial health division (DPS) reported 584 cases and 7 deaths, up from the prior week, with data through 21 November 2026. Uvira led with 64 cases, followed by Bunyakiri (59), Kalehe (55), Fizi (54) and Ibanda (45). Deaths occurred in Mwana (2) and one each in Shabunda, Uvira, Kitutu, Kamituga, and Kimbi-Lulenge. Since January 2026, South Kivu has 18,942 suspected cholera cases and 325 deaths across 31 of 34 health zones. Contributing factors include limited potable water access, river sources and unregulated water, population movements, crowded displacement sites, and open defecation. Response challenges: stockouts of medical supplies, insufficient community transmission interventions, under-motivated staff, and few chlorination sites. Recommendations: strengthen supplies, improve household safe water, and support high-priority zones with contingency plans.

triage.headline_ja: 南キブ州：1週間でコレラ約600症例、7人死亡と通知（DPS）
triage.triage_reason: 南キブ州で1週間に584症例・7人死亡、年初来18,942症例・325人死亡という大規模かつ継続中のコレラ流行であり、感染拡大要因（水アクセス不足、人口移動、避難所の過密）と対応上の課題（医療物資不足等）が確認されるため、フルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 発生地域にFijiが含まれているが記事内容と無関係であり除外した。本件はDRC南キブ州における長期化したコレラ流行で、水・衛生インフラの問題と人口移動が主要因とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch tả lợn Châu Phi diễn biến phức tạp tại xã Tứ Mỹ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African swine fever outbreak shows complex developments in Tu My commune
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) outbreak continues in Tu My commune, Ha Tinh Province, Vietnam, with a new cluster detected on 20 November. Since early October, ASF has affected the Son My and Long Thuong hamlets; as of 20 November, authorities have culled 55 pigs (2,828 kg) across Tu My. A new cull of 34 pigs from three households in Son My and Long Thuong occurred on 20 November, with the largest loss being 19 pigs (457 kg) from the household of Lương Thị Thanh Hà in Son My. In Son Ha hamlet, pig deaths of unknown origin have prompted sampling sent to provincial laboratories for confirmation. While awaiting results, local authorities have intensified surveillance, promoted hygiene and farm disinfection, and warned against concealing cases or moving diseased pigs. Sanitation efforts include 3,500 kg of lime and 200 L of chemicals.

triage.headline_ja: トゥーミー村でアフリカ豚コレラ（ASF）の流行が複雑化
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（ASF）であり人の健康への直接影響はなく、既知の地域流行病で公衆衛生上の国際的懸念基準には該当しない。
triage.notes: ASFは豚のみに影響する動物疾病であり、ヒトへの感染性はないため公衆衛生上のシグナルとしては優先度が低い。地方当局による対応（殺処分、消毒、監視強化）が行われている。

article.articleHeadline: 民主剛果對抗伊波拉疫情受阻　世衛秘書長籲恢復和平
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo's fight against the Ebola outbreak has been hindered; WHO Director-General urges the restoration of peace.
article.articleSummary: While the Democratic Republic of Congo battles Ebola, the outbreak has killed over 5,700 people since May. Strikes and clashes in Ituri and North Kivu since late October severely hinder response efforts. A hospital near Ituri's epicenter came under sustained fire, with staff sheltering in the obstetrics ward for more than 24 hours, disrupting operations and risking patients and health workers. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged peace and sought safe evacuation of medical teams, stressing protection for hospital facilities, staff, and patients. The 21 November 2026 update notes some regional case counts dip, but overall transmission remains high. Ituri and North Kivu remain hardest hit, and the outbreak remains a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC).

triage.headline_ja: 民主剛果のエボラ対策が阻害される　世界保健機関事務局長が和平回復を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がPHEICとして継続中で死者5,700人超、武力衝突により対応が阻害されるなど公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的懸念事項であり、IHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOにより既にPHEIC宣言済みの継続事案。紛争による医療アクセス阻害が新たなリスク要因として報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Over 10.000 smittet: Norge sender 18,3 millioner
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 10,000 infected: Norway sends 18.3 million.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has infected over 10,000 people and killed more than 5,000 since it began in May, with Ituri and North Kivu being the hardest-hit provinces. Norway will provide 18.3 million NOK to UNICEF to strengthen health and education systems in these provinces. Funds will support health care for children and mothers, vaccination programs, and relief for health workers, as well as improved sanitation in primary schools, information campaigns, and preventive infection control to protect children and minimize disruption to schooling and transmission. Development Minister Åsmund Aukrust described the outbreak as serious and emphasized global health security and international cooperation; he spoke at an African health summit in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. Norway has also pledged 1 billion NOK to CEPI to support vaccine development, including this Ebola variant.

triage.headline_ja: 1万人超が感染：ノルウェーが1830万クローネを送る
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が1万人以上感染・5000人以上死亡という大規模アウトブレイクであり、国際的な支援（ノルウェー、UNICEF、CEPI）が動いていることから深刻な公衆衛生イベントと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はノルウェーの資金拠出に関するものだが、主題となる感染症イベントはコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州・北キブ州）でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク。エチオピアは開発大臣の講演地であり発生地ではないため除外。CEPIによる「このエボラ変異株」への言及があり、新変異株の可能性にも留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Bocah di Pinrang Digigit Anjing saat Melintas, Luka di Lengan Berisiko Rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Child in Pinrang Bitten by Dog While Crossing, Arm Wound at Risk of Rabies.
article.articleSummary: Rabies risk in Pinrang, South Sulawesi, Indonesia, after a 10-year-old boy (initials FW) was bitten by a pet dog on his arm in Mangki Village, Cempa District, Pinrang, on 21 November 2026. As of 23 November 2026, the bite is categorized as high-risk exposure, and the boy received the Anti-Rabies Vaccine (VAR) at a nearby Puskesmas. The dog, a household pet, reportedly attacked when disturbed while eating. The incident is recorded in the integrated rabies surveillance system, with real-time updates via a dedicated WhatsApp group; the latest report date cited is 21 November. No laboratory confirmation is reported, and there is no mention of deaths or a wider outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ピンラン県の少年、通行中に犬に噛まれる 腕の傷は狂犬病のリスクあり
triage.triage_reason: 単発の犬咬傷事例であり、適切に曝露後ワクチン接種が行われている。広域的な流行や異常な事態を示す情報はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 地元メディアによる単発の犬咬傷・狂犬病リスク報告。被害者は曝露後ワクチン接種済みで、死亡例や集団発生の報告はない。インドネシアでは狂犬病が地方流行しているが、本記事は個別症例の報告でありシグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 'Com El Niño, há imprevisibilidade para a dengue no ano que vem', diz Jarbas Barbosa, diretor da Opas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'With El Niño, there is unpredictability for dengue next year,' says Jarbas Barbosa, director of PAHO.
article.articleSummary: El Niño creates unpredictability for dengue in the Americas next year, warns PAHO Director Jarbas Barbosa, after 2024’s record 13 million dengue cases and estimates that unreported infections could push regional totals above 100 million, though mortality remains low. The goal is to equip health systems to prevent most dengue deaths. The Butantan dengue vaccine’s approval is suspended pending safety investigations; Takeda’s vaccine is available through PAHO’s Revolving Fund in a two-dose schedule. On HIV, PAHO secured a Gilead deal to supply lenacapavir—a six-month pre-exposure prophylaxis—through the Revolving Fund to 14 regional countries, including Brazil, with rollout hoped for 2027 and aims to reach over 1.1 million users despite generic production delays. Mpox has surpassed 1,000 cases in Brazil; a regional genomic surveillance network covers 30 American countries, aiding vaccination access. Ebola remains a regional African crisis; transmission requires direct contact with blood or secretions, and clinical trials for vaccines are ongoing, with no widely available treatment yet.

triage.headline_ja: 「エルニーニョにより来年のデング熱は予測不可能」とPAHO局長ジャルバス・バルボーザ氏が発言
triage.triage_reason: PAHO局長による地域保健政策の総括的インタビュー記事であり、特定の新規アウトブレイクや緊急事態を報じるものではなく、既存の継続的状況（デング熱の季節性、HIV薬剤提供計画、Mpox累計症例、エボラの一般的注意喚起）の紹介にとどまる。
triage.notes: 記事はPAHO（汎米保健機構）局長による地域全体（南北アメリカ）の保健政策レビューであり、デング熱・HIV・Mpox・エボラについて個別の新規発生イベントではなく既存の継続的傾向や政策対応を解説している。ブラジルにおけるMpox症例数（1000例超）は言及されているが詳細（増加率・重症度等）は不明であり、新規シグナルとしての緊急性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: 47 vs 0: Dengue death data exposes surveillance gap in Telangana
article.articleSummary: Telangana recorded 10,077 dengue cases in 2024 with zero deaths per NCVBDC, but death certificates listing dengue as cause totalled 47 per the Registrar General's MCCD, revealing a surveillance gap. From 2021–2025, Telangana logged 46,612 cases, including over 8,000 in 2025, with more than 4,000 cases reported between April and August 2025. Nationally, the MCCD reported 2,340 medically certified dengue deaths in 2024, compared with 297 in NCVBDC, a discrepancy of about 688%. Hyderabad doctors report rising cases this year despite weaker rainfall; fatalities continue. Notable Telangana deaths cited: a four-year-old with acute liver failure, a 60-year-old patient, and a college student. Private-clinic testing and underreporting to vector surveillance contribute to gaps; authorities will review MCCD figures, verify deaths via verbal autopsies, and ensure correct district entries, with prognosis ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: 47対0:デング熱死亡データがテランガナ州のサーベイランス格差を露呈
triage.triage_reason: テランガナ州における毎年の季節性デング熱流行であり新規性・国際的拡大リスクは低いが、公式統計間の死亡者数の大きな乖離（サーベイランスギャップ）が指摘されており、当局の検証結果など続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・テランガナ州における既存のサーベイランス制度（NCVBDCとMCCDの死亡者数報告）の乖離を扱ったもので、新規の異常発生事象ではない。国家レベルでも同様の報告格差（2,340 vs 297）が指摘されており、当局によるレビュー・検証作業が進行中。続報次第でPICKUPへの格上げを検討。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Nội ghi nhận hơn 500 ca mắc sốt xuất huyết trong tuần từ 13/11 đến 20/11
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hanoi reports more than 500 dengue fever cases in the week from November 13 to November 20.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever dominates Hanoi's week: 506 cases reported from Nov 13–20 across 92 wards/communes, including Phuc Tho, Tu Liem, Hong Vân, Dân Hòa, Đại Mỗ, and Thanh Oai; no dengue deaths reported. Cumulative dengue cases in 2026 reach 7,532 across 122 wards/communes, with 285 outbreaks overall and 19 active outbreaks. The week also records 6 new dengue outbreaks in Gia Lâm, Nội Bài, Phúc Lộc, Phúc Thịnh, Thường Tín and Từ Liêm. Hand, foot, mouth disease adds 66 cases in 42 wards; cumulative 6,910 with zero deaths and no current outbreaks; 105 outbreaks in 2026 have ended. One pertussis case was reported in Hòa Xá; cumulative 133 cases in 66 wards. Two tetanus cases in Hoàng Liệt and Tam Hưng; cumulative 18 with 1 death. Hanoi CDC continues surveillance, targeted outbreak investigations, and vector-control measures including environmental sanitation and mosquito fumigation; vaccination advocacy and cross-sector collaboration are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイ、11月13日から20日の週にデング熱500例以上を記録
triage.triage_reason: ハノイの地方病であるデング熱の定期サーベイランス報告であり、死亡者なし、季節性の既知流行パターンの範囲内で特段の異常性や社会的関心の高まりは見られない。
triage.notes: ハノイCDCによる定期的な感染症週報であり、デング熱は累計7,532例・死亡0件、百日咳・破traffic・手足口病も通常のサーベイランス範囲内。ルーチン業務としての監視・媒介動物対策が継続されている。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkab perkuat deteksi dini guna cegah wabah penyakit di Kolut
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Regency Government Strengthens Early Detection to Prevent Disease Outbreaks in Kolut.
article.articleSummary: Kolaka Utara Regency in Southeast Sulawesi, Indonesia, is boosting early disease detection, screening, and outbreak readiness to prevent KLBs and epidemics. Secretary Idrus emphasizes preventive-focused health services, with rising-case signals verified and acted on within 24 hours, and expands the SPM program to cover early detection of hypertension and diabetes, TB case finding and treatment, and prevention/management of communicable diseases. The plan also targets non-communicable diseases (hypertension and diabetes) to reduce risks of heart disease, stroke, cancer, and kidney failure. Puskesmas are urged to widen risk-factor screening through outreach, optimize Posyandu Lifecycles, and conduct routine checks for productive-age and elderly groups. Realizing success requires cross-sector collaboration among health facilities, camats, village heads and lurahs, PKK, health cadres, and community leaders to produce concrete, measurable follow-up actions.

triage.headline_ja: 県政府、クトゥ県での疾病流行防止に向け早期探知を強化
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、地方自治体による疾病予防・早期探知体制強化に関する一般的な行政施策の記事であり、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核・非感染性疾患を含む一般的な公衆衛生サービス強化策を報じたものであり、具体的なアウトブレイク事例の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 科学网-研究发现疟蚊耐热的机制
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ScienceNet - Study Finds the Mechanism of Heat Tolerance in Anopheles Mosquitoes
article.articleSummary: Anopheles stephensi, a primary urban malaria vector, shows a natural deletion in the core clock gene timeless (tim), named tim5kb, which is enriched in heat-adapted mosquitoes. In a three-year laboratory selection at 32°C day/30°C night, tim5kb frequency rose from 2.08% in a normal-temperature population to 28.65% in the heat-adapted cohort. Heterozygous tim5kb males exhibit increased mating competitiveness and flight under high temperature, while heterozygous females display higher susceptibility to infection by the malaria parasite. The study, published in Cell, links natural variation in tim to heat tolerance and malaria transmission potential via sex-specific mechanisms that connect circadian regulation, energy metabolism, mating signals, and anti-malarial immunity. These findings inform genetic surveillance, malaria risk assessment, and targeted control strategies for urban Anopheles stephensi under climate change, with implications for China and global malaria prevention efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 科学网-研究发现疟蚊耐热的机制（研究によりハマダラカの耐熱メカニズムが判明）
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生事例ではなく、マラリア媒介蚊の耐熱性メカニズムに関する基礎研究論文の紹介記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や流行事例を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術研究（Cell誌掲載）の紹介であり、実際のマラリア発生・流行事例を報告するものではない。気候変動下での都市型マラリア媒介蚊の遺伝的サーベイランスに関する知見であり、将来的なリスク評価の参考情報として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: 【闪电大视野】主播说丨得了甲流还可能得乙流！今年流感季三毒株同时活跃，专家提醒可能反复感染
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [Lightning Wide Field] Host Says: You can get H1N1 flu and still get influenza B! This year's flu season has three strains circulating at the same time, and experts warn that reinfection is possible.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-23, China CDC monitoring shows three circulating influenza strains—Influenza A(H1N1), Influenza A(H3N2), and Influenza B Victoria lineage—coexisting with shifting proportions. The season features rapid switches in the dominant strain, complicating prevention efforts. This co-circulation raises the risk of sequential infections within the same flu season. Doctors warn that infection with H1N1 can be followed by Influenza B infection; likewise, after H3N2 infection, protection against H1N1 appears weak, making reinfection possible. The findings underscore the complexity of the current flu season in China and the ongoing challenge of managing multiple circulating strains.

triage.headline_ja: 【ライトニングワイドビュー】キャスター解説：甲型インフルエンザに罹患後も乙型インフルエンザに感染する可能性あり！今年のインフルエンザシーズンは3種のウイルス株が同時に流行、専門家は再感染の可能性を警告
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの複数株同時流行に関する一般的な公衆衛生啓発報道であり、通常の季節性流行の範囲内で異常性・重大性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)、A(H3N2)、B型（Victoria系統）の同時流行に関する国内メディアの解説報道。新規変異株や重症化急増の報告はなく、通常の季節性サーベイランス情報の範囲。

article.articleHeadline: 国家疾控局等印发医防协同高效推动医疗机构传染病防控工作指导意见
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National Center for Disease Control and Prevention and Others Issue Guidance to Accelerate Infectious Disease Prevention and Control in Medical Institutions Through Medical–Public Health Collaboration.
article.articleSummary: On 23 November 2026, the National Center for Disease Control and Prevention (China CDC), the National Health Commission, and the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine jointly issued guidelines to accelerate infectious disease prevention and control in medical institutions through medical-public health collaboration. The guidance calls for strengthened monitoring coordination, establishing cross-departmental, cross-institutional intelligent, multi-point triggered surveillance and information-sharing mechanisms, and robust monitoring of emerging infectious diseases, outbreaks of unknown origin, and mutations in key pathogens, with open information-sharing and timely reporting channels. Medical institutions should implement infectious disease surveillance tasks, standardize reporting of infectious disease information, and monitor clinical syndromes, gradually achieving multi-disease simultaneous surveillance to improve early detection and reporting. It emphasizes leveraging big data and artificial intelligence to share information promptly, streamline data flows, and enhance the overall quality of surveillance reporting.

triage.headline_ja: 国家疾控局等、医療機関における感染症予防管理を医療・公衆衛生協同で効率的に推進する指導意見を発布
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症イベントではなく、中国政府による感染症サーベイランス体制強化に関する政策・行政指導の発表であり、具体的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、政策文書・行政指導の発表を報じるものであり、トリアージ対象としての感染症シグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Vilhena Lança Ação de Combate às Arboviroses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vilhena City Hall Launches Campaign to Combat Arboviral Diseases
article.articleSummary: Vilhena City Hall kicked off an interinstitutional campaign to combat arboviral diseases on November 9, led by the Municipal Health Secretariat (Semus). The week-long initiative, running through November 13, mobilizes municipal and state teams to prevent and control arboviruses transmitted by Aedes aegypti, notably dengue, chikungunya, and Zika. Activities include capacity-building sessions, community awareness campaigns, neighborhood visits, educational talks, and distribution of informational materials. The effort underscores intergovernmental collaboration as essential to increasing effectiveness in vector control. Residents are urged to participate by eliminating standing water and other mosquito breeding sites. The city government aims to reduce arboviral disease indicators and promote public health and well-being. Further details and guidance are available from Semus.

triage.headline_ja: ヴィリェーナ市役所、アルボウイルス感染症対策キャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: 通常の蚊媒介感染症対策の予防キャンペーンに関する報道であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防キャンペーンの告知であり、具体的な症例数や流行状況の記載がない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、イベントとしての異常性がないため地域検証では除外（通常の公衆衛生活動のため）。

article.articleHeadline: Study Profiles Pediatric Scrub Typhus Linked to Severe Immune Disorder in
article.articleSummary: At a single center in Fujian, China, 33 children (median age 3 years; range 2 months–16 years) with scrub typhus were analyzed; 12 met HLH-2004 criteria for hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis. Scrub typhus was confirmed by IgM ELISA, indirect immunofluorescent antibody testing, or metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS). Among HLH cases, 100% had fever; 41.7% had rash or diagnostic eschars. Hyperferritinemia occurred in all 12, and liver involvement with elevated transaminases was seen in 91.7%. mNGS established diagnosis in 8/12 (66.7%). All HLH patients received doxycycline; systemic corticosteroids were given to 9, ruxolitinib to 6, and etoposide to 2. In univariable analysis, hepatic injury (Firth OR 18.41; 95% CI 2.08–162.92) and fever >10 days before diagnosis (OR 9.01; 95% CI 1.22–66.46) surfaced as putative associations, though timing and small sample limit interpretation. Scrub typhus remains an emerging East Asian infection with potential pediatric HLH.

triage.headline_ja: 中国における小児ツツガムシ病と重症免疫異常(HLH)の関連性に関する研究プロファイル
triage.triage_reason: 単一施設での小児ツツガムシ病とHLH合併に関する臨床研究報告であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: ツツガムシ病は地域的な風土病であり、本記事は臨床研究（HLH合併例の解析）であって、感染拡大や新規アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Собираетесь во Вьетнам? Популярный курорт накрыла вспышка опасной лихорадки
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Are you planning to visit Vietnam? A popular resort has been hit by an outbreak of a dangerous fever.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak in Da Nang, Vietnam, with >12,500 cases this year and 2,219 new cases (Nov 16–22) — a 15% weekly rise. Ngũ Hành Sơn district has 1,363 cases this year (230 in the last week); An Khe 150, Dien Ban Dong 149, and Son Tra 128 also reported cases. The city registered 796 outbreak clusters year-to-date, about five times higher than last year. Authorities deployed 554 mosquito-surveillance points, 85 at elevated risk, but control efforts are constrained by shortages of resources and medical staff, and incomplete larval destruction by residents. Kazakhstan’s Ministry of Health notes its climate does not support dengue vectors, so domestic risk is absent. Travelers to tropical regions should stay in air-conditioned hotels with window screens, wear long-sleeved clothing, cover children, use insect repellent (over sunscreen), and seek medical care after returning if fever, headache, body pains, or rash, informing doctors of travel to Vietnam.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナム旅行を予定していますか？人気リゾート地でデング熱が流行
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ダナンでデング熱の流行クラスターが前年比約5倍に急増しており、医療資源・人員不足も指摘されているため、WPRO基準複数該当・社会的関心もあることからフルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: カザフスタンは気候的にデング熱媒介蚊が生息しないため国内リスクなしと明記されており、発生地域には含めない。記事の主題はベトナム・ダナン市におけるデング熱流行拡大と渡航者への注意喚起。
