article.articleHeadline: Major eye-bleeding virus warning as more than 5,600 people killed in 68 places
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD), a form of Ebola virus disease, drives an ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. As of 23 November 2026, WHO reports 11,613 confirmed cases and 5,678 deaths (case fatality rate 48.9% last month). Since 28 October 2026, 720 deaths have occurred (452 in communities, 268 in treatment centres). Ituri and Nord Kivu are the hardest-hit provinces; Sud-Kivu and Sud Ubangi have had no cases for over 42 days. The outbreak began in May and became the DR Congo’s deadliest by August, described as the fastest-growing by new infections; there is no approved treatment or vaccine for this strain. The WHO cites very high risk due to ongoing transmission, community deaths, and regional spread, underscoring cross-border surveillance and preparedness. A British doctor treated in the UK earlier this month after testing positive.

triage.headline_ja: 目から出血するウイルスの重大警告、68か所で5,600人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: WHOが非常に高リスクと評価するコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）大規模流行で、死者数・致死率が高く、英国での感染例報告など国際的拡大の兆候もあるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 英国での感染確認例はあるが、発生地域としてはDRCが主題。英国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Niterói reforça vacinação contra sarampo diante de risco de reintrodução do vírus no país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Niterói strengthens measles vaccination amid risk of the virus's reintroduction in the country.
article.articleSummary: Measles risk persists in Brazil as vaccination coverage in Niterói lags for the second dose. In Niterói, 93.86% of the target population received the first dose of the trivalent measles-mumps-rubella vaccine; second-dose coverage is 76.46%, below the 95% target set by the Ministry of Health. OPAS maintains Brazil's elimination status for endemic measles; however imported cases require vigilance. Context includes measles circulation in Mexico, the United States, and Bolivia. In 2026 Brazil reported 70 confirmed measles cases, linked to importation, with São Paulo state accounting for 35 cases; Amazonas and Acre also reported cases, while there are no confirmed cases in Niterói. Health authorities stress vaccination to prevent local transmission and protect vulnerable groups, especially children, and advocate broader vaccine campaigns and accessible immunization sites. In 2026, Niterói administered 12,069 measles-containing vaccine doses; recommendations: ages 12 months–29 years should have two doses; ages 30–59 one dose; healthcare workers two doses.

triage.headline_ja: ニテロイ市、ウイルスの国内再侵入リスクを前に麻疹ワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでは麻疹の排除ステータスは維持されているが、輸入例による国内感染拡大（70例確認）とワクチン接種率の低さ（2回目接種76.46%）が継続的リスクとなっており、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル（サンパウロ州、アマゾナス州、ニテロイ市）における麻疹のワクチン接種状況と輸入例に関する内容。メキシコ・米国・ボリビアは感染状況の文脈として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれず、記事の主題でもないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Febre, ínguas e feridas na pele: conheça os sintomas da mpox e como se proteger
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fever, swollen lymph nodes and skin lesions: learn the symptoms of mpox and how to protect yourself.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox outbreak in Brazil in 2026 includes over 1,000 confirmed or probable cases, with São Paulo reporting 409 and Rio de Janeiro 404 cases as of November 17, 2026, and a death recorded in Rio de Janeiro. Bahia had 225 notifications and five confirmations in a prior tally, highlighting vigilance. The disease, caused by the monkeypox virus (Orthopoxvirus family, related to smallpox), spreads mainly through direct contact with skin lesions, bodily fluids, or contaminated objects, and via prolonged exposure to respiratory secretions. Incubation ranges from six to 13 days, up to 21 days. Common symptoms include fever, headache, fatigue, lymphadenopathy, and skin lesions that may disseminate. Most cases are mild and self-limiting; management is supportive—hydration, rest, antipyretics—under medical guidance. Severe cases, especially in immunocompromised individuals, may use antivirals such as tecovirimat. Prevention emphasizes hand hygiene, avoiding contact with lesions, and masks in affected areas; seek care for suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: 発熱、リンパ節の腫れ、皮膚病変：mpoxの症状と予防方法を知る
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで1,000例超のmpox症例と死亡例が報告されているが、記事は主に症状・予防の解説記事であり、新規性や急激な拡大を示す情報は限定的。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: mpoxはすでに既知の流行であり、本記事は主に一般向け症状・予防解説記事。死亡例と1,000例超の累積数は注視に値するが、新規アウトブレイクの急拡大を示す情報ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Espérance Kombi beschreibt die Ebola-Station in Biakato, Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Espérance Kombi describes the Ebola station in Biakato, Kongo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Biakato, Democratic Republic of Congo, has intensified according to The New York Times. Since first detected in May, the outbreak has spread to eight provinces, with Biakato at times accounting for up to a quarter of national new cases and roughly 75% of Ebola patients there dying. Health facilities are strained by insufficient resources and Islamic State attacks affecting conditions on the treatment station. Efforts to contain the virus have been focused where it first appeared, while infections rise in other areas, spreading the outbreak across a territory roughly the size of Great Britain. Dr. Jean-Jacques Muyembe, who co-identified Ebola in 1976 and now heads the National Institute for Biomedical Research in Congo, warns, 'We see the same mistakes as before. It's as if we are starting from zero. It is very disappointing.' The report notes ongoing threats from Islamic State.

triage.headline_ja: エスペランス・コンビ氏、コンゴ・ビアカトのエボラ治療施設の様子を語る
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ発生が8州に拡大し致死率約75%と深刻で、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 武装勢力（イスラム国系）の攻撃により医療活動が妨げられている点、及び資源不足により封じ込めが困難な点が特徴的。続報でWHOのリスク評価や国際対応の有無を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: കട്ടപ്പനയിൽ ഹോട്ടലിൽനിന്ന് മന്തി കഴിച്ച 37 പേർക്ക് ഭക്ഷ്യവിഷബാധ; രണ്ടുപേരുടെ നില ഗുരുതരം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Food poisoning among 37 people who ate mint from a hotel in Kattappana; two are in serious condition.
article.articleSummary: Thirty-seven people developed food poisoning after consuming a mint-based item at a hotel in Kattappana town, Idukki district, near the Civil Station, late Sunday around 11:30 p.m. They all reported abdominal pain and vomiting, with 35 admitted to Kattappana Taluk Hospital for observation and treatment. Two of the patients were in serious condition and were subsequently transferred to Idukki Medical College for specialist care. The affected group included Tirur-based students and other travelers visiting the region. Health department officials visited the hotel and conducted an inspection as part of the response. A total of 37 cases were reported, with 35 admitted.

triage.headline_ja: カッタッパナのホテルでマンディ（料理）を食べた37人が食中毒、2人が重体
triage.triage_reason: 単一施設での食中毒事例であり、感染症の国際的拡大リスクや異常性は認められない。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 食中毒（食品由来疾患の疑い）であり、感染症の伝播事例ではない。保健当局が現地調査を実施済み。

article.articleHeadline: مدير الصحة العالمية: القتال قرب مناطق تفشي إيبولا بالكونغو يعرقل جهود الاستجابة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global Health Director: Fighting near Ebola outbreak areas in the Democratic Republic of the Congo hampers the response efforts.
article.articleSummary: On 23 November 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said intense fighting near a hospital in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, hampered the Ebola response, forcing health workers and relief partners to shelter in the maternity wing for more than 24 hours. He noted clashes occurred near the area where the outbreak first emerged, exposing patients, families, and health workers to significant risk. Attacks across eastern Congo have escalated since late October, severely hindering the Ebola response. WHO is coordinating with humanitarian partners to secure a safe exit for staff trapped at the facility and urged protection for hospital staff, patients, and health facilities. He confirmed the outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo remains out of control six months after it was first declared, with case and death counts rising at a steady pace.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行地域近くでの戦闘が対応活動を妨げている
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国東部のエボラ流行は6か月経っても制御不能であり、紛争により対応が著しく妨げられていると表明しており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する深刻な公衆衛生事案である。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長の声明に基づく報道であり、紛争による対応阻害と感染拡大の継続が強調されている。続報での感染者数・死亡者数の推移、国際的な支援動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО: Борбите во ДР Конго ги попречуваат напорите за сузбивање на еболата
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Fighting in DR Congo hampers efforts to eradicate Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Violent clashes near a hospital in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, interrupted Ebola response activities as health workers and humanitarian staff sheltered in the maternity ward for more than 24 hours. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stated that attacks since late October in eastern DR Congo are severely hindering containment, putting patients, families and medical personnel at risk. WHO is coordinating with humanitarian partners to secure safe evacuation of workers trapped inside the facility and is urging protection for hospital staff, patients, and facilities. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has surpassed 11,000 confirmed cases, making it the second-largest Ebola epidemic in history after West Africa’s 2014–2016 crisis (over 28,600 infections and more than 11,000 deaths). The mid-May outbreak has no approved vaccine or effective therapy for this strain.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国での戦闘がエボラ出血熱撲滅の取り組みを妨げている
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは既に11,000人以上の確定症例を記録し史上2番目の規模に達しており、武力衝突により対応活動が妨げられ、ワクチンや有効な治療法もない深刻な公衆衛生危機である。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーはDRC（イトゥリ州）での状況のみに言及しており、Angolaでの発生は確認できないため除外した。本アウトブレイクはBundibugyoエボラウイルスによるもので既知の進行中の大規模流行であり、本記事は武力紛争による対応妨害という新たな側面を報告している。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch sốt xuất huyết Dengue diễn biến phức tạp, Đắk Lắk yêu cầu tăng cường các biện pháp phòng, chống
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever outbreak with complex developments; Dak Lak Province calls for strengthening prevention and control measures.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak in Dak Lak Province, Vietnam shows 81 active outbreaks and 13,074 cases with 3 deaths as of 20 November. The rise is driven by alternating rainy and sunny weather and abundant standing water, enabling Aedes mosquito breeding; gaps in vector-control efforts and uneven community engagement worsen transmission. Buon Ma Thuot Ward records 545 dengue cases this year (up 135 from 2025), with 506 since July 1–Nov 18; 29 outbreaks across 17 of 55 hamlets/quarters, and 2 active outbreaks in Tu An and Tan Loi, though no deaths in the ward yet. In response, the province issued Directive 34/CT-UBND to intensify prevention, promote the '4 at the spot' approach, and hold leaders accountable. Sở Y tế leads surveillance, vector-control guidance, and clinical management, ensuring supplies, staff training, outbreak investigation, and adherence to MOH treatment guidelines; inspections target high-risk areas.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の流行が複雑化、ダクラク省が予防・対策措置の強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム国内の季節性デング熱流行であり、ヒト-ヒト感染の懸念や国際的拡大リスクは低いが、症例数・死者数が多く地域的対策強化が報じられているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はベクター媒介性疾患であり、国際的な人-人感染拡大のリスクは低い。ダクラク省内での季節性流行拡大と行政対応が主な内容。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch sốt xuất huyết Hà Nội giảm, vẫn còn 19 ổ dịch hoạt động
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hanoi's dengue fever outbreak has declined, but 19 outbreaks remain active.
article.articleSummary: 506 dengue cases in Hanoi from 13-20/11/2026 across 92 wards, down 113 from the prior week; 7,532 cases this year in 122 wards, with no deaths. Nonetheless, 19 dengue outbreaks remain active, including six newly identified in Gia Lam, Noi Bai, Phuc Loc, Phuc Thinh, Thuong Tin, and Tu Liem. Surveillance covers six wards: Bach Mai, Dai Thanh, Hong Ha, Hoa Xa, Phu Cat, Tiến Thắng. Hand, foot and mouth disease records 66 cases in 42 wards (cum 6,910 this year; no deaths; all 105 outbreaks resolved). Pertussis adds 1 new case in Hoa Xa; cum 133 cases in 66 wards; no deaths. Tetanus reports 2 cases (Hoang Liet, Tam Hung); cum 18 cases in 15 wards, 1 death. Public health measures include vector control, environmental sanitation, school hygiene, vaccination, and cross-sector surveillance with veterinary partners.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイのデング熱流行は減少したが、依然として19件の流行地が活動中
triage.triage_reason: ハノイにおけるデング熱の定期的なサーベイランス報告であり、症例数は減少傾向、死亡例もなく、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 疾患名リストに『Foot And Mouth Disease』とあるが、記事内容は人の手足口病（Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease）であり、家畜の口蹄疫ではない点に注意。デング熱、手足口病、百日咳、破傷風いずれも既存の季節性・定期監視範囲内の報告。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada DBD saat musim hujan, Nyamuk justru suka genangan jernih
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be wary of dengue fever during the rainy season; mosquitoes actually prefer clear standing water.
article.articleSummary: Bandung, Indonesia — Dengue fever risk rises in the rainy season as Aedes aegypti mosquitoes prefer clean standing water over dirty surroundings. The Ministry of Health warns that such water accumulates not only outside but also inside homes in items including bathroom basins, water storage containers, ant-trap water near table legs, refrigerator drains, bird drinking cups, flower pots, and dispenser containers. Outdoors, discarded cans, old tires, bottles, coconut shells, littered plastics, damaged gutters, and poorly draining rain channels also serve as breeding sites. Mosquitoes can lay eggs in even small containers. To break transmission, the ministry promotes the 3M Plus Mosquito Nest Eradication: drain, cover, and reuse waste. Regularly drain and scrub water-holding containers, keep water storage sealed, apply larvicides where cleaning is hard, maintain fish that eat larvae, change vase water weekly, and dry plant saucers.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季のデング熱に注意、蚊はむしろ澄んだ水たまりを好む
triage.triage_reason: 季節性デング熱に関する一般的な注意喚起・予防啓発記事であり、異常な増加や重症例の報告はなく、既存の公衆衛生対策の範囲内である。
triage.notes: 記事は保健省による季節性デング熱予防の啓発情報であり、具体的な症例数や異常発生の報告は含まれていないため、対象国として記載しない。

article.articleHeadline: Εμπολα: Οι μαζικές ταφές στο Κονγκό καταδεικνύουν χιλιάδες αδήλωτους θανάτους
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Mass burials in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reveal thousands of unreported deaths.
article.articleSummary: Satellite imagery analyzed by Reuters reveals Ebola’s toll in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is markedly undercounted. In Bunia, the outbreak’s epicenter, new burials rose from two to three per day earlier in 2026 to about 15 daily within months; the Nyamuron go cemetery and Bunia’s two other largest cemeteries show graves far exceeding official counts. By July, a cemetery worker estimated about 600 Ebola-related burials at Nyamuron go since April, while authorities had recorded fewer than 200 Ebola deaths in Bunia. Since the outbreak was officially declared on May 15, 2026, the DRC has logged over 11,500 infections and more than 5,500 deaths nationwide. By early November, Bunia’s excess mortality surpassed 1,000—over 50% higher than the 707 officially attributed to Ebola. Excess deaths may include indirect effects; WHO warned the true scale could be 2–4 times larger, a view supported by experts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国での集団埋葬が数千人の未報告死者を明らかにする
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行において、衛星画像分析により公式統計を大幅に上回る死者数（過少報告）が確認されており、公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際的懸念が認められるためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: WHOは実際の死者数が公式数値の2〜4倍に達する可能性を指摘しており、サーベイランス体制の脆弱性が疑われる。国際的な支援ニーズと情報の透明性に関する懸念が高い案件。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta mpox: casos passam de mil no Brasil; veja sintomas, vacinação e como se proteger
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox alert: cases exceed one thousand in Brazil; see symptoms, vaccination, and how to protect yourself.
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports 1,055 mpox cases in 2026, 16 November, concentrated in São Paulo (398) and Rio de Janeiro (391), together 74.8% of national cases; Ceará (60), Minas Gerais (41), and Federal District (39) follow. To bolster protection, the Health Ministry acquired 25,000 vaccine doses via PAHO's Revolving Fund, limited to high-risk or exposed groups, not the population. Most infections are mild to moderate and self-limiting; severe outcomes occur mainly in immunocompromised individuals, especially those with HIV/AIDS and significant immunosuppression. Mpox is caused by an Orthopoxvirus and transmits via direct contact with lesions, bodily fluids, close respiratory exposure, and contaminated objects; transmission can persist until lesions crust and heal. Symptoms include fever, malaise, headache, myalgias, lymphadenopathy, and skin lesions that may involve mucous membranes. PCR of lesion scrapings confirms diagnosis. Vaccination targets include people living with HIV (CD4 <100), PrEP users, lab workers, and contacts at medium/high risk.

triage.headline_ja: Mpoxアラート：ブラジルでの症例数が1000人を超える。症状、ワクチン接種、予防方法について
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでMpox症例が1,000例を超え、保健省がワクチンを調達するなど対応を強化しており、WPRO基準（異常性・持続曝露・流行しやすさ）に該当し社会的・行政的関心も高いため、フルリスク評価への移行を検討すべきシグナルと判断した。
triage.notes: 重症例は主にHIV陽性など免疫不全者に集中しており、全体としては軽症～中等症が多い。保健省はPAHO回転基金を通じてワクチン2万5千回分を調達しており、国際的な調達支援の関与が見られる。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak is spreading and killing at a record pace as barriers to aid persist
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), caused by the Bundibugyo strain, remains out of control six months after it was first declared on May 15; as of Nov 23, government data show more than 11,000 infections and over 5,500 deaths. The outbreak is the second-largest on record globally and Congo’s 17th Ebola episode, surpassing the 2018-2020 outbreak (3,481 cases, 2,299 deaths). Ituri province is the original epicenter, but alerts describe spread to hot spots beyond Ituri. Insecurity, attacks on health workers, and limited coordination hinder response; MSF says vital resources aren’t reaching remote areas. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus cited security as a major obstacle; health workers have gone on strike over conditions and unpaid salaries. About $2.9 billion has been pledged, but less than half has been disbursed; donors urged closer Kinshasa coordination to avoid duplication.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行、支援への障壁が続く中で記録的な速さで拡大・死者増加
triage.triage_reason: 死者5,500人超・感染者11,000人超の史上第2位規模のエボラ流行で、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが明確にIHR基準2つ以上に該当する。
triage.notes: イトゥリ州を震源とするエボラ流行がイトゥリ州外のホットスポットへ拡大中。治安悪化、医療従事者へのストライキ・攻撃、資金拠出の遅れ（29億ドル中半分未満が実際に支払われた）が対応を阻害している。史上2番目の規模（コンゴ国内17回目の流行）。

article.articleHeadline: Telangana Vaccinates 17.21 Lakh Children Against Polio
article.articleSummary: Polio vaccination drive in Telangana on Nov 22, 2026 vaccinated 1,721,545 children across five districts (Hyderabad, Ranga Reddy, Medchal-Malkajgiri, Sangareddy, Hanumakonda) under the Sub-National Immunisation Day. First-day coverage reached about 95.6% of the target 1,801,698 children. The programme used 7,428 vaccination booths, 245 transit points, and 245 mobile teams, with 29,712 vaccinators and 744 supervisors deployed. Of the total, 1,683,380 children received polio drops at booths, 21,369 at transit points, and 16,796 via mobile teams. Hanumakonda led with ~98.5% coverage; Ranga Reddy ~98.14%; Sangareddy ~94.8%; Medchal-Malkajgiri ~94.67%; Hyderabad ~94.18% (5,11,641 of 5,43,235). Children received two drops of bivalent Oral Polio Vaccine (types 1 and 3). Health Minister Damodar Raja Narasimha urged parents to vaccinate every eligible child; follow-up house-to-house visits are planned on Nov 23–24, with Greater Hyderabad aims through Nov 25, focusing on migrants and densely populated areas.

triage.headline_ja: テランガナ州でポリオワクチン接種、172.1万人の子どもに実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防接種キャンペーン（Sub-National Immunisation Day）の実施報告であり、新規症例や流行の兆候は記載されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は定期的なポリオ予防接種キャンペーンの実施状況を報告するものであり、実際の感染症発生・症例報告ではないため対象国リストへの計上は行わない。

article.articleHeadline: Ghanaian Polyherbal Remedies Inhibit Malaria Parasites While Showing
article.articleSummary: Three widely circulated polyherbal antimalarials from urban Ghana inhibit blood-stage Plasmodium falciparum in vitro. Product A (Aloe schweinfurthii, Khaya senegalensis, Piliostigma thonningii, Cassia siamea), Product B (Ocimum viride, Vernonia amygdalina, Morinda lucida, Alstonia boonei, Carica papaya), and Product C (Ananas comosus, Citrus aurantifolia, Azadirachta indica) suppressed chloroquine-sensitive 3D7 trophozoites (IC50: 0.8686, 0.8280, 3.066 µg/mL) and chloroquine-resistant Dd2 trophozoites (0.9388, 0.3177, 15.09 µg/mL). Life-stage tests showed higher schizont IC50s (9.958, 7.707, 13.66) and gametocytes (13.59, 17.92, 59.65), suggesting curative rather than transmission-blocking effects. In non-infected RBCs, CC50s were 117.60, 64.63, 55.23 µg/mL. Ghana FDA requires quality screening and acute toxicity but not efficacy proof; 45 formulations were surveyed in Accra and Kumasi, with three top products selected. Rodent safety was tolerable alongside in vitro efficacy.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナのポリハーバル治療薬がマラリア原虫を阻害、ラットにおける安全性も許容範囲内であることを示す
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は研究室での植物薬剤のin vitro/動物実験に関する基礎研究報告であり、実際の疾病発生やアウトブレイクに関する情報ではないため、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: この記事はマラリア原虫に対する伝統薬の研究結果（in vitro試験・ラット毒性試験）に関する学術的な内容であり、実際の感染症発生事例ではないため、verified_locationsは空とする。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Congo, distese di tombe raccontano un'emergenza più grave dei bilanci ufficiali
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo, expanses of graves tell of a crisis more serious than official tallies.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Mongbwalu (eastern DRC), is evidenced by mass graves at the CECA cemetery. Reuters footage shot in July shows burial sites expanding as the outbreak unfolds. Satellite analysis comparing new graves with previous years indicates excess mortality well beyond official Ebola tallies. In August, the number of deaths uncovered at CECA Cemetery 20 surpassed the city and surrounding villages' official Ebola toll by more than 25%. Many individuals were buried without being tested or registered, especially during the epidemic's early months, which was declared mid-May. The article highlights undercounting through informal burials, suggesting that actual mortality from Ebola in Mongbwalu and nearby areas may exceed official figures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ、墓地の広がりが公式統計より深刻な危機を物語る
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにおいて公式統計を大幅に上回る過少報告の可能性が示されており、公衆衛生上の深刻性・異常性・国際的関心が高いためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事は衛星画像・墓地調査に基づく死亡者数の過少報告を指摘しており、既存のエボラアウトブレイク（2026年5月宣言）の深刻度評価の見直しが必要な可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 109 nouveaux cas et 48 décès enregistrés en une journée
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 109 new cases and 48 deaths recorded in one day.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo recorded 109 new confirmed cases and 48 deaths on November 17, 2026 (reported November 20). Of the fatalities, 34 occurred in communities and 14 in Ebola Treatment Centers. Nord-Kivu accounts for 71 of the 109 new cases (65.1%), with the Beni health zone reporting 30 cases and 14 deaths. Ituri province remains the most affected since the start, accounting for about 68.4% of cumulative confirmed cases. Since the outbreak began, 3,148 people have recovered, while 1,743 patients are in isolation in treatment centers. Twenty of 68 historically affected health zones report no new cases; five have 21–42 days without notification and fifteen more than 42 days. The epidemic is active in five provinces: Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo, and Nord-Ubangi. Authorities have strengthened surveillance, diagnostics, community messaging, and care capacity. Contact tracing rate is 82.6%, with interventions concentrated in Ituri and Nord-Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：1日で109件の新規症例と48人の死亡を記録
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続しており、1日で100件超の新規症例・48人の死亡という高い重症度と複数州への拡大が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクはイトゥリ州、北キブ州、オート・ウエレ州、チョポ州、北ウバンギ州の5州で活動中であり、致死率・感染拡大状況から継続的な監視とフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 中国当前3种毒株同时活跃 医院爆满(组图)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three virus strains are currently circulating in China; hospitals are at full capacity (Photo Gallery)
article.articleSummary: Three influenza virus strains are circulating in China: A(H1N1), A(H3N2), and B Victoria lineage. Transmission is widespread across the country, with co-circulation and shifting dominance: A(H3N2) predominated in October, but by November A(H1N1) rose to become the main strain, while A(H3N2) fell below 20% and B Victoria remained comparatively stable. Children aged 5–14 show the highest influenza-positive rates. Week 46 (Nov 9–15, 2026) recorded 144 influenza-like illness outbreaks nationwide, defined as 10+ ILIs in a region or facility within a week. Hospitals are overloaded; many reports describe fever clinics crowded and people with high fever persisting. Clinicians warn that flu symptoms in children can be non-specific in infants; adults focus on preventing severe disease. Cross-protection between strains is weak, making reinfection possible; potential complications include pneumonia, myocarditis, and encephalopathy in vulnerable groups.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で現在3種類のウイルス株が同時に流行、病院は満床状態（写真特集）
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザながら3株の同時流行と病院の受入れ逼迫が報告されており、重症化例や合併症への懸念も見られるため、経過確認を含めフルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（A(H1N1)、A(H3N2)、B型Victoria系統）の同時流行で、病院のキャパシティ逼迫が報告されている。重症化（肺炎、心筋炎、脳症）の懸念もあり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch sốt xuất huyết Dengue diễn biến phức tạp, Đắk Lắk yêu cầu tăng cường các biện pháp phòng, chống
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever outbreak with complex developments, Dak Lak calls for strengthening prevention and control measures.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak in Dak Lak Province, Vietnam, described as complex; the Dak Lak People’s Committee issued a directive urging all administrative levels, agencies, and localities to vigorously implement prevention and control measures to protect public health. Dated 23 November 2026, the article notes the outbreak’s complex developments but provides no case or death counts, laboratory confirmation details, or identified infection sources. There is no information on imported or exported cases. The directive emphasizes urgent mobilization of resources and coordinated actions—vector control, surveillance, health education, and community measures—to curb transmission and safeguard residents. The piece highlights government-led response rather than clinical data, with no district-level breakdowns or numerical outbreak metrics provided.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の流行が複雑化、ダクラク省が予防・対策強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の流行拡大が報告されているが、症例数・死亡数等の具体的データがなく、地域の風土病的疾患であるため国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いと考えられる。続報を注視する。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムの風土病であり、症例数・死亡数等の具体的データが欠如しているため、重症度の評価は困難。地方政府の対策強化指示が主な内容で、臨床データは含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: विदेश पर निर्भरता खत्म: भारत ने बर्ड फ्लू रोधक पहली स्वदेशी वैक्सीन बनाई, अब मुर्गियों को H5N1 वायरस से मिलेगी सुरक्षा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: End of dependence on foreign countries: India has developed the first domestically produced vaccine against avian influenza; chickens will now be protected against the H5N1 virus.
article.articleSummary: India unveils the first domestically produced vaccine against avian influenza (H5N1) for poultry, developed by ICAR’s National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases in Bhopal and unveiled by Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan. The vaccine targets H5N1 clade 2.3.2.1A, marking India’s inaugural indigenous vaccine against this strain. This milestone is expected to strengthen animal health security and shield the poultry sector from losses, contributing to Atmanirbhar Bharat. Since 2006 India has reported over 500 outbreaks of H5N1 and H5N8. The latest large outbreak occurred in May 2026 in Navapur, Nandurbar district, Maharashtra, with 13 farms affected; approximately 400,000 chickens culled, 2,160,000 eggs destroyed, and 500 tons of poultry feed destroyed. Details on commercial production and immunization campaigns were not disclosed.

triage.headline_ja: 海外依存の終焉：インドが鳥インフルエンザ対策の初の国産ワクチンを開発、鶏をH5N1ウイルスから保護へ
triage.triage_reason: 記事はワクチン開発という政策・技術的進展が主題で、ヒトへの新規感染拡大の報告はない。過去の家禽アウトブレイク（2026年5月）への言及はあるが現時点で急性の公衆衛生リスクを示す情報はなく、動物衛生分野の継続監視事項として扱う。
triage.notes: 記事はヒト感染ではなく家禽（動物）のH5N1/H5N8対策ワクチン開発に関するもの。影響カテゴリも'animals'のみ。ヒトへの感染拡大や症例報告は記載されていないため、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いが、家禽の継続的なアウトブレイク発生状況（2006年以降500件超）から流行しやすさ・長期曝露の観点でWPRO基準に該当するため経過観察とする。

article.articleHeadline: Кладбища растут быстрее, чем вирус: спутниковые снимки вскрыли масштаб катастрофы в Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cemeteries are growing faster than the virus: Satellite images reveal the scale of the disaster in Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in eastern Congo appear to be at least 50% undercounted, according to Reuters analysis comparing Ministry of Health tallies with satellite imagery of graves in Bunia, Mongbvalu, and Nyamurongo. In early November, Bunia officially recorded 707 Ebola deaths, while fresh graves exceeded this by about 500, suggesting roughly 1,200 fatalities. In June, the gap was sevenfold (580 uncounted vs 80 official). By September, uncounted deaths reached 950, about twice the official count. Factors include late outbreak detection, misdiagnosis as malaria, tests for a different Ebola strain with a vaccine, hospital avoidance due to high mortality, and many temporary gold-miners buried without testing. Although burial controls tightened by November, more than 60% of deaths occur outside hospitals and over 85% of new infections are not in contact lists, signaling a loss of transmission chain control in Bunia, Mongbvalu, Nyamurongo and surrounding areas.

triage.headline_ja: 墓地はウイルスよりも速く増えている：衛星画像がコンゴの惨事の規模を明らかにした
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにおいて、衛星画像分析により公式死者数が実際より大幅に過少報告されている可能性が示され、感染経路の制御も失われつつあることから、深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念とさらなる拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: ロイターの衛星画像分析報道に基づく。マラリアとの誤診、病院忌避、金鉱労働者の未検査埋葬などが過少報告の要因として挙げられており、85%以上の新規感染者が接触者リスト外であることから感染伝播の制御喪失が強く示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: 中國當前3種毒株同時活躍 醫院爆滿(組圖)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three virus strains are currently circulating simultaneously in China; hospitals overwhelmed (photo gallery).
article.articleSummary: China is experiencing simultaneous circulation of three influenza strains—Influenza A(H1N1), Influenza A(H3N2), and Influenza B/Victoria—driving increasing clustered outbreaks. Latest CDC monitoring shows mid-level national activity, with the north trending upward and the south fluctuating; children aged 5–14 have the highest positivity. In the 2026 season, H3N2 dominated early, but by November A(H1N1) became the main circulating strain while H3N2 fell below 20%, and B/Victoria remained steadily active. Cross-protection between strains is weak, allowing possible sequential infections. Beijing You’an Hospital notes pediatric cases are predominantly infants to preschoolers, with abrupt onset high fever and body aches and risks of pneumonia, myocarditis, or encephalitis, especially in the young and elderly. As of week 46 (Nov 9–15), 144 influenza-like outbreak events were reported nationwide. The report also notes one plague death in September 2026 and Russian rumors of pneumonic plague.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で現在3種のウイルス株が同時流行、病院は患者で溢れる（写真集）
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1・H3N2・B型）の同時流行による医療機関の逼迫が報告されているが、新規病原体や国際的拡大の明確な証拠はなく、ペスト関連情報も噂レベルで裏付けが乏しいため、続報を注視する段階と判断する。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザ（A(H1N1)、A(H3N2)、B/Victoria）の同時流行と小児重症例（肺炎・心筋炎・脳炎）を中心に報じている。2026年9月のペスト死亡例やロシア発の肺ペスト噂は本筋とは別の付随情報であり、確認情報に乏しいため評価対象外として扱った。

article.articleHeadline: Organizația Mondială a Sănătății cere încetarea violențelor într-o regiune din RDC afectată de Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization calls for an end to violence in an Ebola-affected region of the DRC.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization (WHO) appeals for peace in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), amid the most deadly Ebola outbreak recorded in the country’s history. As of 11,613 confirmed cases, 5,678 deaths have been reported, with Ituri (northeast) and Nord-Kivu (east) as the hardest-hit regions. Violent clashes near a hospital have forced medical staff to shelter in a maternity ward for more than 24 hours, disrupting Ebola response efforts and threatening patients and families. WHO seeks safe evacuation of personnel and protection for facilities, staff, and patients, underscoring that peace is the best remedy. The outbreak, ongoing since May, has spread across large areas of eastern and northern RDC, with access for humanitarian actors limited by insecurity, geography, and distance, and about 80 security incidents against health workers (some fatal) since the epidemic began. Two new vaccines are under testing; if conclusive, large-scale, cold-chain vaccine deployment will be required, even in electricity-disabled zones.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関(WHO)、エボラ出血熱の影響を受けるコンゴ民主共和国の地域における暴力の停止を要請
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で同国史上最も死者数の多いエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（確定症例11,613例、死亡5,678例）が継続しており、暴力により対応活動が妨げられている。公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性が認められ、WHOも国際的な懸念を表明しているためフルリスク評価に進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ItiuriおよびNord-Kivuはコンゴ民主共和国内の州であり、別個の対象国としては扱わずDRCに統合して計上した。暴力・治安悪化により医療従事者の安全確保とワクチン展開（コールドチェーン含む）が課題となっている。

article.articleHeadline: ਪਲਸ ਪੋਲੀਓ ਮੁਹਿੰਮ ਤਹਿਤ 9052 ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਪਿਆਈਆਂ ਬੂੰਦਾਂ - Polio drops administered to 9,052 little ones
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Under the Pulse Polio Campaign, polio drops were administered to 9,052 children.
article.articleSummary: On 23 November 2026, under Civil Surgeon Dr Upinder’s orders and led by Senior Medical Officer Dr Nisha Bansal, the Pulse Polio drive vaccinated 9,052 children aged 0–5 in Block Dhudike, Punjab (Kaka Ramunwala area). The first day covered all 9,052 children; remaining eligible children will receive drops in the next days. The campaign deployed 69 booths and 138 teams, with 12 supervisors monitoring operations to ensure no child is left unvaccinated. In addition to centers at Dala, Ramunwala Nawan, and Chadik Addi, camps were set up at Bughipura Chowk and Ajitwal bus stands. Supervisors Chamkaur Singh, Jagroop Singh, Jagtar Singh, Suman Deep Singh, Ranjit Singh, Gur Amarpreet Singh, and Sandeep Singh led efforts, with nursing students from Nursing College Bughipura and Baba College involved.

triage.headline_ja: パルス・ポリオ・キャンペーンのもと、9,052人の子どもたちにポリオワクチン滴下が投与された
triage.triage_reason: これは定例のポリオ予防接種（Pulse Polioキャンペーン）の実施報告であり、実際の症例発生や流行を示す内容ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はポリオ症例の発生ではなく、定期予防接種キャンペーンの実施状況を報じるルーティン記事。症例や発生に関する言及はないため、対象国リストへの計上も行わない。

article.articleHeadline: Tribal Pandemic Response Study Reveals Major Regional Differences in
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 non-pharmaceutical interventions adherence surveyed across four tribal communities in India: Baiga (Dindori, Madhya Pradesh); Bhariya (Patalkot Valley, Chhindwara, MP); Saharia (Shivpuri, MP); Bodh (Keylong, Lahaul and Spiti, Himachal Pradesh). Between Sep 2021 and Feb 2022, n=2,617; fever recognition 73% and vaccine awareness 95% were high, but preventive practices varied by region. Hand hygiene (2,232) and mask wearing (2,179) were most common; social distancing (1,313) least. In Lahaul and Spiti, hand hygiene 98.8%, masks 98.4%, social distancing 67.8% (highest). Baiga Dindori: mask 63.0%, social distancing 27.4% (hand hygiene 90.6%). Bhariya Patalkot Valley: handwashing 72.7%, linked to acute water scarcity. Television was the primary information source (61% overall), highest in Shivpuri (87.4%); Dindori and Chhindwara relied more on frontline health workers and print/radio, with limited use of digital platforms (12.9% in Lahaul and Spiti). Centralized directives failed to account for local topography and social structure, driving regional disparities in preventive practices.

triage.headline_ja: 部族のパンデミック対応研究、予防対策における地域間の大きな差異を明らかに
triage.triage_reason: 過去（2021年9月〜2022年2月）の行動調査研究結果の報告であり、現在進行中の新規感染拡大や公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術研究（過去の行動調査データ分析）であり、新規の感染症発生イベントではないため対象国特定の必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Hospital Staff in Brazil Harbor Multidrug-Resistant Staph in Nasal Cavities
article.articleSummary: In a public hospital in Caxias, eastern Maranhão, Brazil, a cross-sectional study (Dec 2024–Feb 2025) found nasal carriage of Staphylococcus aureus in 27.27% of 132 healthcare professionals. Of 36 recovered isolates, 18 (50%) were multidrug-resistant, and 6 (16.67% of colonized; 4.54% of the workforce) met phenotypic criteria for MRSA. The cohort was 68.94% female, mean age 38.94 years (SD 10.90); nursing technicians/assistants comprised 40.91%, registered nurses 26.52% (35 individuals), physicians 21.97% (29), and allied health workers 10.61%. Exclusion: no systemic antibiotics in the two weeks prior to sampling. Isolation involved BHI broth, blood and mannitol salt agars, and MALDI-TOF confirmation (Biotyper 3.1). Disk diffusion against 15 antibiotics showed high resistance to penicillin G and ampicillin (94.44%), erythromycin (83.33%), and azithromycin (77.78%); cefoxitin resistance was 16.67%, with ciprofloxacin 11.11% and levofloxacin 8.33% resistance. Indicates ongoing occupational circulation of high-risk S. aureus lineages in Brazilian hospitals.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの病院スタッフの鼻腔内に多剤耐性黄色ブドウ球菌を保菌
triage.triage_reason: 単一病院での横断研究による保菌調査であり、アウトブレイクや急性症例の報告ではなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性や社会的関心も認められない。
triage.notes: 研究報告であり、アウトブレイクの発生を示すものではない。院内感染対策の文脈での情報として留意する程度。

article.articleHeadline: The missing deaths of Congo's Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Satellite imagery analysis of three cemeteries in Bunia and one in Mongbwalu in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo shows the Ebola outbreak in Ituri province has caused far more deaths than official tallies indicate. While authorities reported over 5,500 Ebola deaths across the country since the outbreak began, burial-site activity and the civil registry in Mongbwalu reveal a much larger toll that is not captured in formal counts. Deaths are often not reported to the civil registry, and even complete registration would not fully reflect the toll because the outbreak was declared only after a surge in deaths. At the local hospital, May deaths rose before the first laboratory confirmation of a rare Ebola virus species. Since the declaration, deaths continue, including those outside hospitals, complicating counting and contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行における『見過ごされた死者』
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行において衛星画像分析により公式統計を大幅に上回る死者数が示唆されており、稀なエボラウイルス種の確認や報告体制の不備など公衆衛生上重大かつ異常な事態であるため。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存のエボラ流行に関する続報だが、衛星画像・墓地活動分析により公式死者数（5500人以上）が実態を大幅に過小評価している可能性を示す重要な新情報を含む。稀なエボラウイルス種の確認、院外死亡の増加、接触者追跡の困難さなど、流行管理上の深刻な課題が示唆されており、フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Imported Malaria Re-Establishment Risk in Fuzhou Peaks in May and June
article.articleSummary: Imported malaria re-establishment risk in Fuzhou peaks in May–June. A decade-long study (2016–2025) integrating epidemiology, entomology, and climate shows that conditions for re-establishment are most favorable in late spring/early summer, despite no local transmission since 1992 and China declared malaria-free by WHO in 2021. From 2016-2025, Fuzhou reported 663 imported malaria cases (68.85% of Fujian Province’s total), with 611 cases (92.16%) acquired in Africa. Plasmodium falciparum accounted for 76.17% of infections. Males dominated (ratio 9.2:1); median age 41; overseas laborers and international travelers comprised 71.80%. At diagnosis, 460 resided in Fuzhou; 203 abroad. The seasonal pattern is bimodal: peaks in Jan–Feb and Jun–Aug. Entomology found 3,525 Anopheles sinensis over ten years, with Fuqing contributing 79.97% of captures; vector counts varied from 14 to 1,044. Receptivity, vulnerability, and infectivity define malariogenic potential.

triage.headline_ja: 福州における輸入マラリア再定着リスクは5月・6月にピークを迎える
triage.triage_reason: 実際の疾病発生ではなく、過去10年間（2016-2025）のデータに基づく輸入マラリア再定着リスクに関する学術的研究報告であり、現地感染は1992年以降発生しておらず中国はWHOよりマラリア撲滅国に認定済みのため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は輸入マラリア症例の疫学的・昆虫学的・気候学的研究報告であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。現地伝播は1992年以降発生なし。続報監視も不要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: HOSPITAL NO SUL DE MG RESTRINGE VISITAS APÓS COVID E SARNA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hospital in southern Minas Gerais restricts visits after COVID-19 and scabies.
article.articleSummary: Hospital São Sebastião in Três Corações, southern Minas Gerais, has indefinitely restricted visits and accompaniment due to COVID-19 and human scabies circulating in the city and region. Masks are mandatory again and cleaning protocols reinforced; the hospital serves about 500 people daily. The measures aim to limit outside contact to curb in-hospital transmission of highly contagious diseases transmitted via respiratory routes and close contact. Três Corações has recorded 161 human scabies cases, with many treated at the hospital. Regarding COVID-19, three patients were treated in November: a 94-year-old woman was hospitalized, conscious and stable; a 2-month-old infant was hospitalized and later discharged; and a 75-year-old cancer patient contracted COVID-19 and died, with the hospital attributing death to cancer-treatment complications, not the infection. Reinforcement of Ministry of Health prevention protocols is in place, and relaxations will depend on case reductions as of 23 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 南ミナスジェライス州の病院、COVID-19と疥癬の流行で面会制限
triage.triage_reason: 単一病院・地域レベルの局地的なCOVID-19と疥癬の発生であり、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報はないが、地域での感染拡大継続中のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 地域ローカルニュースであり、COVID-19死亡例は癌治療の合併症によるものとされている。疥癬161例は地域内での流行を示すが、国際的な懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Hasil Lab, Melon dan Sambal Tomat MBG di Malang Mengandung Bakteri E. coli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lab results show MBG Melon and Tomato Sambal in Malang contain Escherichia coli.
article.articleSummary: Escherichia coli detected in two MBG menu items (melon and tomato sambal) distributed by SPPG Madyopuro 2 in Malang, East Java. Lab results from Labkesda Surabaya linked contamination to MBG consumed on 17 November 2026, triggering illness in students and staff. At SMK Kesehatan Adi Husada Kota Malang, 22 students reported nausea, vomiting; 11 required hospitalization. Additionally, two students and one TK Dharma Bakti Pertiwi teacher exhibited similar symptoms. Other menu items (rice, crispy chicken, fried tofu, sautéed cabbage) did not meet requirements. SPPG suspended the MBG supplier from 18 November 2026 for 20 days, while the kitchen operator faced temporary closure. TK Dharma Bakti Pertiwi families voted to discontinue MBG, reflecting parental safety concerns. The incident underscores food-safety oversight for school feeding programs in Malang.

triage.headline_ja: ラボ検査結果、マランのMBG給食メロンとトマトサンバルから大腸菌を検出
triage.triage_reason: 学校給食による限定的な食中毒事例であり国際的拡大の懸念は低いが、学校給食の食品安全管理に関する懸念として継続観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 単一地域（マラン市）の学校給食プログラムにおける食品汚染事例。入院11名、重症者報告なし。国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威ではなく、現地の食品安全管理の問題として扱うべき。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola/Rutshuru : un premier cas confirmé à Kanyabayonga, dans la zone de santé de Kibirizi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola/Rutshuru: the first confirmed case in Kanyabayonga, in the Kibirizi health zone.
article.articleSummary: First confirmed case of Ebola virus disease in Kanyabayonga, Bwito chiefdom, Kibirizi health zone, Rutshuru territory, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo. A female resident of the Mwendabandu neighborhood was confirmed Ebola positive on 22 November at the CEPROMI health center after laboratory analysis; she died at the facility despite care. Following confirmation, health authorities restricted access to CEPROMI to facilitate epidemiological investigations and contact tracing. Residents are advised to seek care at other health facilities for medical needs. This represents the first positive case in the CEPROMI catchment area and in the Kibirizi health zone since the outbreak began, with regional concern rising due to spread in neighboring Lubero territory, where seven health zones are affected. Authorities urge heightened surveillance and community vigilance: regular handwashing, avoiding direct contact with suspected cases, and rapid reporting of any suspected infection.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ/ルチュル：キビリジ保健ゾーンのカニャバヨンガで初の確認症例
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州でエボラ出血熱の新たな健康ゾーンにおける初症例確定・死亡が発生し、既に周辺のルベロ準州で7つの保健ゾーンに拡大している進行中のアウトブレイクであるため、即座にフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本症例は既存のエボラアウトブレイクの一部で、ルベロ準州では既に7保健ゾーンに拡大中。ルワンダは近隣国として言及されているが、ルワンダ国内での発生は記載されていないため対象国リストに含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Going to Vietnam? Popular resort hit by outbreak of dangerous fever
article.articleSummary: More than 12,500 dengue fever cases have been reported in Da Nang, Vietnam, this year, nearly four times higher than 2025. Da Nang, a resort popular with Kazakhstanis, recorded 2,219 new cases from November 16–22, led by Ngu Hanh Son District with 1,363 since January (230 in the past week). Other districts: An Khe 150, Dien Ban Dong 149, Son Tra 128. The city identified 86 new infection clusters in the week, for a total of 796 since January (about five times last year). Authorities run 554 mosquito-monitoring sites; 85 are at increased risk. Control efforts are hampered by shortages of mosquito-control supplies and medical workers, and incomplete larva elimination. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus; symptoms include high fever, severe headache, retro-orbital pain, muscle/joint aches, rash, nausea and vomiting. Kazakhstan’s Healthcare Ministry says climate prevents domestic dengue; travelers should use air conditioning and screens, wear long clothing, apply repellents, and seek medical advice after returning if fever develops.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナム旅行を計画中ですか？人気リゾート地で危険な熱病の流行
triage.triage_reason: ダナンでのデング熱症例が前年比約4倍に急増し、制御資材・医療従事者不足など対応力に懸念があるため、WPRO基準に複数該当し社会的関心も高いと判断。
triage.notes: カザフスタン保健省が渡航者向け注意喚起を出しているが、カザフスタン国内でのデング熱発生ではないため対象国リストに含めず。重症度（死亡者数・入院率）に関する具体的データは記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Mandaue City Council urges weekly clean-ups to prevent dengue fever
article.articleSummary: Mandaue City, Cebu, pushes weekly clean-up drives in schools and barangays to eliminate mosquito breeding sites and curb dengue as cases rise. Councilor Raul Kevin Flores Cabahug announced a resolution and an emergency meeting on Nov 24 at Mandaue City Hall to coordinate dengue responses with the Health Office, Department of Education-Mandaue City Division, and 27 barangays. As of Nov 19, eight dengue-related deaths and about 1,200 dengue cases were recorded, higher than the same period last year. The plan emphasizes rapid post-rain clean-ups and adherence to the DOH '4 o’clock habit,' urging daily searches for and destruction of breeding sites across households. Dengue is a mosquito-borne viral infection causing a severe flu-like illness; warning signs include nausea, vomiting, and rashes. CBC testing is provided free at the City Health Office, underscoring community-wide cooperation for prevention.

triage.headline_ja: マンダウエ市議会、デング熱予防のため毎週の清掃活動を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン・セブ州マンダウエ市で例年より多いデング熱症例・死亡が報告され地方自治体が対策強化しているが、IHR基準の国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限の根拠はなく、地域限定の季節性流行対応として続報を注視すべき事案。
triage.notes: インフルエンザは記事本文に言及なく、デング熱のみが主題。地方自治体レベルの季節性対応であり、国家規模の緊急事態を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue no Paraná: Sesa abre a temporada com alerta para cidades com mais casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue in Paraná: Sesa opens the season with an alert for cities with more cases.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Paraná, Brazil: Paraná State recorded 6,380 confirmed dengue cases in 2026 with six deaths, per Epidemiological Report No. 31 from the State Health Secretariat (Sesa). About 2,836 cases are under investigation and 59,922 have been discarded; 317 cases are classified as severe. Regions with the most confirmations are Londrina (1,573), Paranavaí (637), Maringá (584), and Cornélio Procópio (528). Among the six fatalities, four were women aged 21–24, 50–59, 70–79, and >90, and two were men aged 10–20 and 80–89. Despite a 93% reduction versus 2025 by Week 44 and a 95.8% drop in deaths (114 to 6), Sesa maintains prevention efforts, including the Dia D mobilization on Nov 28. El Niño may boost Aedes aegypti proliferation; surveillance uses LIRAa and 32,614 ovitraps across ~90% of municipalities. Wolbachia-carrying mosquitoes have been released in Foz do Iguaçu, Cascavel, Londrina, Cambé, and Ponta Grossa to reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: パラナ州のデングウイルス感染症：州保健局(Sesa)が流行シーズン開始を宣言し、症例多発都市に警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルは対象国に含まれず、記事内容も前年比93%減少と季節性の定例報告であり、国際的拡大や異常事態とは言えない。
triage.notes: 対象国(ブラジル)は本リストの対象国GeoNames IDに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とする。

article.articleHeadline: Կոնգոյում էբոլայով հիվանդության դեպքերը գերազանցել են 11700-ը
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, Ebola virus disease cases have surpassed 11,700.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has 11,762 confirmed cases and 5,775 deaths (case fatality 49.1%) since May 2016. The epicenter is Ituri province, accounting for 68.3% of total cases, with the outbreak spanning eight provinces and 178 municipal zones, of which 68 are affected. The World Health Organization notes that six months into this outbreak, response measures have expanded substantially, but virus transmission remains sustained. The WHO assesses the risk of further spread within the DRC as very high.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱の症例数が11,700人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、11,762症例・5,775死亡という深刻な被害規模で、WHOが国内でのさらなる拡大リスクを非常に高いと評価しており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準にも合致するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: WHOが国内拡大リスクを「非常に高い」と評価しており、8州178自治体区のうち68区に影響が及ぶ広域アウトブレイク。継続的なモニタリングとフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : les combats dans un foyer de l'épidémie d'Ebola perturbent la riposte, alerte l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Fighting in an Ebola outbreak hotspot disrupts the response, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, continues to threaten containment as fighting near a hospital disrupts response. The World Health Organization reports the outbreak—the country’s deadliest Ebola wave—has reached 11,613 cases and 5,678 deaths as of last week. WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus warned that intensified clashes around health facilities endanger patients and healthcare workers and jeopardize containment efforts. In Ituri, violence forced personnel and humanitarian workers to shelter in a maternity ward for more than 24 hours, delaying essential services. The WHO is pursuing a secure evacuation route for staff and protection of hospital infrastructure and patients. Despite the violence, authorities continue response activities to interrupt transmission in one of the most severe Ebola outbreaks the DRC has faced.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ流行の拠点での戦闘が対応を妨げている、とWHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最悪級のエボラ流行（11,613症例、5,678死亡）が継続中であり、武力衝突が対応を妨げているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が直接警告を発しており、致死率の高さと紛争による対応阻害が重なる重大事案。継続的なフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Human H5N1 Infection in China (Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region) Detected Entering From Vietnam
article.articleSummary: An adult male traveler from Quang Ninh Province, Vietnam, entering Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, China, was found positive for avian influenza A(H5N1) at border screening on 2 November 2026; he developed symptoms on 1 November 2026. China confirms influenza A(H5N1) at entry; subsequent Vietnamese samples were negative. He reported no poultry exposure, and two Vietnamese household contacts remained asymptomatic and negative for influenza A. As of 4 November, the patient was clinically stable without fever or respiratory symptoms. From 1 January 2003 to 7 October 2026, Western Pacific Region records 487 H5N1 cases in six countries, with 320 deaths (CFR 65.8%). Globally, 1,005 cases with 479 deaths (CFR 47.6%). China’s H5N1 burden declined after 2017 H5+H7 poultry vaccination. The report also notes an 8th Mainland China H9N2 case in the past 6 weeks (pediatric in Henan with poultry exposure; recovered; 191 H9N2 cases since 2015 in Western Pacific, mostly in China).

triage.headline_ja: WHO:中国（広西チワン族自治区）でベトナムから入国した人のH5N1感染を検出
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムからの越境症例としてWHOがH5N1ヒト感染を確認しており、IHR基準の複数（重篤性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当し、社会的・行政的関心も高いためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 患者はベトナム・クアンニン省在住で中国広西へ入境時に陽性判定。濃厚接触者は陰性で現時点ではヒト-ヒト感染の証拠なし。また同時期に河南省でH9N2小児例も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: שדות של קברים: המתים שלא נספרו חושפים את ממדי אסון האבולה בקונגו
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fields of graves: the uncounted dead reveal the scale of the Ebola disaster in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Satellite imagery analysis reveals a stark discrepancy between new graves in eastern Congo and the official Ebola death toll, indicating thousands of deaths have gone uncounted and that the outbreak is larger than reported. In Bunia, at Nyamurongo Cemetery, gravedigger Solomon Mugisa stood under a tree with a shovel at his feet, sweat running in the heat of mid-July. Earlier this year, two or three burials per day were recorded at the cemetery, but after Ebola spread into the eastern city, burial numbers rose sharply from late April onward. The findings imply substantial undercounting of Ebola fatalities in the region and suggest the true scale of the outbreak exceeds official tallies.

triage.headline_ja: 墓地に広がる墓標：数えられなかった死者がコンゴのエボラ災害の規模を暴く
triage.triage_reason: 衛星画像分析によりコンゴ東部でエボラ死者数が公式発表より大幅に過小評価されている可能性が示され、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と管理可能性への懸念からフルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 衛星画像分析に基づく報道であり、公式統計との乖離が指摘されている。感染拡大の地理的範囲や公式対応状況については記事内に明記がなく、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Γιατί η ιλαρά εξαπλώνεται ξανά παγκοσμίως
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why Measles Is Spreading Again Worldwide.
article.articleSummary: Measles is spreading again worldwide as vaccination coverage falls below the 95% two-dose target. The United States, Mexico and Bolivia have lost measles elimination status after the virus circulated within their borders for more than a year; the United Kingdom, Spain and Canada had already reported similar developments. The high contagiousness of measles means about 95% two-dose coverage is needed; by end-2025, 84% of children had received the first dose and 77% the second. The pandemic disrupted immunization campaigns, and recovery remains slow due to weakened health services and vaccine distrust. Global health funding declined from $49.6B in 2024 to $39.1B in 2025, with sharper cuts in sub-Saharan Africa. Brazil and Venezuela have shown elimination can be regained with higher vaccination and close surveillance. An imported case is not enough to overturn progress, but transmission resumes when unvaccinated populations are large.

triage.headline_ja: なぜ麻疹は再び世界的に拡大しているのか
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は世界的な麻疹流行再燃に関する分析記事であり、対象11カ国の中で言及されているブラジルは排除状態を回復した成功例として挙げられているのみで、現在進行中の発生事例ではないため、監視対象地域における具体的なシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は米国・英国・カナダ・スペイン・メキシコ・ボリビア・ベネズエラ・ブラジルなど複数国にまたがる世界的な麻疹流行動向の分析記事。ブラジルとベネズエラは『排除状態を回復した成功例』として言及されており、現在アウトブレイクが発生しているわけではないため、対象国リストに基づくverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Folha da Região: Araçatuba entra em semana de mobilização contra a dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Regional Paper: Araçatuba enters a week-long mobilization against dengue
article.articleSummary: Araçatuba reports 2,316 dengue cases in 2026 with one death, and 214 chikungunya cases, up from 209 in 2025; figures updated on Fri, Nov 20. With dengue risk rising across São Paulo state, SES-SP (São Paulo State Health Secretariat) launches a week-long intensification of Aedes aegypti control from Monday, Nov 23 to Friday, Nov 27, culminating in Dia D (Day D) on Saturday, Nov 28. The campaign targets reduction of mosquito breeding sites to curb transmission of dengue, chikungunya, and zika. Araçatuba’s elevated numbers reflect a broader regional pattern, prompting coordinated prevention actions and heightened vector-control efforts across the state to limit infections in 2026 and beyond.

triage.headline_ja: 地方紙:アラサトゥーバ市、デング熱対策の週間動員を開始
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州で季節性のデング熱・チクングニア熱の増加が報告されているが、重症度や異常性を示す情報は限定的で、既存の対策（ベクターコントロール強化週間）が実施されている段階。
triage.notes: デング熱症例2,316件・死亡1例、チクングニア熱214件（前年209件から微増）。季節性の流行対策として州保健局が主導するベクターコントロール強化週間の実施が主題であり、突発的な異常事態とは言えない。ジカ熱は言及されているが具体的な症例数は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS mantiene la emergencia internacional por el brote de ébola en República Democrática del Congo, con más de 11.600 casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO maintains the international public health emergency over the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with more than 11,600 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo strain) continues in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 11,613 confirmed cases and 5,678 deaths as of November 17, across 68 health zones in eight provinces; transmission persists in 48 zones. Ituri and North Kivu are the most affected. In the last 21 days 1,417 new confirmed cases were reported (Ituri 668; North Kivu 635, the latter up 8%). The case fatality rate is 48.9%, with 3,148 recoveries. Since October 28, 720 deaths occurred (452 in communities, 268 in treatment centers), highlighting delays in detection and access to care. Security and access challenges hinder surveillance and contact tracing, which averaged 81% of contacts followed daily (target 95%): North Kivu 77%, Tshopo 68%, Sud-Ubangi 63%. The WHO maintains the international public health emergency. Kenya and Nigeria show progress with no new cases since Oct 19–20 and a 42‑day countdown to end; Kenya: 9 cases, 2 deaths; Nigeria: one imported case evacuated to Switzerland.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行で国際的緊急事態を継続、症例数は11,600件超
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEIC（国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を継続しており、致死率約49%、1万人超の症例、複数州への拡大、国境を越えた症例（ナイジェリア→スイス避難）も確認されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ケニア・スイスは関連する国境を越えた症例・輸出先として記載されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないか、主たる流行地ではないためverified_locationsから除外。主要な発生地はDRCのイトゥリ州・北キブ州等。

article.articleHeadline: RDC eleva a cerca de 11.800 los casos y alrededor de 5.800 los...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC raises the number of cases to about 11,800 and around 5,800 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 November 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 11,762 confirmed cases and 5,775 deaths (case fatality rate 49.1%). The eight-province outbreak, declared in mid-May, is centered in Ituri and has affected North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele (Upper Uele), Bas-Uele (Lower Uele), Tshopo, Ubangi-Nord, and Ubangi-Sur. More than 2,000 patients are hospitalized or in isolation, with over 3,200 discharged after recovery. Ituri remains the epicenter, and the episode is the deadliest in the DRC’s history, surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak. Projections suggest it could exceed the West Africa 2014–2016 crisis (28,616 cases, 11,325 deaths). WHO Director-General Tedros warns that intense fighting around a hospital near Ituri has disrupted the response, prompting sheltering of health workers; WHO is coordinating safe passage and protection of staff and facilities.

triage.headline_ja: DRC、エボラ出血熱の症例数を約11,800人、死者数を約5,800人に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが同国史上最悪規模（1万1千人超の症例、致死率49.1%）に達し、西アフリカ2014-16危機を上回る可能性があり、紛争により対応が阻害されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC国内（Ituri、North/South Kivu、Haut-Uele、Bas-Uele、Tshopo、Ubangi-Nord/Sur）のみが言及されており、Angolaでの発生は確認されないため除外。紛争により病院周辺での対応が妨げられ、WHOが安全な通行と医療従事者保護を調整中との情報あり。

article.articleHeadline: Qatar eases Ebola-related travel restrictions on Uganda - The Observer Media Ltd
article.articleSummary: As of 23 November 2026, Qatar has eased Ebola-related travel restrictions on Uganda after Timatic updated to remove Uganda from Qatar's restricted list. Uganda’s Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak, declared May 15, 2026 and linked to the DRC, recorded 20 confirmed cases (15 imported, 5 secondary among contacts/health workers), with 2 deaths and 18 recoveries; >800 contacts were monitored. Local transmission was interrupted on 28 July 2026, after a 42-day surveillance period. Heightened surveillance at Entebbe International Airport and land borders continues. Since October, returning Ugandans with DRC travel history face 21-day quarantine; Uganda–DRC border movement is restricted to essential travellers, including humanitarian workers and truck drivers; screening of permitted travellers and transit restrictions for those with DRC exposure remain. The easing occurs amid ongoing Ebola-related controls elsewhere; Uganda maintains preparedness, while ECDC monitors and WHO cautions against unnecessary travel restrictions. Qatar remains a key destination and transit hub.

triage.headline_ja: カタール、ウガンダに対するエボラ関連渡航制限を緩和
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダのエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）流行は既に2026年7月28日に局地伝播が終息しており、本記事はカタールによる渡航制限緩和という既存事案の後続報道であり新規の公衆衛生シグナルとはいえない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダにおけるエボラ流行（DRCとの関連が言及されるが、DRC国内での発生拡大は記載なし）であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。流行自体は既に終息しており、本報道は渡航制限緩和という事後対応に関するもの。

article.articleHeadline: Enzy Storia Dirawat Dua Hari di Rumah Sakit Akibat Infeksi Ameba
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Enzy Storia Hospitalized for Two Days Due to Amoebic Infection
article.articleSummary: As of November 23, 2026, Indonesian actress and presenter Enzy Storia was hospitalized for about two days in Jakarta due to an amoebic infection of the digestive tract, with health gradually improving. The infection is linked to Entamoeba histolytica and is typically transmitted via food or water contaminated with parasite cysts. Storia suspects exposure from a raw salad, noting that a weakened physical state may have increased vulnerability. Amebiasis symptoms include diarrhea, abdominal pain, cramps, and, in some cases, dysentery or bloody diarrhea. The article emphasizes that not all digestive disturbances after eating raw vegetables are caused by amoebas. Location references include Jakarta Pusat and the Senayan area, Indonesia, and there are no reported fatalities in the report.

triage.headline_ja: エンジー・ストリア、アメーバ感染症で2日間入院
triage.triage_reason: 著名人個人の単発的なアメーバ感染症例であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりを示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 個人の著名人に関するゴシップ的記事であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生事象としての情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Dieta ocidental faz Salmonella avançar até o fígado em camundongos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Western Diet Drives Salmonella to the Liver in Mice.
article.articleSummary: Western-style high-fat, low-fiber diet in mice accelerates Salmonella Enteritidis infection severity and hepatic dissemination. After three weeks on a Western diet (~60% of calories from fat) vs a grain-based control (~17%), mice showed altered gut microbiota with reduced diversity before illness. When challenged with Salmonella Enteritidis at low or high dose, Western-diet mice developed more severe disease and died sooner: at low dose, average time to death was about 15 days versus ~22 days on control diet; high-dose also led to earlier mortality. Despite shedding less bacteria in feces on days 2, 4, and 6, Western-diet mice harbored more Salmonella in liver and spleen, indicating greater systemic spread. Analyses combined 16S rRNA sequencing with metagenomics of both intestinal and hepatic microbiota. The study, conducted in China (Fudan University) and Georgia State University, used 8 mice per group (all male) and was published in Animal Microbiome.

triage.headline_ja: 西洋式食事がマウスにおいてサルモネラ菌の肝臓への進展を促進
triage.triage_reason: 動物実験(マウス)に関する基礎研究であり、実際のヒトまたは動物の感染症発生事例ではないため、公衆衛生上の緊急性や社会的関心は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事はマウスを用いた実験室研究の報告であり、実際の疾患発生事例ではない。中国(復旦大学)と米国(ジョージア州立大学)の研究機関が実施した基礎研究のため、地域的な公衆衛生イベントとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: गुजरात: सर्दी आते ही राजकोट में 7 दिन में 1,600 से ज्यादा सर्दी-खांसी और बुखार के मामले दर्ज
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gujarat: As winter arrives, Rajkot records more than 1,600 cases of cold, cough and fever in seven days.
article.articleSummary: Rajkot, Gujarat, 16–22 November 2026: 874 cold/cough cases and 760 fever were reported, with 204 diarrhoea/vomiting and 1 typhoid; no cases of jaundice, dysentery, or cholera. Year-to-date totals: cold/cough 36,676; fever 34,408; diarrhoea/vomiting 11,789; typhoid 41; jaundice 44. Dengue saw 5 new cases this week, bringing the annual total to 73; malaria and chikungunya reported no new cases this period, with cumulative counts of malaria 15 and chikungunya 2. Vector-control measures included larva-control in 106,695 households and fogging in 1,009 houses; 401 non-residential sites inspected; notices issued to 289 residential and 73 commercial property owners for breeding sites. Temperature ranged: Rajkot min 13.6°C, max 34°C; Ahmedabad min 15.5°C. IMD forecasts next 3 days warmer minimums and 7 days of dry weather, with no state-wide warnings through 29 November. Public urged to eliminate standing water and maintain cleanliness to curb vector-borne diseases.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州：冬の到来とともにラージコートで1週間に1,600件以上の風邪・咳・発熱の症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の風邪・発熱症例が中心で、コレラ・チフス・デング等の重篤な感染症の新規発生は低水準かつ通常のベクター対策が実施されており、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による定期的な疾病サーベイランスレポートであり、デング5件、チフス1件など散発的で、年間累計も低水準。ベクター対策（防虫・清掃啓発）が通常業務として実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Deadly eye-bleeding virus warning as more than 5,600 people killed in 68 places
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD), the Ebola-like outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, has reached 11,613 confirmed cases and 5,678 deaths (case fatality rate 48.9%). The outbreak began in May and, by 2026-11-23, is described as the deadliest in DRC’s history and the fastest-growing in new infections, with 720 deaths since 28 October (452 in communities, 268 in treatment centres). Ituri and Nord Kivu remain hardest hit; Sud-Kivu and Sud Ubangi have had no cases for more than 42 days. Kenya and Nigeria have reported no new cases and are counting down 42 days to declare their outbreaks over; no other countries have reported confirmed cases. The WHO cautions very high country risk and ongoing needs for cross-border surveillance, timely case detection, and preparedness amid insecurity and limited lab capacity; there is currently no treatment or vaccine. A British doctor working on the response returned to the UK after testing positive.

triage.headline_ja: 致死性の『目から出血する』ウイルス警告、68カ所で5,600人超が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCでバンディブギョウイルス病（エボラ様疾患）が史上最悪規模で拡大しており、致死率約49%、国境を越えた感染拡大（ケニア・ナイジェリア・英国人医師の陽性例）も確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアは新規症例なく42日間のカウントダウン中で、感染地域の中心はDRC国内（Ituri、Nord Kivu）。英国は帰国した医療従事者の陽性例であり発生地域ではないため対象国リストに含まれず除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola continúa extendiéndose en provincia de RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola continues to spread in a province of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: First confirmed Ebola case in Kanyabayonga, North Kivu, DR Congo, with the patient dying at Cepromi health center in Bwito, Kibirizi, Rutshuru territory. Authorities imposed temporary access restrictions at the facility to identify and census contacts. North Kivu remains the outbreak epicenter, with Lubero territory most affected, reporting cases across seven health zones. Ongoing violence in the eastern DRC hampers the response, raising safety concerns for health workers and facilities in Ituri and elsewhere. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned of increased attacks on healthcare teams, urging immediate, safe evacuation of personnel and protection of hospitals and patients as the Ebola outbreak persists in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の州でエボラ出血熱が拡大を続ける
triage.triage_reason: 北キブ州で新たな確定症例と死亡例が報告され、武力紛争により対応が阻害されるなど、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当し、WHO事務局長も懸念を表明しているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ルワンダ国境付近での拡大も報じられているが、ルワンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。武力紛争により医療従事者・施設への攻撃リスクが高まっている点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: اشتباكات شرق الكونجو تعرقل جهود مكافحة إيبولا - أخبار ليبيا 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Clashes in Eastern Congo Hinder Efforts to Combat Ebola - Libya News 24
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is ongoing in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri province. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says armed clashes near a hospital have disrupted the response, forcing health workers and aid partners to shelter in a maternity wing for more than 24 hours. Since late October, attacks across eastern DRC have intensified, compromising infection-control activities and humanitarian operations. By 23 November 2026, authorities report more than 11,000 Ebola cases and over 5,500 deaths since the outbreak was declared on 15 May. Security constraints hinder access to affected communities, and WHO is coordinating with partners to secure safe movement for staff and protect facilities, as the outbreak persists in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部での衝突がエボラ対策の取り組みを妨害 - リビアニュース24
triage.triage_reason: DRCで11,000例超・死者5,500人超という大規模なエボラ流行が継続中であり、武力衝突により対応が妨げられ、国際的拡大・人道支援ニーズが高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が直接言及する大規模流行で、紛争により感染制御活動が妨げられている。続報でのケース数推移・国際的拡大の実態確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: صور الأقمار الصناعية تكشف فجوة صادمة في حصيلة ضحايا إيبولا بالكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Satellite images reveal a shocking discrepancy in the Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Satellite imagery analysis of burial sites in Bunia, Democratic Republic of the Congo, reveals a gap between official Ebola death counts and estimated fatalities. Since the outbreak began in April, new graves at Nyamurongo Cemetery rose from 2.4 per day pre-outbreak to over 9 per day in June, stabilizing around 4.5 per day by early November; about 600 bodies have been interred there, while official figures reported fewer than 200 deaths in Bunia. By early November, excess mortality in Bunia exceeded 1,000—more than 50% above the Ebola death toll of around 707 for the period. A burial site in Mongbalu, north of Bunia, shows excess deaths exceeding 25% of official tallies for the town and surrounding areas. Officials warn that excess deaths may include indirect fatalities, and that underreporting is expected in mining regions; Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain was confirmed mid-May, with no vaccine or effective treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 衛星画像がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数における衝撃的な乖離を明らかに
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株）で公式死者数と衛星画像による推定死者数に大きな乖離があり、過少報告の懸念とワクチン・治療法の欠如が指摘されているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 4月に発生したブンディブギョ株エボラ流行について、衛星画像分析により公式死者数（約707人）に対し過剰死亡が1000人超と推計され、過少報告の可能性が高い。ワクチン・有効な治療法がない点も懸念材料。
