article.articleHeadline: Midges pose a growing health threat to Britons, experts warn
article.articleSummary: Midges pose a growing health threat for Britain as potential vectors of animal and human pathogens. The UK, with more than 650 midge species concentrated in Scotland, already harbours midges that spread Bluetongue and Schmallenberg, causing severe illness in livestock. Human risk is highlighted by Shamonda virus: a first-ever human case in France, a death in a patient with terminal cancer, and subsequent detection in animals across Europe; this year UK cattle tested positive for Shamonda for the first time on farms in Shropshire and Powys, Wales. In the Americas, Oropouche virus—also midge-borne—has led to thousands of cases in South and Central America, with Brazil reporting more than 13,000 since 2023 and concerns for pregnancy outcomes. Britain has imported Oropouche cases but no local spread yet; climate warming raises the specter of establishment. UK research: a £3 million PAMEC project at the University of Glasgow will test if Scottish midges can be infected by Oropouche.

triage.headline_ja: ヌカカ（ミッジ）が英国人に対する健康上の脅威として高まっていると専門家が警告
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主眼は英国における将来的なベクター媒介感染症リスクの解説であり、対象国であるブラジルのオロプーシュ熱流行は2023年以降継続している既知の状況説明に留まり、新規性・緊急性のある発生情報としては確認できないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は英国視点の総説的内容で、ブラジルでのオロプーシュ熱（2023年以降1.3万例超）は背景情報として言及されているのみ。英国・フランス等は対象国リスト外のため除外。新規アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、気候変動によるベクター拡大の将来的懸念が主題。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue deaths surge
article.articleSummary: Central Visayas, Philippines, reports 119 dengue deaths as of Nov 14, 2026, with 21,357 dengue cases region-wide (Jan 1–Nov 14), DOH-7 says, more than fivefold 2025. Bohol leads deaths at 42 among 5,623 cases; Cebu Province has 40 deaths from 7,816 cases; Cebu City 22 deaths among 4,732 cases; Lapu-Lapu City 8 deaths, 1,968 cases; Mandaue City 7 deaths, 1,218 cases. Provincial data through Nov 20 show Cebu Province LGUs with 8,882 cases and 58 deaths. Top municipalities: Talisay City 1,008 cases 6 deaths; Toledo 893/3; Medellin 563/1; Minglanilla 466/1; Dalaguete 408/3; Consolacion 385/4; Cordova 346/3; Danao City 332/3; Liloan 311/5; Argao 299/2; Madridejos 4 fatalities. Hospitals remain over capacity amid dengue/flu; overlapping symptoms and El Niño risk complicate detection. DOH-7 notes outbreak declarations rest with LGUs; Mandaue pushes mandatory weekly cleanups (Draft Resolution 402-2026) with an emergency meeting on Nov 24.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱による死者数が急増
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン中部ビサヤ地方でデング熱による死者が119人（前年比5倍超）に急増し、病院が収容能力を超えるなど公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常な増加が確認されるため、IHR基準2項目・WPRO基準複数に該当する。
triage.notes: インフルエンザとデング熱の症状重複により診断が複雑化している点、またエルニーニョによる媒介蚊増加リスクが指摘されている。地域（LGU）レベルでの対応が中心で、国際支援の必要性については記事内に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: Mujeres denuncian a un odontólogo en Brasil por transmitirles una infección
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Women file a complaint against a dentist in Brazil for transmitting an infection to them.
article.articleSummary: Six women in Rondônia, Brazil, accuse dentist Jean José Dunga, 41, of intentionally transmitting human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) to them through romantic relationships. The Public Prosecutor’s Office (MP-RO) is investigating and has requested a new arrest warrant amid potential additional victims. Dunga was already convicted in August 2026 to five years in prison under a semi-open regime and ordered to pay 50,000 reais in damages in a case linked to one complainant; another criminal proceeding involves three more women. Prosecutors allege a pattern of pursuing intimate relationships to infect victims, and that Dunga knew his HIV status for about ten years while allegedly not adhering to antiretroviral therapy, potentially enabling transmission. One complainant, anonymized as Marta, describes persistent infections, body pains, redness, itching, headaches, and fatigue before an HIV diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで歯科医がHIV感染を故意に広げたとして女性らが告発
triage.triage_reason: 個人による意図的なHIV感染という刑事事件であり、公衆衛生上の国際的拡大リスクや異常な感染症アウトブレイクには該当しない。
triage.notes: 本件は刑事事件（個人間の意図的感染）であり、公衆衛生上の感染症アウトブレイク事案ではないため対象国リストへの計上も行わない。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Covid-19 voltam a crescer no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases are rising again in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases are rising again in Brazil, with six consecutive weeks of higher activity. Fiocruz reports a notable increase in severe cases in Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Minas Gerais, Paraná, Bahia, and the Federal District. Since January, Brazil has recorded more than 118,000 influenza-like illness diagnoses associated with COVID-19. In the last week of October, positive test results were up 35% compared with the same period in 2025, signaling renewed transmission despite most infections being mild. Older adults and immunocompromised individuals remain at greater risk and require heightened protection. In response, the Ministry of Health has authorized the distribution of additional COVID-19 vaccine doses to the states to reinforce immunization and prevention efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでCOVID-19症例が再び増加
triage.triage_reason: 既知の病原体（COVID-19）による季節的な感染増加であり、重症例の増加や高リスク層への影響は見られるが、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに強いシグナルには至らず、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 既知の病原体による季節的な再流行であり、保健省が追加ワクチン配布で対応中。重症化は高齢者・免疫不全者に限定的で、国際的な拡大や渡航制限のリスクは報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Сателитски снимки укажуваат на потценет биланс на еболата во Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Satellite images indicate an underestimated burden of Ebola in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Satellite imagery of burial grounds in Bunia, eastern Congo, suggests official Ebola virus disease mortality data may underestimate the outbreak’s true toll. Reuters analysis compared the number of new graves with a baseline year without an outbreak, finding that by early November excess deaths exceeded 1,000, versus 707 officially recorded Ebola deaths. The gap likely reflects both underreporting and indirect effects of the epidemic, and the estimate does not attribute each death to Ebola. A colored electron microscope image of the Ebola virus is included, but it is not from the current outbreak (Credit: CDC/Cynthia Goldsmith, public domain). The findings underscore a heavier mortality burden in eastern Congo than confirmed case counts indicate."} }-package: seti��

triage.headline_ja: 衛星画像がコンゴのエボラ死者数過小評価を示唆
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにおいて、衛星画像分析により公式死者数が実態より大幅に過小評価されている可能性が示され、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的懸念が認められるため。
triage.notes: 記事はロイターの分析に基づき、ブニア（東部コンゴ）の墓地における埋葬数増加から超過死亡が公式エボラ死者数（707人）を大幅に上回る（1,000人超）可能性を指摘。過小報告およびエボラ流行の間接的影響の両方が示唆されている。既存のアウトブレイクに関する続報だが、規模の過小評価という新たな懸念材料がありフルリスク評価が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde mobiliza força-tarefa com 160 agentes para combater mosquito da dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health department mobilizes a task force of 160 personnel to combat the dengue mosquito.
article.articleSummary: Fernandópolis Municipal Health Department mobilizes 160 health agents to intensify Aedes aegypti control, targeting dengue and chikungunya. The first phase covers Jardim Araguaia, Jardim Paraíso, Jardim Rosa Amarela, Coester, and Parque Universitário, with door-to-door visits, resident guidance, and removal of breeding sites such as plant pots, tires, drains, and containers, plus lectures and informational materials. The effort follows state guidance to bolster preventive measures ahead of the rainy season. By November 2026, the city recorded 389 dengue notifications, of which 260 were confirmed, 123 discarded, and 6 under investigation, in a population of about 74,068 (incidence 351 per 100,000). In 2025, Fernandópolis reported 6,285 dengue cases, so the current year shows roughly a 95.9% decrease. The campaign aims to curb transmission and mosquito circulation during peak breeding conditions.

triage.headline_ja: 保健局、デング熱媒介蚊対策のため160人体制のタスクフォースを動員
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・フェルナンドポリス市における例年の雨季前のデング熱・チクングニア熱予防的蚊対策であり、前年比95.9%減少と状況は改善傾向にあるため、特段のシグナルとは判断されない。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。症例数は前年比で大幅減少しており、通常の季節対策の一環と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Detectaron una nueva variante de COVID-19 en Argentina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new COVID-19 variant detected in Argentina.
article.articleSummary: Argentina's National University of La Plata scientists confirmed a new SARS-CoV-2 lineage, PJ.2.1, descended from Omicron, identified in three hospitalized patients in Buenos Aires Province. The cases include a 58-year-old adult and two infants (1 and 2 months). Genomic sequencing at UNLP's Public Health Laboratory confirmed PJ.2.1. The World Health Organization lists PJ.2.1 as a variant under surveillance, with rising detections in Canada, the United States, and Brazil. WHO notes higher transmissibility but low public health risk, though data on disease severity are limited. Symptoms resemble cold/flu: fever, cough, sore throat, nasal discharge. Vaccines remain protective; neutralization demonstrated by antibodies from variant-adapted vaccines LP.8.1 and XFG. Emphasize vaccination completion, especially for older adults, immunocompromised individuals, pregnant women, and other high-risk groups; infants under six months have maternal antibodies.

triage.headline_ja: アルゼンチンで新たなCOVID-19変異株を検出
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPJ.2.1を監視対象変異株としているが公衆衛生リスクは低いと評価しており、重症度や感染拡大の実態について情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアルゼンチンでの新変異株PJ.2.1の検出であり、アルゼンチンは対象国リストに含まれない。ブラジルは他国での検出増加傾向の文脈で言及されているのみで、記事の主題ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo é a doença mais transmissível do planeta e está de volta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles is the most contagious disease on the planet and it's back.
article.articleSummary: Measles: United States loses measles elimination status after a 12-month circulation, per PAHO. As of November 5, 2026, CDC records 5,182 confirmed cases and 10 deaths in the U.S., more than double 2025’s total. Mexico is under review; Guatemala reports the Americas’ largest outbreak with 34,748 cases and 53 deaths. Across 17 countries/territories in the Americas, 57,666 cases and 81 deaths are recorded, up 4.7-fold versus 2025 and the worst year since 2004. Brazil, having regained elimination status in 2024, shows fragility in 2026 with a 71% rise in confirmed cases; São Paulo and Amazonas account for 95% of notifications. First-dose MMR reaches 94.66% coverage for children under one year; second-dose coverage drops to 79.78% (Jan–Aug 2026), with 3,589 municipalities and about 65% of cities below 95%. Measles remains highly contagious; prevention hinges on high, uniform vaccination and vigilant surveillance to contain imported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹は地球上で最も感染力の強い疾患であり、再び流行している
triage.triage_reason: 米州全体で麻疹が急増（前年比4.7倍、2004年以降最悪）しており、ブラジルでも71%の症例増加とワクチン接種率の地域的低下が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事は米州全体（米国、グアテマラ、メキシコ、ブラジル等）の麻疹流行状況を報告しているが、対象国リストに該当するのはブラジルのみ。ブラジルはサンパウロ・アマゾナス州で95%の症例が集中し、2回目MMR接種率が79.78%と低く、65%の自治体が95%未満のカバー率にとどまる点が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta por una nueva variante de Covid en Argentina: la detectaron en tres pacientes de Buenos Aires
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning about a new COVID-19 variant in Argentina: it was detected in three patients from Buenos Aires.
article.articleSummary: SARS-CoV-2 PJ.2.1 lineage, an Omicron descendant, detected in Argentina with three hospitalized cases in Buenos Aires Province. UNLP researchers identified PJ.2.1 in samples from two infants (one and two months old) and a 58-year-old adult. Confirmation came from the Public Health Laboratory, Genomics and Molecular Diagnostics Area of the Faculty of Exact Sciences at the Universidad Nacional de La Plata, which performed sequencing. The World Health Organization has classified PJ.2.1 as a variant under surveillance due to rising circulation in the Americas, with detections mainly in Canada, the United States, and reported cases in Brazil. Clinically, PJ.2.1–associated symptoms resemble common cold or flu: fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose. The WHO assessment notes a higher transmissibility but insufficient comparative clinical data to confirm increased severity. Ongoing genomic monitoring will show its evolution in Argentina.

triage.headline_ja: アルゼンチンで新型コロナウイルスの新変異株を警戒：ブエノスアイレスの3人の患者から検出
triage.triage_reason: WHOが監視下に置く新変異株PJ.2.1がアルゼンチンで検出され、米州（カナダ・米国・ブラジル）でも報告があり国際的拡大の兆候があるため、継続監視としてフルRRAに進める。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアルゼンチン（対象国外）での検出だが、WHOの評価でブラジルでも症例が報告されている旨が明記されているため、Brazilのみ対象国として記録。アルゼンチン自体は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。症状は軽度（感冒様）だが伝播力増加の可能性がありWHOが監視対象としている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Goiânia: Parques Atheneu, Pedro Ludovico e Jd. Novo Mundo estão no topo das notificações de dengue - Fala Canedo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Goiânia: Parques Atheneu, Pedro Ludovico and Jardim Novo Mundo are at the top of dengue notifications - Fala Canedo.
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreaks in Goiânia, Goiás, Brazil show 35,054 confirmed dengue cases in Goiânia from January to mid-November 2023, with the state reaching 114,356 cases—up 21.48% from 94,137 prior year. Parque Atheneu leads with 99 dengue notifications in the four weeks before the Nov 19 bulletin; Setor Pedro Ludovico has 47, Jardim Novo Mundo 42. The state recorded 99 dengue deaths, Goiânia accounting for 35; Jataí, Aparecida de Goiânia and Inhumas follow. Dengue serotype 3 is most common; El Niño and the re-emergence of serotype 3 are cited as factors. Chikungunya is rising too (2022: 1,901; this year: 11,389). The city launched inspections of vacant properties to remove mosquito breeding sites; 23–26 Nov mobilization, Day D on 27 Nov. From Jan–Nov, 2.4M residences visited; 52,525 breeding sites eliminated; 78,285 larvicides applied; 1,052 locations to be inspected by March 2024. Preventive measures: eliminate standing water, seal water tanks, weekly checks.

triage.headline_ja: ゴイアニア：アテネウ公園、ペドロ・ルドヴィコ、ジャルジン・ノヴォ・ムンド地区がデング熱通知件数トップ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ゴイアス州における季節性・地域的なデング熱/チクングニア熱の流行報告であり、既知の風土病で地元自治体が対策（蚊の繁殖地駆除等）を実施中。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱・チクングニア熱はブラジルで毎年流行する既知の媒介性感染症であり、本記事はゴイアス州の地方自治体による通常の疫学速報・対策報告。国際的な公衆衛生リスクの兆候は見られないためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni : une école instaure l'enseignement alterné pour limiter les risques de contamination - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: a school implements alternating teaching to limit the risk of transmission - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Beni, North Kivu, in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, prompts the Wasomi private school to adopt an alternating attendance system to limit transmission. Classes are restructured to halve or third the number of students per session, with preschool, primary (grades 1, 3, 5, 6), and secondary all participating in staggered schedules. Under the plan, students who studied today stay home tomorrow for independent work, with rotations continuing until the end of the first term. Each child must have a personal hand sanitizer; parents are urged to reinforce barrier measures and physical distancing at home and avoid crowded or high-risk places such as funerals, birthday or wedding ceremonies, and hospitals. Four weeks remain in the first term of 2026-2027—two weeks of classes and two weeks of periodic exams. The provincial Director of National Education rejected temporary suspension, arguing schools better protect pupils than home isolation.

triage.headline_ja: ベニのエボラ出血熱：ある学校が感染リスクを抑えるため交代制授業を導入 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCベニ地域でのエボラ出血熱流行が継続しており、学校での感染対策措置（交代制授業）が導入されるなど公衆衛生上の深刻な対応が取られているため、フルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事はベニ（北キブ州）における既存のエボラ流行を前提とした学校での対応策に関するもの。流行の規模・致死率・症例数などの詳細情報は本文に記載なく不明。続報で感染状況の詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Academy alerts Nigerians as new COVID-19 variant spreads globally
article.articleSummary: PJ.2.1 is a new COVID-19 variant (descendant of Omicron JN.1) first detected in Ontario, Canada, on May 2, 2026, with reports across the United States, Canada, Spain, France, the Netherlands, Israel, Singapore, Brazil, Argentina, Australia and New Zealand; WHO counted sequences in 18 countries as of November 8, 2026. The WHO classifies PJ.2.1 as a Variant Under Monitoring with a low current global public health risk. Preliminary data suggest potentially higher transmissibility than some Omicron sub-lineages, but no evidence of increased severity. Early lab findings indicate existing vaccines remain effective, with antibodies from updated vaccines able to neutralise it. Symptoms resemble cold/flu: sore throat, fever, cough, runny or blocked nose, fatigue, headache, muscle aches, chills; some cases with severe sore throat and prolonged fatigue. No public Nigeria cases; Nigeria’s NCDC maintains routine surveillance; genomic sequencing limitations noted. Preventive guidance includes testing, masking, ventilation, staying home when unwell, and monitoring travellers for 10 days post-arrival.

triage.headline_ja: アカデミーが新型COVID-19変異株の世界的拡大についてナイジェリア国民に警告
triage.triage_reason: WHOがVariant Under Monitoringに分類し公衆衛生リスクは低いとしているが、伝播性上昇の可能性があり国際的な拡大が確認されているため継続監視が妥当。対象国での症例報告はなく、ピックアップ基準には達しない。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリアへの注意喚起が主題だが、ナイジェリア国内での症例は報告されていない。対象国リストの中ではブラジルが発生国として言及されているため記載。重症度増加の証拠なく、ワクチンは有効とされる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Nord-Kivu : des contaminations hospitalières évoquées parmi les cas traités à Beni - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in North Kivu: Nosocomial Transmissions Mentioned Among Cases Treated in Beni - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with nosocomial transmissions reported among patients treated at the Ebola Treatment Center of the reference general hospital in Beni. Dr. Jérémie Muhindo, medical director, says most cases arise from infections within healthcare facilities, including a fracture patient allegedly contaminated during massage-related care. He underscores lapses in infection prevention and control (IPC) as the primary risk. To address public concern, he notes that seeking care after an accident does not automatically mean Ebola, but care delivered without IPC can transmit the virus. The ETC reports patient recoveries and notes the use of specific therapeutic molecules since early November, hopeful for improved outcomes. Ebola spreads via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids and contaminated objects; strict IPC in health facilities remains essential to prevent nosocomial transmission as of 23 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州のエボラ出血熱：ベニで治療された症例の中で院内感染が指摘される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の院内感染（院内感染対策の不備）が報告されており、医療施設内での感染拡大リスクが懸念されるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 記事は北キブ州ベニのエボラ治療センターにおける院内感染（医療施設内感染対策の不備）に焦点を当てている。既存のDRCエボラ流行の一部であるが、IPC不備による新規感染リスクの増大が懸念される。国際的拡大や渡航制限への言及はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Variante da Covid-19 responde por 58% das amostras no Rio de Janeiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 variant accounts for 58% of samples in Rio de Janeiro.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 variant PJ.2.1 accounted for 58% of sequenced samples in Rio de Janeiro between Oct 17 and Nov 6, 2026, with 96 of 167 genomes identified by IOC/Fiocruz in collaboration with the Rio de Janeiro Municipal Health Secretariat. Genomic surveillance by IOC's Laboratory of Respiratory Viruses, Exanthematics, Enteroviruses and Viral Emergencies fed data to GISAID and integrated with Fiocruz's Genomic Network and the Ministry of Health. The World Health Organization classifies PJ.2.1 as a variant under monitoring to track genetic changes that could affect transmissibility or disease severity; this does not imply an automatic increase in danger. PJ.2.1 was first detected in Canada in May 2026 and reached Brazil in late August; besides Rio, confirmed in São Paulo, Espírito Santo, Distrito Federal, Rio Grande do Sul, and Santa Catarina. In Rio, PJ.2.1 surpassed Omicron sublineages RF.5 (22%) and XFG (11%), underscoring the importance of genomic surveillance for public health decisions.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19変異株がリオデジャネイロのサンプルの58%を占める
triage.triage_reason: WHOがモニタリング対象variantとして分類しているに過ぎず、重症度や伝播性の増加を示す情報はなく、通常のゲノムサーベイランス報告に留まる。
triage.notes: PJ.2.1はWHOの『監視下の変異株』であり危険性増加を意味しないと明記されている。ブラジル国内の複数州(サンパウロ、リオ、サンタカタリーナ等)で確認されているが、重症化や感染拡大リスクの明確な報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Foz notifica cinco imóveis em ação contra a dengue no Porto Meira, Profilurb e Morumbi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Foz do Iguaçu City Hall notifies five properties in a dengue-control operation in Porto Meira, Profilurb and Morumbi.
article.articleSummary: Five properties in Foz do Iguaçu's Porto Meira, Profilurb and Morumbi were notified during a dengue-control operation on Wednesday, part of the Semana de Mobilização de Combate à Dengue. In two sites evaluators found dengue mosquito foci; in the other three the issues were lack of cleaning and maintenance. Access was denied at some properties, enabling forced entry under Federal Law 13.301/2016 to locate breeding sites and curb the mosquito. The campaign, launched on Monday Nov 16, includes CCZ visits, educational activities, and a cleanup drive in the Eastern Region. The municipality reports 4,556 dengue notifications and 46 confirmed cases in Foz do Iguaçu; there have been no dengue deaths since 2024. The Wolbachia-method second phase, started in August, continues in 28 neighborhoods. Residents should keep yards clean, dispose of trash properly, and remove water-holding containers. Report suspected foci to CCZ at (45) 2105-2828, Ombudsman at 156, or via e-Ouve.

triage.headline_ja: フォス市役所、ポルト・メイラ、プロフィルルブ、モルンビ地区のデング熱対策活動で5件の不動産に通知
triage.triage_reason: 通常の自治体によるデング熱対策活動の一環であり、死亡例もなく、異常性・国際的拡大リスク・社会的関心の高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による定期的なデング熱媒介蚊対策活動の報道であり、2024年以降死亡例なし。ウォルバキア法による対策も進行中で管理状況は良好。

article.articleHeadline: Alert for Kazakh tourists: Dengue cases surge in Vietnam's Da Nang
article.articleSummary: Vietnam's Da Nang records 2,219 new dengue cases (Nov 16–22), a 15% week-over-week rise, bringing 2026 total to over 12,500 — about 3.7 times the same period last year. Ngu Hanh Son remains the epicenter with 1,363 cases since January, including 230 in the latest week; An Khe, Dien Ban Dong and Son Tra are also affected. The city logged 86 new infection clusters in the past week, for an annual total of 796 — roughly fivefold higher than last year. Da Nang CDC urges decisive local action and public cooperation to curb transmission. U.S. CDC advises travelers to Vietnam to use insect repellent, wear long sleeves, and stay in air-conditioned or screened accommodations, noting dengue transmission by Aedes mosquitoes and typical symptoms (high fever, severe headache, pain behind the eyes, muscle/joint pains, nausea, rash).

triage.headline_ja: カザフスタン人観光客への警告：ベトナム・ダナンでデング熱症例が急増
triage.triage_reason: ダナンでのデング熱症例が前年同期比約3.7倍に急増し、クラスター数も約5倍に増加するなど異常な拡大傾向があり、現地当局・報道の関心も高いため。
triage.notes: 死亡例や重症例の報告はなく、現地CDCの対応で管理されている模様。米国CDCは旅行者向けの予防策を案内しているのみで、国際的な拡大・渡航制限は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Quinze nouveaux cas confirmés d'Ebola, portant le cumul à 3188 au Nord-Kivu - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fifteen new confirmed Ebola cases, bringing the total to 3,188 in North Kivu.
article.articleSummary: North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo—The 17th Ebola outbreak in Nord-Kivu continues. Fifteen new confirmed cases were recorded, bringing the provincial total to 3,188. Seven of the new confirmations were in the Beni health zone; other new cases were reported in Masereka, Mutwanga, Kyondo, Kalunguta, Butembo, Oicha, and Katwa. Cumulative deaths reached 1,912 (case fatality ~60%), with 466 recoveries. Active cases stand at 750; 60 patients were discharged from care without medical authorization. Two probable cases were reported (Kyondo and Beni). On Nov 20, 288 suspected cases were identified, including 74 deaths; 149 samples were collected. Among 16,401 active contacts, 12,763 were followed (78%). The outbreak affects 17 of 34 health zones across 211 health areas of 684 in Nord-Kivu. Vigilant case finding and contact tracing remain central to the response.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州でエボラ出血熱の新規確定症例15件、累計3,188人に
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州で進行中の第17次エボラ流行が継続しており、致死率約60%、累計死亡者1,912人、活動中症例750人という深刻な公衆衛生上の影響とヒト-ヒト感染拡大のリスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: 第17次エボラ流行は17保健ゾーン・211保健地区にまたがり継続中。接触者16,401人中12,763人（78%）の追跡が行われているが、無許可退院例も60件あり、感染拡大・管理の両面で懸念が残る。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief says fighting near Congo Ebola outbreak area disrupts response efforts
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered near a hospital in Ituri province, is hindered by heavy fighting that forced health workers and aid partners to shelter inside a maternity ward for more than 24 hours. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said attacks across eastern Congo have escalated since late October, severely compromising the response and putting patients, families, and healthcare staff at grave risk. The agency is coordinating with humanitarian partners to secure a safe exit for trapped staff and is calling for protection of hospital workers, patients, and facilities. Six months after the outbreak was first declared on May 15, the outbreak remains out of control, with case numbers and deaths rising. Government data show more than 11,000 infections and over 5,500 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、コンゴのエボラ流行地付近での戦闘が対応活動を妨げていると発言
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（感染11,000人超、死者5,500人超）が武力紛争により対応困難となっており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が直接言及していることから国際的関心が高く、紛争により対応が阻害されている点が特に深刻。致死率約50%と極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Cambodia Confirms First Mpox Case in 30 Months
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) has been confirmed in Cambodia—the first case in about 30 months—after a patient tested positive on 20 November 2026 and hospitalized, with official confirmation on 22 November 2026. No details on the patient’s age, sex, nationality or location were released, and the infection source and close contacts have not been disclosed. Cambodia previously recorded 20 mpox cases from December 2023 to May 2024. The health ministry urged vigilance to prevent clusters; no vaccination measures were announced for this case. Key symptoms include a blistering rash (face, limbs, body, eyes, mouth or genitals) with fever, swollen lymph nodes, headache, muscle aches and fatigue. Mpox spreads mainly through close or sexual contact, not brief casual contact; most people recover in weeks, though young children, pregnant women and immunocompromised individuals are at higher risk. Thailand in 2026 reported clade Ib predominance, with 1,074 cases and 16 deaths by May 2026.

triage.headline_ja: カンボジア、30か月ぶりにMpox感染例を確認
triage.triage_reason: カンボジアで約30か月ぶりとなるMpox症例が確認され、感染源や接触者が不明なままヒト-ヒト感染拡大の懸念があり、WPRO基準の複数項目（異常性・曝露継続・流行しやすさ）に該当し政府の警戒発表もあるため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はカンボジアの新規Mpox症例だが、カンボジアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。タイについては2026年のclade Ib流行状況（1,074例・16死亡）が具体的事実として言及されているため対象国として計上した。患者の詳細（年齢・性別・感染源・接触者）は未公表であり、重症度や管理体制の評価には追加情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Áncash: dengue deja ocho víctimas mortales, entre ellas una gestante de 32 semanas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Áncash: dengue leaves eight dead, including a 32-week pregnant woman.
article.articleSummary: Dengue continues to claim lives in the Áncash region, with eight deaths in 2026 among 3,843 cases (confirmed and suspected). A 32-week pregnant woman died at Hospital Regional Eleazar Guzmán Barrón in Nuevo Chimbote after severe dengue complications. She was referred from Hospital La Caleta de Chimbote and died in the early hours of Sunday despite multidisciplinary care from obstetrics, intensive care, and other services. Santa and Casma provinces register the highest case numbers. The regional health directorate, Diresa Áncash, notes that severe dengue cases persist, including pregnant women, postpartum women, and children, who are particularly vulnerable. Among the fatalities is an 11-year-old child, and the latest fatality is the pregnant patient. The hospital says it continues to treat severe dengue cases, including those in vulnerable groups.

triage.headline_ja: アンカッシュ:デング熱で8人死亡、32週の妊婦も含まれる
triage.triage_reason: 記事はペルー・アンカッシュ州でのデング熱流行に関するものであり、対象国（フィリピン等）での発生ではないため対象外。
triage.notes: 発生地域にPhilippinesが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はペルー・アンカッシュ州でのデング熱流行であり、フィリピンに関する言及はないため対象国に該当する地域なし。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Des élèves sensibilisés à leurs droits et à la prévention contre Ebola à Lubero
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Students educated about their rights and Ebola prevention in Lubero.
article.articleSummary: In Lubero-Centre, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, pupils from Ufahamu and Masemi primary schools received education on their rights and Ebola prevention. The event, held on World Children's Day (20 November 2026) and organized by the Collectif féminin pour l'innovation et la stabilisation (CFIS), highlighted school-based hygiene barriers and Ebola prevention practices. CFIS distributed handwashing kits and liquid soap samples produced by its women’s group under the Inuka Mwanamuke project. Joselyne Nzenze Mutsumbirwa, CFIS coordinator, said the initiative also aims to empower children as sensitization messengers within their families and communities, including those from conflict-affected areas and some internally displaced. The 2026 World Children's Day theme was 'Mon monde, mes droits, mon avenir'.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：ルベロで児童が権利とエボラ予防について教育を受ける
triage.triage_reason: 実際のエボラ発生や症例報告ではなく、学校での予防啓発・衛生教育活動に関する記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラの実際の症例発生ではなく、NGOによる学校での予防啓発活動の報告。疾患名にEbolaが付与されているが、感染イベントではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Adinkes: Butuh kolaborasi lintas sektor untuk eliminasi malaria di Mimika - ANTARA News Papua Tengah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Office: Cross-sector collaboration needed for malaria elimination in Mimika Regency - ANTARA News Central Papua
article.articleSummary: As of 23 November 2026, cross-sector collaboration is essential for malaria elimination in Mimika Regency, Central Papua, Indonesia. The Papua Tengah Health Office (Adinkes) pushes for involvement from government, corporations, banks, and civil society to develop the RAD Malaria Mimika. Fransiska Rahmawati notes that malaria control requires environmental improvements, market management, and better access to health services, not just patient testing and treatment. Non-government partners include CSR-funded companies, banks, BUMD, YPMAK, CHD, PT Petrosea, and Baznas. A two-day multi-sector meeting aims to define roles and produce a joint declaration for malaria elimination in 2027. Mimika is the first Central Papua regency to start the RAD Malaria; TB and HIV/AIDS RADs are planned for 2027. Adinkes promotes social contracting, urging districts to allocate at least Rp50 million to involve civil society; Mimika has earmarked ATM funds in 133 villages (Rp15–20 million per village). Plt. Kepala Dinas Kesehatan Marselino Mameyao stresses broad involvement; IRS has been used, but environmental remediation, water access, waste management, and community engagement are also needed; elimination by 2030 remains the target.

triage.headline_ja: 保健局:ミミカ県でのマラリア撲滅には分野横断的な協力が必要
triage.triage_reason: 通常のマラリア対策・撲滅計画に関する行政的な取り組みの記事であり、突発的な公衆衛生上の脅威や異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: マラリア撲滅に向けた地域行政の継続的な取り組みであり、既存の風土病に対する計画的対策。緊急性・異常性は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Kisangani : les slameurs lancent " Mots Docs " pour soutenir la riposte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kisangani: slam poets launch "Mots Docs" to support the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: On 22 November 2026, Kisangani slam poets launched the 'Mots docs' project to support the Ebola virus disease (EVD) response in Tshopo province, where the outbreak has reached more than 106 people. About a dozen poets performed at Espace des Martyrs in Makiso, promoting prevention under the slogan 'when words save lives.' They conveyed messages through verbs, urging timely care and transparency, with Darcy Bak on stage in a white lab coat and stethoscope. Judith Birungi, a slam poet and law student at UNIKIS, recalled her Bunia-based family’s losses to Ebola, including a young cousin under six. Mots docs, an initiative of Kis Slam—the city’s slam-poet collective—plans to carry the campaign to schools. Organizers lament the lack of backing from health authorities; the project runs on private contributions with no funding to date.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニ:スラム詩人たちがエボラ対策支援のため「モ・ドック」を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCコンゴ・ツショピ州で106人以上の感染者を出しているエボラ出血熱の継続的アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事自体はエボラ対策を支援する市民活動（スラム詩人のキャンペーン）が主題だが、記事中でツショピ州における106人超のエボラ感染者という進行中のアウトブレイクが明示されており、公衆衛生当局からの支援不足も指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Variante PJ.2.1 da Covid-19 responde por 58% das amostras no Rio de Janeiro e entra no monitoramento da OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The PJ.2.1 variant of COVID-19 accounts for 58% of samples in Rio de Janeiro and enters WHO monitoring.
article.articleSummary: PJ.2.1 SARS-CoV-2 accounts for 58% of samples in Rio de Janeiro city (Oct 17–Nov 6, 2026), with 96 of 167 genomes identified by Fiocruz’s Oswaldo Cruz Institute and the Municipal Health Secretariat. The WHO classifies PJ.2.1 as a variant under monitoring, noting genetic changes that could affect transmission or severity but not implying increased danger. Genomic data are deposited in GISAID; besides Rio, the lineage is confirmed in São Paulo, Espírito Santo, Distrito Federal, Rio Grande do Sul, and Santa Catarina. A German study links PJ.2.1 to higher ACE2 binding, with moderate/low immune escape; vaccines in SUS remain protective against severe disease. Symptoms resemble flu: fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose. InfoGripe notes rising COVID-19–related SRAG in early November 2026, though severe cases stay low. Rio de Janeiro receives 350,000 of 1.4 million extra Pfizer doses; nationwide distribution exceeds 22.9 million.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19変異株PJ.2.1がリオデジャネイロの検体の58%を占め、WHOの監視対象に
triage.triage_reason: WHOが監視下に置く新変異株であり拡大状況を注視する必要があるが、重症度増加は否定されており現時点で緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: WHOはPJ.2.1を監視下の変異株に分類したが、危険性増加を示唆するものではないと明記。重症例は低水準にとどまる一方、SRAG報告は増加傾向。ワクチン追加配布が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: gorakhpur news: नवंबर के अंत तक डेंगू का खतरा, हेल्थ डिपार्टमेंट अलर्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gorakhpur News: Dengue Threat by the End of November, Health Department Alert.
article.articleSummary: Gorakhpur, India: Dengue threat remains through the end of November 2026, with the Health Department issuing an alert. From January–November 2026, 123 dengue-confirmed cases have been reported, compared with 184 in the same period of 2025 — a reduction of 61. The festival season (Diwali and Chhath Puja) heightens transmission risk due to increased travel. Dengue spreads when an infected person is bitten by a mosquito, which can then bite another person. In 2026, September saw 34 cases and October 35; in 2025, September 31 and October 29. Early-year trends show relatively controlled numbers, with January 4; February and March zero; April 3; May 4; June 5; July 9; August 19; September 34; October 35; November 10 (to date). December 2025 had three cases. Ongoing surveillance and preventive measures are urged. Dr. Nandlal Kushwaha, CMO.

triage.headline_ja: ゴーラクプルニュース：11月末までデング熱の脅威、保健部門が警戒
triage.triage_reason: 前年より症例数が減少しており、季節性の定例的な警戒情報にとどまるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも該当性が低い。
triage.notes: 2026年の症例数（123件）は2025年同期（184件）より減少しており、地域の季節性デング熱の通常の監視報告と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ'den Kongo için acil çağrı: Çatışmalar Ebola ile mücadeleyi durma noktasına getirdi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Urgent appeal from WHO for Congo: Clashes have brought the fight against Ebola to a standstill.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that clashes in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo since late October are severely hindering Ebola response efforts. In Ituri province, violence around a hospital near the outbreak’s origin has forced aid teams to shelter in the maternity ward for over 24 hours, jeopardizing patients, families and health workers. The WHO is negotiating with warring parties with humanitarian partners to secure safe evacuation and protection for healthcare facilities, personnel and patients, urging the sides to halt fighting and noting that peace is the best medicine. The Ebola virus, a hemorrhagic fever, was first identified in 1976 in Nzara, Sudan, and Yambuku, DRC, and named after the Ebola River near the initial outbreak. In eastern DRC, 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths were reported, with the outbreak declared on May 15; the Bundibugyo variant has no approved treatment or vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ(DRC)に緊急アピール：武力衝突がエボラ対応を停止寸前に追い込む
triage.triage_reason: 東部DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（246疑い例、65死亡、ワクチン・治療法未承認のBundibugyo株）が武力衝突により対応が阻害されており、国際的拡大・公衆衛生への深刻な影響が懸念されるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Nzara(スーダン)、Yambuku(DRC)は1976年の初発地としての歴史的言及であり、現アウトブレイクの発生地ではない。現在の発生地は東部DRC（イトゥリ州周辺）。Burundiは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文に記載なく除外。

article.articleHeadline: Температура под 40 и угроза кровотечения: Опасная лихорадка добралась до российских туристов
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fever below 40°C and risk of bleeding: a dangerous fever has reached Russian tourists.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is spreading among Russian tourists in Vietnam, with at least 30 cases reported this year and a surge in Danang. About ten Russians are hospitalized or treated at home. A Krasnoyarsk woman developed 39°C fever, eye pain, and body aches; dengue was lab-confirmed. Another Russian who contracted dengue in Danang in October had 39.5°C fever, muscle cramps, and a rash, with platelets falling to 92,000/µL. A 41-year-old Tyumen man who returned from Vietnam had fever up to 39.7°C, significant thrombocytopenia, and was hospitalized for five days due to bleeding risk. Vietnamese health authorities report over 170,000 dengue cases and 21 deaths in the first ten months of 2026, with Danang accounting for about 10.7 thousand cases by mid-November, tripling year-earlier levels. Dengue has no specific antiviral; prevention relies on mosquito bite avoidance, and Russia reported 127 imported dengue cases in early 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 40度近い高熱と出血の危険：危険な熱病がロシア人観光客にも到達
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで季節性デング熱が拡大し重症例・死者も報告されているが、毎年起こる既知の流行であり異常性・国際拡大リスクは低い。観光客感染拡大の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア人観光客のデング熱感染事例を中心に報じているが、発生地はベトナム（特にダナン）であり、ロシア国内（クラスノヤルスク、チュメニ）は輸入症例。ベトナム全国で年間170,000例・21死亡、ダナンで前年比3倍の増加が報告されており、流行規模の推移を継続的に確認する必要がある。SFTSウイルスへの言及は記事本文になし。

diseases.name: Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: 全球公衛焦點！波蘭現禽流感、印度瓶裝水檢驗不合格 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global Public Health Focus! Avian influenza detected in Poland; bottled water from India fails inspection - Minshi News Network
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-23, the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) reports Poland, the EU’s largest poultry meat exporter, has detected its first outbreak of highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) in six months, at a turkey farm, amid Europe’s avian influenza seasonal rise. The incident underscores ongoing risk to supply chains, food prices, and concerns about potential human transmission. In India, the national food safety regulator announced that samples from the leading bottled water brand Bisleri failed quality tests, prompting expanded testing across brands and heightened public health scrutiny of drinking water. The report highlights persistent public-health challenges related to animal influenza activity and water safety, with no mention of human cases in the piece.

triage.headline_ja: 世界的な公衆衛生の焦点！ポーランドで鳥インフルエンザ発生、インドのボトル入り飲料水が検査不合格
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザはポーランド（対象国外）での発生であり、インドの件はボトル水の品質検査不合格であって感染症の発生・ヒト感染事例の報告はないため、対象国における感染症シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: ポーランドの鳥インフルエンザは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。インドの事例はボトル水の品質検査不合格に関するものであり、感染症の発生やヒト感染事例とは無関係のため、対象国の感染症シグナルとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Central Visayas logs 21,357 dengue cases, 119 deaths | Carmel Pedroza
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Central Visayas, Philippines, records 21,357 cases and 119 deaths as of morbidity week 45 (Nov 8–14, 2026), with a case fatality rate of 0.6%. Deaths are led by Bohol (42), followed by Cebu province (40), Cebu City (22), Lapu-Lapu City (8) and Mandaue City (7). Infections by area: Cebu province 7,816; Bohol 5,623; Cebu City 4,732; Lapu-Lapu City 1,968; Mandaue 1,218. Within Cebu Province, Talisay City has 916 infections (7 deaths), Toledo 847 (2), Medellin 554 (2). In Bohol, Tagbilaran 610 (5), Talibon 407 (5), Inabanga 405 (1). DOH-7 notes deaths may be reclassified as reported deaths are reviewed and suspected cases included, potentially altering CFR. Emphasizes environmental sanitation to destroy breeding sites; misting alone is insufficient. Encourages the four o’clock habit for community cleanup. Concurrent influenza-like illnesses burden hospitals; early medical consultation urged, especially for children and seniors.

triage.headline_ja: 中部ビサヤ地方でデング熱21,357例、死亡119人を記録
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン中部ビサヤ地方での季節性デング熱流行報告であり、死亡者数は多いが毎年発生する定例的なサーベイランス報告の性質が強く、異常性・国際拡大リスクは低い。国内保健当局が対応中で外部支援要請の記載もないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はフィリピンで季節性に毎年発生する疾患であり、本報告はDOH-7による定例的な週次モビディティ報告。インフルエンザ様疾患の併発も言及されているが詳細情報は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Fighting in Ituri Traps Ebola Responders in DR Congo: WHO
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo persists as heavy fighting near a Ituri hospital disrupts responders. WHO says staff and Ebola responders sheltered in a maternity ward for over 24 hours and calls for immediate safe passage and protection for hospital facilities, staff and patients. The violence accompanies more than 87 attacks on healthcare across DRC since 1 January. Ituri remains the epicentre, accounting for over two-thirds of confirmed cases across eight provinces. By 20 November, the outbreak totals 11,762 confirmed cases and 5,775 deaths across 68 health zones; separate figures cite 11,613 confirmed cases and 5,678 deaths, marking it as the deadliest Ebola outbreak in DRC to date. In Ituri, >8,000 confirmed cases and 3,791 deaths (CFR 47%), with 23 of 39 new cases there. Ongoing insecurity hampers contact tracing, case detection and access to care, with many deaths in communities and outside treatment centres.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:イトゥリ州での戦闘によりエボラ対応要員が孤立(WHO)
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（確認症例11,762件、死亡5,775人、CFR47%）が継続中で、武力紛争により対応活動が妨げられWHOが安全な通行確保を要請している。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: DRC史上最悪のエボラ流行（ブンディブギョウイルス）。イトゥリ州が震源地で全症例の2/3以上を占め、治安悪化により接触者追跡・症例検出・医療アクセスが著しく阻害されている。医療施設への攻撃が年初来87件発生。

article.articleHeadline: OMS alerta de que los combates en el este del Congo dificultan la respuesta al ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns that fighting in eastern Congo hampers the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: Intensified fighting in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is hindering the Ebola response, WHO warns. Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says clashes near a hospital in Ituri have forced health workers to shelter for 24 hours in the maternity ward, disrupting hospital operations and the Ebola response, and increasing risks to patients, families, and health staff. The warning follows reports that the region’s latest Ebola outbreak has killed about 5,700 people. Ongoing armed conflict continues to obstruct access for humanitarian teams, especially in Ituri, where the virus was first detected near the outbreak site. The statement, published on X, underscores the need for peace to restore containment as of 23 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ東部での戦闘がエボラ対応を妨げていると警告
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部での大規模エボラ流行（死者約5,700人）が武力紛争により対応困難となっており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的関心も高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 死者数約5,700人という規模はDRCエボラ流行として極めて深刻であり、武力紛争による対応困難化がWHOにより公式警告されている。国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限については記事内に明示情報なし。

article.articleHeadline: Canaã utiliza drone para mapear possíveis focos do Aedes aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Canaã uses a drone to map possible hotspots of Aedes aegypti.
article.articleSummary: On November 6, 2026, the municipality of Canaã conducted a drone-assisted aerial survey to identify potential hotspots for Aedes aegypti, the mosquito vector of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The operation was carried out in partnership with the Intermunicipal Health Consortium of the Viçosa microregion (CISMIV) and Solo Topografia. Aerial mapping covered multiple areas to locate sites that may favor mosquito reproduction. Findings aim to support health surveillance and guide planning of prevention and control measures against arboviruses in Canaã. In addition to monitoring, the city urged residents to prevent standing water by keeping water tanks sealed, cleaning yards, discarding tires and bottles properly, and inspecting gutters, drains, and plant pots to eliminate containers that collect water. Municipal authorities emphasize ongoing surveillance and community participation in mosquito control.

triage.headline_ja: カナンがドローンを使用してネッタイシマカの発生可能性のある地点をマッピング
triage.triage_reason: 蚊の発生源を特定するためのドローン調査と予防啓発活動の報告であり、具体的な症例報告や異常な公衆衛生事象は確認されない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ミナスジェライス州カナン市における予防的な蚊媒介性疾患対策（ドローン調査・住民啓発）の報告であり、実際の症例発生やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: கேரளாவில் பறவைக் காய்ச்சல் எதிரொலி: கோவை எல்லையில் 12 சோதனைச் சாவடிகள் 'சீல்'; இறைச்சி, முட்டை வாகனங்களுக்குத் தடை
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza fallout in Kerala: 12 inspection checkpoints sealed at the Coimbatore border; meat and egg vehicles banned.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 November 2026, Kerala reports avian influenza (bird flu) in Alappuzha and nearby areas, prompting intensified controls at the Tamil Nadu border. In Coimbatore district, 12 border checkpoints have been equipped for intensified disinfection and surveillance by the Department of Animal Husbandry, with temporary sheds erected and vehicles transporting poultry, meat, and eggs subject to disinfection and monitoring. Chickens and other birds carried by vehicles are under strict scrutiny regarding origin, transit, and destination. Poultry-related vehicles entering Tamil Nadu from Kerala are barred; eggs and poultry meat vehicles coming into Tamil Nadu are not allowed. Authorities are collecting vehicle details and screening for exposure sources. In parallel, Tamil Nadu is issuing biosecurity advisories to goods vehicles moving from Tamil Nadu to Kerala. The objective is to prevent the spread of avian influenza from Kerala into Tamil Nadu via the Coimbatore border and other border points.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州で鳥インフルエンザ拡大の余波：コインバトール県境で12か所の検問所を封鎖、食肉・卵の輸送車両を禁止
triage.triage_reason: 家禽における鳥インフルエンザ発生で動物衛生当局が越境対策を強化しているが、ヒト感染の報告はなく情報が限定的なため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 本記事は家禽における鳥インフルエンザ発生に伴う動物検疫・物流規制が主題であり、ヒトへの感染は言及されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Aumento de casos leva São Paulo a iniciar nova distribuição de vacina contra mpox - Brasil | Portal do Holanda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Increase in mpox cases leads São Paulo to initiate a new mpox vaccine rollout - Brazil | Portal do Holanda
article.articleSummary: São Paulo, Brazil launched a new mpox vaccination rollout on November 23, 2026, distributing 1,000 doses from the National Health Ministry. The initial supply targets priority groups under the National Immunization Program, with 600 doses to the capital and 400 to interior municipalities, allocated per local epidemiology and eligibility. Vaccination is not open to all; eligible groups include people living with HIV/AIDS with significant immunosuppression, PrEP users, laboratory workers exposed to MPXV, and individuals with medium- or high-risk contact with suspected or confirmed mpox cases after health service evaluation. Mpox transmits mainly via close contact with skin lesions, mucous membranes, body fluids, or contaminated objects. Symptoms include skin lesions or vesicles, fever, muscle pain, headache, weakness, and swollen lymph nodes. Preventive guidance emphasizes hand hygiene, not sharing personal items, and seeking medical care if symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: 症例増加を受けサンパウロ州がmpoxワクチンの新規配布を開始 - ブラジル
triage.triage_reason: mpox症例増加を受け保健省主導でワクチン配布が開始されており、HIV陽性者等のハイリスク層への持続的曝露とヒト-ヒト感染の懸念があり、政府（保健省）の関与・関心が明確であるため。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: H5N1 avian influenza case reported in China, in man entering from Vietnam
article.articleSummary: One new human infection with avian influenza A(H5N1) was reported in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, China, during Nov 13–19, 2026, an imported case from Vietnam. The patient is an adult man from Vietnam’s Quang Ninh Province who frequently travels to China for business. He developed symptoms on Nov 1, and during health screening at Dongxing Port on Nov 2 presented with cough, nasal congestion, and runny nose. A border sample tested positive for A(H5N1) in China; Vietnam follow-up testing was negative. As of 2026-11-04, the patient was in stable condition with no fever, cough, or breathing difficulties. Investigators found no known poultry or animal exposure or contaminated environment exposure. Two household contacts in Vietnam remained asymptomatic and tested negative for influenza A (including H5). Worldwide, 1,005 A(H5N1) cases in 25 countries from Jan 1, 2003 to Oct 7, 2026, with 479 deaths (CFR 47.6%).

article.articleHeadline: Mutirão da Limpeza, com foco no combate à dengue, chega a todo o DF a partir desta quarta-feira (25)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cleanup drive, with a focus on dengue control, reaches the entire Federal District starting this Wednesday, the 25th.
article.articleSummary: Dengue prevention drives the Federal District, Brazil, as the rainy season begins. The Municipal Cleaning Service (SLU) launches the first phase of Mutirão da Limpeza on November 25, aiming to reduce Aedes aegypti habitats by removing illegally discarded waste. Initial actions run in Ceilândia, São Sebastião, and Santa Maria, with a district-wide schedule through year-end. The effort, in partnership with regional administrations, emphasizes eliminating standing water and educating residents on proper waste disposal timing. First-stage areas include November 25–28: São Sebastião, Ceilândia, Santa Maria; December 2–5: Paranoá, Itapoã, Samambaia, Recanto das Emas, Riacho Fundo II; December 9–12: Sobradinho, Sobradinho II, Sol Nascente, Gama, Ponte Alta; December 16–19: Planaltina, Ceilândia, Estrutural, 26 de Setembro. No dengue cases reported; the campaign seeks to curb dengue outbreaks.

triage.triage_reason: 記事はブラジル連邦直轄区における予防的な清掃キャンペーンの告知であり、デング熱症例の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の異常事態は確認されない。

article.articleHeadline: Number of Ebola cases in DR Congo exceeds 11,700 -- health ministry
article.articleSummary: As of 23 November 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 11,700 confirmed cases since May 2026, with more than 5,700 fatalities (11,762 cases, 5,775 deaths; 49.1% CFR). The epicenter is Ituri Province, accounting for 68.3% of cases, with 68 of 178 health zones across eight provinces affected. WHO notes the response has expanded but requires scale-up amid rising insecurity; deaths are concentrated in communities outside treatment centers, especially among young children, indicating challenges in early detection and timely care. On 17 November, the IHR Emergency Committee extended the PHEIC; Tedros concurred. The outbreak began 15 May in eastern DRC and Uganda; Uganda’s outbreak ended 28 July (confirmed 25 August). Kenya reported a first case on 6 October, Nigeria on 20 October. The Bundibugyo virus is involved; a vaccine is still in development. Ebola virus disease is severe with ~50% CFR; symptoms include fever, weakness, vomiting, diarrhea, rash, and bleeding; incubation 2–21 days; transmission via direct contact with blood and body fluids.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ症例数が11,700人を超える――保健省
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを延長した大規模エボラ流行で、致死率約49%、複数国への越境拡大が確認されており、IHR基準に複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの感染拡大が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHO IHR緊急委員会はPHEICを延長（11月17日）。

article.articleHeadline: Detectaron una nueva variante de COVID en Argentina: qué se sabe y cuáles son sus síntomas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new COVID-19 variant has been detected in Argentina: what is known and what are its symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Argentina reports a new SARS-CoV-2 lineage PJ.2.1 descended from JN.1 detected through UNLP public health/genomic surveillance in samples from two infants (1 and 2 months) and a 58-year-old adult. The World Health Organization classifies PJ.2.1 as a Variant Under Monitoring; its global share is rising, notably in the Americas with cases in Canada, the United States, and Brazil. WHO assesses low additional public health risk, but confidence in this assessment is limited due to scarce clinical data on severity. Symptoms align with common cold/flu: fever, cough, sore throat, nasal discharge; higher transmissibility may drive spread, especially among high-risk groups. Vaccine sera adapted to LP.8.1 and XFG neutralize PJ.2.1, indicating continued protection. Vaccination should be kept up to date, particularly for older adults, immunocompromised, pregnant, and those with risk factors; infants under six months rely on maternal antibodies. COVID-19 persists, with fluctuating transmission and ongoing variant emergence.

triage.headline_ja: アルゼンチンで新型コロナウイルスの新変異株を検出：判明している情報と症状について
triage.triage_reason: WHOは当該変異株(PJ.2.1)を監視下の変異株(VUM)に分類し追加的な公衆衛生リスクは低いと評価しており、症状も軽度。また主たる発生国アルゼンチンは対象国リストに含まれず、対象国(ブラジル)も周辺的な言及に留まる。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアルゼンチンでの新変異株検出であり、ブラジルは米州における感染拡大国の一つとして言及されているのみで記事の主題国ではないため、対象国としては含めない。アルゼンチン・米国・カナダ・スペインはいずれも本評価の対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Maharashtra Records Nearly 96% Rise In Hepatitis B Cases In Four Years, Climbs To Second Position In National Rankings
article.articleSummary: Maharashtra’s newly detected Hepatitis B cases rose from 9,260 in 2022-23 to 18,122 in 2025-26 (96% increase); Hepatitis C detections climbed from 479 to 864 (80%). The state moved from sixth to second in national Hepatitis B rankings behind Uttar Pradesh (41,819 HBV cases) in 2025-26, after ranking second in 2024-25 with 13,712 HBV cases. HBV figures were 12,250 (2023-24) and 13,712 (2024-25); HCV 695 and 790 in those years. Under the National Viral Hepatitis Control Programme (operational since July 2019), free diagnosis and treatment are provided nationwide, with over 21 crore screened and more than six lakh treated by July 2026 across 1,153 centres. Maharashtra maintains four Model Treatment Centres in Mumbai (Sion Hospital; KEM Hospital), Pune (BJ Government Medical College), Nagpur, and Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar; newborns of HBV-positive mothers receive HBIG and a birth-dose vaccine within 24 hours.

triage.headline_ja: マハラシュトラ州、過去4年間でB型肝炎症例が約96%増加、全国順位で2位に上昇
triage.triage_reason: B型・C型肝炎の症例数増加は主にスクリーニング拡大による検出数増加であり、急性の公衆衛生上の脅威や国際的拡大リスクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 国家ウイルス性肝炎対策プログラムによるスクリーニング拡大が症例数増加の主因と考えられ、アウトブレイクを示す情報はない。慢性疾患の統計報告であり、トリアージ対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Qué se sabe de la nueva variante del COVID que se detectó en Argentina y cuáles son los riesgos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is known about the new COVID-19 variant detected in Argentina and what are the risks?
article.articleSummary: Argentina reports detection of SARS-CoV-2 Omicron sublineage PJ.2.1 in three hospitalized patients in Buenos Aires Province. Sequencing by the UNLP Public Health Laboratory identified PJ.2.1, a descendant of lineage JN.1, signaling ongoing viral evolution but not indicating an imminent surge. Patients include two infants (one and two months) and a 58-year-old adult. No evidence PJ.2.1 causes more severe disease; the finding highlights genomic surveillance and vaccination, especially for vulnerable individuals. WHO classifies PJ.2.1 as a variant under surveillance; risk assessment is limited by sparse clinical data. Symptoms mimic common respiratory infections (fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose). Detections have occurred in Canada, the United States, and Brazil, underscoring regional monitoring. Experts urge vaccination, especially for older adults, and consideration of influenza and pneumococcal vaccines.

triage.headline_ja: アルゼンチンで検出された新型コロナウイルスの新変異株について判明していること、そのリスクとは
triage.triage_reason: 新型コロナの新変異株PJ.2.1がアルゼンチンで検出されたが、重症化リスクの増加は確認されておらず、WHOも監視下変異株としているため、現時点では経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアルゼンチンでのPJ.2.1検出だが、アルゼンチンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブラジルでも検出例が言及されているため対象国として含めた。カナダ・米国は対象国外。

article.articleHeadline: DRC: Nearly 600 cases of cholera, including 7 deaths, reported in one week in South Kivu
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in South Kivu, DRC: During the 46th epidemiological week, 584 cases were reported with seven deaths, up from the previous week by 20. Uvira health zone recorded 64 cases, followed by Bunyakiri (59), Kalehe (55), Fizi (54), and Ibanda (45). The seven fatalities occurred in Mwana (2 deaths) and Shabunda, Uvira, Kitutu, Kamituga, and Kimbi-Lulenge health zones (one each). Ongoing transmission is driven by limited access to clean water, displacement and overcrowding at reception sites, and open defecation. Since the start of 2026, South Kivu has logged 18,942 suspected cholera cases and 325 deaths across 31 of 34 health zones, indicating a persistent province-wide outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：南キブ州で1週間に約600人のコレラ症例、死者7人
triage.triage_reason: 南キブ州で大規模かつ持続的なコレラ流行が継続しており（年間約1.9万症例、325人死亡）、重症度・感染拡大の可能性が高く外部支援の必要性も示唆されるためフルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: コレラはDRCで地方流行性だが、南キブ州全体（34保健地域中31地域）に及ぶ持続的流行であり、清潔な水へのアクセス制限・避難民の過密状態・野外排泄が感染拡大要因となっている。国際的な越境拡大の有無は記事からは不明。

article.articleHeadline: Mujer con 32 semanas de embarazo fallece por dengue en Áncash y es la octava víctima mortal de la enfermedad en la región
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A woman 32 weeks pregnant dies from dengue in Ancash and is the region's eighth fatality from the disease.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Áncash, Peru, with 3,843 confirmed and suspected cases and eight deaths in 2026, highlights transmission concentrated in Santa and Casma provinces. The region recorded its first maternal death: a 32-week pregnant woman who died in Nuevo Chimbote’s Eleazar Guzmán Barrón hospital after two weeks of worsening dengue; she had been referred from La Caleta de Chimbote. The hospital reports severe cases among pregnant women, new mothers, and children. Three ICU patients remained in critical condition, including a child, a pregnant woman, and an elderly person; families sought a helicopter transfer to Lima for another patient, after securing a bed at a national hospital but vowing ambulances unsuitable due to severity. Nationally, dengue fatalities reach 148, with the north bearing most cases (La Libertad >23,000; Piura, Lambayeque; Áncash included). Dengue symptoms include classic fever, headache, and myalgias; hemorrhagic form with bleeding; incubation 5–15 days; Aedes aegypti drives spread.

article.articleHeadline: Detectan nueva variante de COVID-19 en Argentina: cuáles son sus síntomas y qué recomiendan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New COVID-19 variant detected in Argentina: What are its symptoms and what do they recommend.
article.articleSummary: Argentina's Buenos Aires province reports a new COVID-19 variant PJ.2.1, descendant of Omicron, detected in three hospitalized patients. Samples were sequenced by the Public Health Laboratory, Genomics and Molecular Diagnostics Area, Faculty of Exact Sciences, National University of La Plata (UNLP). The cases involve two infants aged one and two months and a 58-year-old adult. The World Health Organization has classified PJ.2.1 as a Variant Under Monitoring due to rising global circulation, with cases also reported in Canada, the United States, and Brazil. Symptoms mirror a cold or flu: fever, cough, sore throat, and nasal discharge. There is currently no clear evidence of increased severity. Vaccination is emphasized, with protection maintained by up-to-date immunization, especially for older adults, immunocompromised individuals, pregnant people, and other high-risk groups; infants under six months rely on maternal antibodies. Continued surveillance and vaccination are urged to prevent complications.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak with 50% death rate is getting worse: Three key reasons why
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in DRC caused by Bundibugyo virus shows 48% fatality: 5,678 deaths among 11,613 cases as of November 17. Declared in May, it is the largest Ebola outbreak on record. The outbreak has crossed into Kenya after Uganda cases, underscoring cross-border transmission risk. Ituri and North Kivu in Congo remain hardest hit, with fighting between government forces and rebels including M23 disrupting care and contact tracing; health facilities have been attacked. WHO Director-General Tedros warned of hospitals where staff sheltered for 24 hours, highlighting disruption to the response. Mistrust of authorities and beliefs in poisoning or witchcraft hinder surveillance, especially in rebel-controlled areas. Rough terrain delays logistics and testing; sample transport once exceeded 1,420 miles to Kinshasa, though decentralized testing in Mongbwalu now yields results in under an hour. By Nov 17, 68 health zones across eight provinces report cases, 48 with new infections in the three weeks.

triage.headline_ja: 致死率50%のエボラ流行が悪化：その3つの主な理由
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行（致死率48%、11,613症例）が進行中で、ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境感染も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境感染が報告されているが、両国は本トリアージの対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。紛争地域（M23反乱軍）による対応妨害、医療施設への攻撃、住民の不信感も流行拡大の要因として挙げられている。

article.articleHeadline: Des slameurs mobilisent leurs textes dans la lutte contre Ebola à
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Slam poets mobilize their poems in the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: In Kisangani, Democratic Republic of the Congo, slam poets mobilize against Ebola virus disease through a public awareness drive. The Kisangani Slam collective launched activities on Sunday, November 22, at Place des Martyrs in Makiso, urging residents to adhere to prevention measures to curb the outbreak. The urban performances emphasize information sharing, with attendees like Seth Tsongo saying he will relay what he learned to others. Slammaster Becky appeals to families to follow protections to shield themselves from the disease, while Loft LM stresses the reality of Ebola and the need to take it seriously. The activities are part of the MODOC project, which aims to use words to save lives and push Kisangani toward becoming Ebola-free.

triage.headline_ja: スラム詩人たちがエボラとの闘いに自作の詩を動員
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国キサンガニで進行中とみられるエボラ流行に対する住民啓発活動（スラム詩人の活動）を報じる記事であり、新規感染拡大や症例数等の具体的疫学情報がないため、現時点ではフルRRAに進める根拠が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行そのものの新規発生報告ではなく、既存流行下での住民啓発活動（MODOCプロジェクト）に関する内容。具体的な症例数・死亡者数・流行規模の記載がなく、エボラ流行の最新状況を示す続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ceará chega a 188 casos de Mpox confirmados; 84% em Fortaleza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ceará reaches 188 confirmed mpox cases; 84% in Fortaleza.
article.articleSummary: Ceará state reports 188 confirmed mpox (monkeypox) cases, with Fortaleza accounting for 159 cases—84% of the total. Officials say Fortaleza remains the main transmission hub; while numbers rise rapidly, authorities do not view it as an epidemic or outbreak but a reemergence of the virus. Mpox symptoms can mimic other viral illnesses early on, but diagnosis centers on skin lesions that progress from spots to blisters to crusts; transmission is mainly through intimate mucosal contact during sexual activity, though airborne droplet transmission is possible albeit less common, and spread can occur while lesions persist. Vaccination is limited to post-exposure groups and immunosuppressed individuals: Ceará has 500 doses, prioritized for recent contacts of diagnosed patients, laboratory workers handling mpox samples, and people with HIV with low CD4 counts. Vaccines are not curative and do not replace public health measures; distribution is determined by municipal health authorities in Ceará.
