triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・セアラ州でMpox症例が急増しているが、当局は『エピデミックではなく再興』と位置付けており、重症度や国際的拡大の情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は性的接触を主な感染経路とするMpoxのローカルな再興を報告。当局はワクチン（500回分）を接触者・免疫不全者等に優先配布しているが、国際的な拡大や重症度に関する具体的データは記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Estudo analisa dengue, zika e chikungunya em cinco municípios do Bico do Papagaio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Study analyzes dengue, Zika, and Chikungunya in five municipalities of Bico do Papagaio.
article.articleSummary: Dengue, Zika, and Chikungunya are analyzed in five municipalities in the Bico do Papagaio region, northern Tocantins, Brazil (Tocantinópolis, Araguatins, Augustinópolis, São Miguel do Tocantins, Nazaré). Conducted by Unitins at Campus Augustinópolis, the subproject aims to analyze temporal trends and the epidemiological profile of arboviruses from 2016–2025, linking cases to climate factors to support surveillance and vector control. Using Sinan/Datasus, IBGE, and Inmet data, researchers will compute standardized incidence rates and apply Poisson or negative binomial regression for trends, STL for seasonality, and climate correlations with 0–3 month lags, presenting results as choropleth maps in QGIS and inter-municipal comparisons. The project, spanning 24 months, will deliver a Technical Surveillance Manual for Bico do Papagaio, clinician and public health workshops, and publish articles. It aligns with UN SDGs 3, 11, and 13.

triage.headline_ja: トカンチンス州ビコ・ド・パパガイオ地域5市町村におけるデング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱の研究分析
triage.triage_reason: 新規の感染症発生事例ではなく、大学による疫学研究プロジェクトの紹介記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2016-2025年のアルボウイルス（デング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱）の疫学的傾向と気候要因の関連を分析する24ヶ月間の学術研究プロジェクトの紹介であり、現在進行中の発生事例の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: mais de 5.600 mortos e falhas dificultam controle na África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: More than 5,600 deaths and failures hinder control in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused 5,678 deaths and 11,613 confirmed cases as of 17 November, with active transmission across 48 health zones. Only 11% of analyzed cases were on monitored contact lists; 89% had not previously been identified as contacts. Since 28 October, more than 60% of deaths (720 total, 452 in communities) occurred outside treatment centers, hindering early detection and interruption of transmission. Armed conflict and displacement worsen surveillance; an attack in Cantine-Aloya disrupted follow-up of 1,000 contacts, heightening spread risk. Five countries have reported cases since May: Congo, Uganda, Kenya, Nigeria, and France; Congo remains the only country with documented community transmission. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; no approved vaccine exists. The WHO is monitoring Ervebo and has recommended two experimental vaccines (Oxford and Moderna) in trials. Control relies on contact tracing, rapid case identification, and access to affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：死者5,600人超、アフリカでの封じ込めに失敗が影響
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で5,000人以上の死者を出すエボラ出血熱の大規模流行が継続し、武力紛争による接触者追跡の阻害や複数国への感染拡大が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にフランス、ケニア、ウガンダ、ナイジェリアが挙げられているが、記事ではコンゴのみが地域内伝播を伴う主要発生国とされており、他国は散発的な症例報告に留まるため対象国リストに該当しないか主題外として除外した。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: H5N1 Bird Flu Confirmed in Dead Crows in Nalanda, Bihar
article.articleSummary: Four dead crows found at the Biharsharif district magistrate’s residence in Nalanda, Bihar, tested positive for H5N1 bird flu. Lab confirmation came from the National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases in Bhopal after samples were routed via Patna and Kolkata. A 12-km surveillance zone around Biharsharif is in force; poultry farms within the radius are tested and monitored, with no infections or abnormal chicken deaths reported. A rapid response team has been mobilized; disinfection is underway and poultry movements are being restricted if needed. A four-member Patna Institute team visited Nov 21 to draft a containment plan. District Animal Husbandry Officer Dr. Rekha Choubey said there are no confirmed farm infections. Officials suspect migratory birds from Siberia introduced the virus to crows, though unconfirmed. Crows’ deaths are an early warning; previous H5N1 outbreaks have occurred in Chennai and Kannur, with Bihar’s Darbhanga noted. Human risk is low but avoid handling dead birds and report unusual deaths.

triage.headline_ja: インドのビハール州ナーランダで死んだカラスからH5N1鳥インフルエンザを確認
triage.triage_reason: 動物（カラス）でのH5N1確認事例であり、人への感染は報告されていないが、監視区域設置など対応が進行中のため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 人への感染例は報告されておらず、家禽農場での感染も確認されていない。渡り鳥（シベリア由来の可能性）がカラスに感染させたと推測されているが未確認。過去にチェンナイ、カンヌール、ダルバンガでもH5N1発生歴あり。

article.articleHeadline: Central Visayas dengue deaths reach 119, surpass 2025 record
article.articleSummary: Dengue deaths in Central Visayas reached 119 with 21,357 cases from Jan. 4 to Nov. 14, 2026, per DOH-7. Cebu Province accounted for 7,816 cases and 40 deaths; within it, Talisay City reported 916 cases and 7 deaths, Toledo City 847 cases 2 deaths, and Medellin 534 cases 2 deaths. Outside Cebu Province, Bohol logged 5,623 cases and 42 deaths—the highest death toll in the region. Cebu City recorded 4,732 cases and 22 deaths; Lapu-Lapu City 1,968 cases and 8 deaths; Mandaue City 1,218 cases and 7 deaths. The case fatality rate is about 0.6% (including suspected cases). Age distribution shows 6–10 years (25%), 21+ (24%), 1–5 (21%), 11–15 (17%), 16–20 (12%), under 1 (2%). Outbreak declarations are LGU decisions; Bohol declared Aug. 25. Environmental factors—warm, humid conditions and potential El Niño–driven water storage—highlight the need for strengthened vector control and early medical care.

triage.headline_ja: 中部ビサヤ地方のデング熱死者数119人に達し、2025年の記録を上回る
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常性の2項目以上に該当し、2025年の記録を上回るデング熱死者数・症例数が報告されているため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: DOH-7（保健省中部ビサヤ地域事務所）による公式統計に基づく報告。Bohol州で最多の死者数(42名)を記録し、気候要因（高温多湿、エルニーニョに伴う貯水行動）が媒介蚊の増加に寄与していると指摘。渡航制限等の情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: РСТ не получал данных о массовом заражении россиян лихорадкой денге во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RST did not receive data about a mass dengue fever outbreak among Russians in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Mass dengue fever outbreak among Russians in Vietnam has not been confirmed, according to Kirill Sgibnev, head of the Russian Union of Travel Industry (RST) Insurance Committee. The RST has no data indicating that at least 30 Russians sought medical care with dengue-like symptoms in Vietnam, and there are no reports from tour operators of illness among organized travelers. Nonetheless, information has circulated that since the start of the year at least 30 Russians contracted dengue fever in Vietnam. Available information also notes isolated confirmed dengue cases imported from Vietnam. As of 23 November 2026, the authorities have not substantiated a mass outbreak among Russian tourists, with only sporadic, imported cases documented.

triage.headline_ja: RST、ベトナムでのロシア人集団デング熱感染に関するデータは受領していない
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでのロシア人観光客間の集団感染は否定されており、散発的な輸入症例のみで、デング熱自体も当該地域の既知の風土病であり新規性・異常性に乏しい。
triage.notes: 記事は『集団感染は確認されていない』という否定報道であり、デング熱自体はベトナムの風土病として既知。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: O que é brucelose? Doença passa a ter notificação obrigatória no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is brucellosis? The disease is now notifiable in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Brucellosis, a bacterial zoonosis transmitted from animals to humans, is now a nationally notifiable disease in Brazil. A portaria published in the Diário Oficial da União on 17 November 2026 requires health services to report cases weekly to surveillance authorities to improve tracking of a disease that is often underreported. Brucellosis is caused by Brucella spp. and is linked to contact with infected animals and consumption of animal products, especially unpasteurized milk and dairy items, as well as raw or undercooked meat; occupational exposure is common among rural workers, veterinarians, slaughterhouse, and dairy workers. Symptoms include fever, profuse night sweats, chills, weakness, weight loss, headaches, and musculoskeletal pain; incubation is typically 5–60 days. Diagnosis relies on culture, serology, or PCR. Treatment uses antibiotics via SUS; prevention emphasizes pasteurized dairy, fully cooked meat, PPE, and biosafety practices.

triage.headline_ja: ブルセラ症とは何か？ブラジルで届出義務化疾患に
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでブルセラ症を届出義務疾患に指定したという行政制度変更の報道であり、アウトブレイクや症例急増の情報はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル保健省による届出義務化の行政措置を伝えるもので、具体的な感染拡大・集団発生の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Indonesian Plants Consumed by Wild Orangutans Inhibit Giardia Parasites in
article.articleSummary: Indonesian plants consumed by wild Sumatran orangutans inhibit Giardia intestinalis in vitro. Field work in North Sumatra near Bukit Lawang and Gunung Leuser National Park shows orangutans increase intake of specific leaves during higher parasite burdens, indicating self-medication. Sixteen plant species’ leaves were collected at ~323 m, dried, ground, and subjected to three solvent extracts (water, methanol, methanol–THF). In vitro assays against active Giardia trophozoites under anaerobic culture revealed inhibitory activity for all species in at least one solvent; four species had IC50 < 1 mg/mL, and eight had no prior biological testing. Giardia intestinalis is globally distributed, with cysts and trophozoites causing giardiasis and GI symptoms; 212 outbreaks were reported between 2004–2016. Metronidazole resistance reported at 30–48% among travelers; concerns over side effects and rodent carcinogenicity. The study links primate behavior to potential antiparasitic drug leads and identifies new botanical candidates for therapy.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアの野生オランウータンが摂取する植物がGiardia寄生虫を抑制することが実験室バイオアッセイで判明
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は学術研究（植物成分の抗寄生虫作用の検討）であり、公衆衛生上の感染症アウトブレイクや新規事例を報告するものではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はジアルジア症の発生報告ではなく、野生オランウータンの自己治療行動と植物由来の抗寄生虫成分に関する学術研究であるため、感染症イベントとしてのシグナル評価対象外。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo inicia semana de mobilização contra a dengue nesta segunda (23)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo kicks off a week of mobilization against dengue this Monday (23).
article.articleSummary: São Paulo state launches a week-long mobilization against dengue starting Monday, November 23, 2026. Dengue is transmitted by the Aedes aegypti mosquito, which also spreads Chikungunya and Zika. The campaign emphasizes preventing transmission by eliminating mosquito breeding sites: regularly inspecting yards and outdoor areas, removing water-collecting containers, and keeping water storage tanks tightly sealed. In 2026, São Paulo reported about 65,000 dengue cases and five deaths. Dengue infection is transmitted by mosquito bites. Common symptoms include high fever, headache, pain behind the eyes, joint pains, and red rash on the body. The article highlights ongoing public health measures to curb transmission during the current campaign in the state.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、月曜（23日）からデング熱対策啓発週間を開始
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は当該地域で流行しており例年の公衆衛生対策の一環だが、2026年に約65,000例・5死亡と一定規模であるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: これは例年実施される公衆衛生啓発キャンペーンの報道であり、新規の異常事態ではない。デング熱はブラジルで地域流行性があるため、通常のサーベイランス対象として注視する。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية : اشتباكات شرق الكونغو الديمقراطية تعطل جهود مكافحة إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Clashes in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo disrupt Ebola response efforts.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that clashes near a hospital in Ituri, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, disrupted Ebola response efforts and forced health workers and relief partners to shelter in a maternity ward for more than 24 hours. The clashes occurred close to the area where the outbreak first emerged and have intensified since late October, severely hampering control measures. WHO is coordinating with humanitarian partners to secure the safe exit of staff trapped at the facility and to protect health workers, patients, and health facilities. Six months after the outbreak was declared, Ebola in eastern DRC remains out of control, with rising infections and deaths. The World Health Organization reported 11,613 confirmed cases and 5,678 deaths as of 17 November.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴ民主共和国東部での武力衝突がエボラ対応活動を妨害
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが6か月経過しても制御不能で、死者・感染者数が増加しており、さらに武力衝突が対応活動を妨害しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHO報告（11月17日時点）で確定症例11,613件、死亡5,678件。紛争により医療従事者・患者が病院内に24時間以上避難を余儀なくされるなど、対応活動が著しく阻害されている。国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限の有無については記事内で言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Offre d'emploi | Chargé de la Sécurité (Safety and Security Officer) (1) GHS Ebola | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Job offer | Safety and Security Officer (1) GHS Ebola | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: ICAP in the DRC seeks a Safety and Security Officer based in Bunia to manage security for operations across Ituri and North Kivu. Reporting to the Administrative & Finance Director, the officer plans travel, monitors security conditions, and implements protective measures for staff, beneficiaries, assets, and program activities. Maintains continuous vigilance on the security context, collecting and analyzing risk information from official alert channels (INSO, OCHA, UNDSS) and producing regular risk assessments. Advises program teams on risk prevention and mitigation; authorizes or escalates field missions as risk levels dictate. Contributes to crisis preparedness and response for health emergencies, including the 17th Ebola virus disease outbreak, ensuring health risks are integrated into security plans. Collaborates with programs, administration, finance, logistics, procurement, authorities, UN agencies, and partners. Note: medical management of Ebola is not part of this role; focus is on risk management and continuity of operations.

triage.headline_ja: 求人情報｜安全・セキュリティ担当者（1名）GHSエボラ | mediacongo.net
triage.triage_reason: これはエボラ対応プログラムに関連する求人広告であり、新規の感染症発生や症例報告ではないため、トリアージ対象のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおける第17次エボラ流行対応に関わるNGO（ICAP）の求人広告であり、新たな症例や公衆衛生事象の報告ではない。既知の流行への言及があるのみで、新規シグナルとしての価値はない。

article.articleHeadline: कौओं की मौत से बर्ड फ्लू की आशंका: जांच के लिए भोपाल भेजे गए सैंपल, चिकन-अंडे पकाकर खाने की सलाह
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu suspected after crow deaths: samples sent to Bhopal for testing, advice to cook chicken and eggs before eating.
article.articleSummary: Bird flu (avian influenza) suspected after crow die-offs near a lake behind a Sai temple in Agar-Malwa, India. Veterinary teams collected birds and sent samples on 22 November to NIHSAD in Bhopal for testing; cause is not yet confirmed, results awaited. A control room has been set up; sanitation measures include fogging and disinfection. Reported avian symptoms include sudden weakness, feather loss, lethargy, swelling around the eyes and neck, watery discharge, and reduced feed and egg production. Poultry farmers are advised to secure enclosures, limit entry, disinfection regularly, and isolate new birds for at least 30 days. Chicken shops should clean facilities, wear masks and gloves, and dispose of waste properly. Citizens should buy from reliable shops and cook chicken and eggs to at least 70°C; avoid raw products. If humans develop fever or respiratory symptoms after contact with birds, seek care and inform clinicians.

triage.headline_ja: カラスの大量死で鳥インフルエンザの疑い：検査のためサンプルをボパールに送付、鶏肉・卵は加熱調理を推奨
triage.triage_reason: インドでカラスの大量死を受け鳥インフルエンザが疑われているが、検査結果待ちで確定診断がなく、人への感染例も報告されていないため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 検査結果未確定の段階であり、鳥（カラス）での疑い事例にとどまる。人への感染報告はなく、現時点では地域当局による対応（防疫・消毒・隔離措置）が行われている。結果判明後の続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: El sector cárnico catalán prevé un 2027 también a la baja, un año después del brote de PPA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Catalan meat sector also foresees 2027 to be down, a year after the ASF outbreak.
article.articleSummary: ASF outbreak in Catalunya remains a major economic drag as authorities mark one year since the first case detected on November 28. Industry leaders say 2026 was negative, with losses around €20 per pig, and expectations for 2027 are similarly grim, especially for SMEs and Barcelona-centric firms hit by regionalization across 19 municipalities. Unió de Pagesos estimates cumulative losses at about €275 million in Catalonia and €1,044 million across Spain; pork price in Mercolleida averages €1.21/kg, about 23.3% below the prior year, while production costs rise to €1.37/kg, producing a net deficit of roughly €0.16/kg (€18.47 per live pig). The downturn stems from ASF-driven market closures abroad, notably China, creating European oversupply and depressed prices. Wild boar density reaches up to 24 animals/km² in high-risk zones, prompting calls to eradicate boars and maintain surveillance; coordination with the Generalitat is praised.

triage.headline_ja: カタルーニャの食肉業界、ASF発生から1年、2027年も低迷を予測
triage.triage_reason: 発生地はスペイン・カタルーニャであり対象国リストに含まれない。中国は市場閉鎖の影響先として言及されているのみで発生国ではなく、動物疾病（ASF）による経済影響が主題のため見送り。
triage.notes: 本記事はスペイン・カタルーニャにおけるASF発生から1年後の食肉産業への経済的影響を扱ったもので、対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン、タイ、ガーナ、DRC、ブラジル、インドネシア、中国、ミャンマー、ベトナム、インド）における発生ではない。中国は輸入規制による市場閉鎖の文脈で言及されているのみ。ヒトへの健康影響もなし。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : des combats près d'un hôpital de l'Ituri perturbent la riposte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Clashes near a hospital in Ituri disrupt the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak in Ituri province worsens as clashes near a hospital interrupt response. The World Health Organization reports the hospital and response teams sheltering in a maternity ward for over 24 hours. As of 20 November, there are 11,762 lab-confirmed Ebola cases and 5,775 deaths across 68 health zones in eight provinces, making it the worst outbreak in the DRC. Ituri remains the epicenter with 8,028 cases and 3,791 deaths (47% fatality), containing over two-thirds of cases and about 60% of new infections; 23 of 39 new confirmed cases are in Ituri. Attacks in Cantine-Aloya in early November killed 66 civilians, including 3 health workers, and disrupted contact tracing for over 1,000 contacts. In Tshopo, a November attack killed a nurse and wounded another, hindering a treatment center’s opening and enabling spread. WHO Director-General Tedros urged protection of health workers and facilities, emphasizing peace as essential to the response.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:イトゥリ州の病院付近での衝突がエボラ対応を妨げる
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最悪規模のエボラ流行（11,762症例、5,775死亡）が継続中であり、武力衝突による対応妨害で国際的拡大・公衆衛生への深刻な影響が懸念されるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が保健従事者・施設の保護を訴えており、紛争により接触者追跡や治療センター開設が妨げられている。史上最悪規模のアウトブレイクであり、致死率47%と極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Puducherry records two dengue deaths in the last few days
article.articleSummary: Two dengue deaths reported in Puducherry over the last few days: a 19-year-old girl and a 23-year-old man. In the first 19 days of November 2026, 46 dengue cases were recorded in the Union Territory, with 43 in Puducherry region and 3 in Karaikal. Year-to-date dengue cases total 1,362 across the UT, and 1,232 of those are in the Puducherry region. Historical counts show Puducherry region recorded 1,625 (2021), 1,673 (2022), 2,790 (2023), 128 (2024), and 902 (2025). October–November 2026 accounted for 721 cases, while September had 151. Pro-tem Speaker A. Anbalagan submitted a memorandum to Chief Minister N. Rangasamy urging enhanced hospital facilities to treat dengue, citing rising cases and inadequate steps. The report emphasizes case totals and official responses, with no infection source details provided.

triage.headline_ja: プドゥチェリーでここ数日デング熱による死亡者が2名確認される
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はインドで季節性の風土病であり、今年の症例数は過去（2021〜2023年）と比べ特に異常ではないが、死者発生と地元議員からの医療体制強化要請があり、今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: プドゥチェリー連邦直轄地における季節性デング熱の地域的流行。年間症例数（1,362件）は過去数年（2021-2023年）と比較して特に突出しておらず、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは見られない。地元議員が州首相に病院体制強化を求める等、行政対応が進んでいる点は注視対象。

article.articleHeadline: Bolivia refuerza la vigilancia ante la detección de nueva variante de COVID-19 en países vecinos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bolivia tightens surveillance in response to the detection of a new COVID-19 variant in neighboring countries.
article.articleSummary: Bolivia intensified epidemiological, clinical, and laboratory surveillance after SARS-CoV-2 sublineage PJ.2.1 was detected in Brazil and Argentina. The World Health Organization added PJ.2.1, a descendant of Omicron, to its routine follow-up on 19 November 2026, noting higher transmission but no evidence of more severe disease or increased hospitalizations; vaccines, testing, and treatments remain effective. Bolivia’s Ministry of Health outlines three measures: (1) intensified monitoring of acute respiratory infections at health facilities, prioritizing entry points and border departments; (2) prioritization of positive samples in national reference labs for genomic sequencing to identify the sublineage; (3) weekly coordination with the nine Sedes, PAHO/WHO, and neighboring countries on cases and hospital occupancy. Preventive guidance emphasizes up-to-date COVID-19 boosters (especially >60, pregnant, health workers, chronic conditions), ventilation, hand hygiene, masking with symptoms, and seeking care for fever, cough, sore throat, or congestion.

triage.headline_ja: ボリビア、近隣諸国で新型コロナウイルスの新変異株検出を受けて監視体制を強化
triage.triage_reason: WHOが新変異株PJ.2.1を監視対象としたが重症化や入院増加の証拠はなく、ボリビアは予防的に監視強化を行っている段階であり、現時点ではフルリスク評価の緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はボリビアの監視強化措置だが、ボリビアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。変異株PJ.2.1の検出地としてブラジルが明記されているため、ブラジルのみを検証済み地域として記載。

article.articleHeadline: Hortolândia intensifica eliminação de criadouros da dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hortolândia intensifies elimination of dengue breeding sites.
article.articleSummary: Hortolândia intensifies dengue control with house-to-house visits by the Zoonoses Surveillance Unit (UVZ) in Amanda Garden as summer nears to curb Aedes aegypti and arboviruses. Jardim Amanda shows a high October larval density index (LDI) of 2.9, medium infestation. Agents inspect residences to eliminate breeding sites and educate residents; UVZ says 80% of breeding sites are inside homes and asks residents to allow entry. Contact UVZ at (19) 3897-3312 or (19) 3897-5974 for scheduling. Prevention guidance emphasizes weekly property checks, especially with the seasonal rise in mosquito activity. Dengue vaccination is available at Basic Health Units (BHUs) from 7:30 to 15:30, with seven units offering extended hours: until 17:30 at Amanda II, Dom Bruno Gamberini, Rosolém, and Santa Clara; until 18:30 at Amanda I, Figueiras, and Horto Park.

triage.headline_ja: オルトランディア市、デング熱媒介蚊の発生源対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 日常的な予防活動・行政広報に関する記事であり、異常な流行拡大や重症事例の報告はなく、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 地域の季節的なデング熱予防・媒介蚊対策活動に関するローカルニュース。流行拡大や重症化の兆候は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Botucatu inicia nebulização veicular contra a dengue nesta terça-feira (24)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Botucatu begins vehicle fogging to combat dengue this Tuesday (the 24th).
article.articleSummary: Dengue control in Botucatu begins vehicular fogging with a biological larvicide as part of the 23–28 November intensification of arbovirus prevention ahead of the National Dengue Fight Day. The operation starts Tuesday, 24 November, with Monte Mor as the first neighborhood, followed by Jardim Yolanda (Wed 25), Jardim Ypê (Thu 26) and Jardim Itamaraty (Fri 27). Fogging runs 8:00–11:00, resumes 14:00, potentially until 18:30 depending on weather. The plan aims to cover at least 33 neighborhoods by the end of 2026, based on October’s Aedes aegypti infestation survey. The larvicide is biological and, when used per guidelines, poses no risk to humans, pets, or non-target insects such as bees. Additional measures include population education, door-to-door visits by Endemic Disease Control Agents, breeding-site elimination, targeted monitoring, and closer integration with Primary Health Care to broaden prevention; community participation remains essential.

article.articleHeadline: China's flu activity reaches moderate level, with three strains circulating simultaneously: reports
article.articleSummary: China reports moderate nationwide influenza activity with three strains circulating: A(H1N1), A(H3N2), and B(Victoria). Northern China shows a sharp rise in flu positivity; southern regions fluctuate, with clustered outbreaks. In Oct, A(H3N2) was dominant; by Nov, A(H1N1) became predominant, A(H3N2) fell below 20%; B(Victoria) remained relatively stable. Coexistence of multiple strains and rapid shifts complicate prevention, as cross-protection is limited, increasing risk of reinfection with a different strain. Li Tongzeng, chief physician at Beijing You'an Hospital, notes that infection with one strain does not preclude others; vaccination is key. The trivalent influenza vaccine offers protection against all three circulating viruses. Antivirals work against A and B, but early diagnosis and prompt treatment are crucial. China stresses boosting annual vaccination rates and science-based public health education; imported/exported cases not specified.

article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola virus disease expertise showcased in Addis Ababa as the Congolese Institute of Public Health (INSP) Director-General Mwamba Dieudonné presented the country's experience at a strategic governance conference running November 22–27, 2026. The discussions highlighted the DRC’s management of the 17th Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain and the central role of INSP and its Public Health Emergency Operations Center (COUSP) in coordinating responses. Participants examined collaboration with the Institut national de recherche biomédicale (INRB) in epidemiological surveillance, diagnostics, scientific research, and field operations. The gathering, aimed at governance, institutional strengthening, and sustainable financing of national public health institutes in Africa, sought to boost financial and institutional autonomy, reduce dependence on external funds, and strengthen Africa’s health sovereignty. Delegations included representatives from DRC, Nigeria, Uganda, Libya, and Sierra Leone.

article.articleHeadline: Veterinary officers educate students on rabies prevention, responsible pet ownership
article.articleSummary: Rabies prevention education was led in Koforidua, Ghana, on Oct 21, 2026, targeting students at Aboabo Methodist JHS, Wawase R/C JHS, Nkurakan R/C JHS and Nkurakan Presby JHS. Veterinary officers warned that rabies is a viral disease almost always fatal once symptoms appear, mainly transmitted by bites or scratches from dogs and cats. Prevention relies on timely vaccination and prompt medical care after exposure. Animal warning signs include sudden aggression, drooling, restlessness, fear of water, varying difficulty swallowing and unprovoked biting; avoid approaching such animals and report them. Dogs and cats should be regularly vaccinated with records kept; vaccination is not a one-off. From January next year, vaccinated pets in Ghana will receive vaccination cards as part of enforcement. Ghana has started free vaccination for 25,000 dogs and cats in identified high-risk areas to eliminate human deaths from dog-mediated rabies by 2030. Emphasising responsible pet ownership and seeking immediate care after bites.

article.articleHeadline: Electron Microscopy Reveals Poxvirus Headquarters
article.articleSummary: Mpox remains a smoldering threat with clusters in Brazil, Thailand, and Austria and ongoing hotspots across multiple African countries. A Nature study by ISTA reveals the poxvirus core as an infection headquarters. Using cryo-electron tomography, researchers captured 3D structures of the viral RNA polymerase complex and a rigid, wall-embedded export portal inside the core. They found the RNA polymerase units are stored as dormant, paired engines, often tethered to viral DNA; upon infection, the pairs dissociate and transcription begins, with mRNA exported through the portal. This coordinated 'production-and-dispatch' pipeline clarifies how infection starts and how viral messages are released, offering antiviral targets and insights for engineering poxviruses for cancer therapies.

triage.notes: 記事はNature誌掲載の基礎研究（ISTA）紹介が主題であり、Mpoxの既存流行状況（ブラジル・タイ・オーストリアでのクラスター、アフリカでのホットスポット）は背景情報として触れられているのみで、新規イベントの詳細（症例数、死亡数、対応状況等）は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Why the Ebola Outbreak Keeps Growing, According to Virus Expert Pardis Sabeti
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo is the second-largest on record, with over 11,000 cases across five countries and more than 5,700 deaths as of Nov. 20. Pardis Sabeti of the Broad Institute notes that conflict-zone conditions—population movement, refugees, poor sanitation, and breakdowns in healthcare—plus reduced surveillance and global funding cuts hinder containment. The outbreak involves multiple Ebola variants, including Bundibugyo, for which no universal diagnostic exists to detect all circulating strains. Stigmatization and secrecy about illness impede public health responses. Operation Outbreak, an education tool simulating outbreak spread, diagnosis, vaccination decisions, and epidemiology, is being used in 27 U.S. states and 20 countries and piloted with the UN, World Health Organization, and the FBI to improve preparedness.

article.articleHeadline: Estado de São Paulo realiza semana de mobilização contra a dengue, chikungunya e Zika | JC Rio Claro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: State of São Paulo conducts a week-long mobilization against dengue, chikungunya and Zika | JC Rio Claro
article.articleSummary: São Paulo state, Brazil, launches a Week of Intensification of Aedes aegypti Control from Monday, Nov 23, through Friday, Nov 27, with a Day D mobilization on Saturday, Nov 28, to boost prevention of dengue, chikungunya and Zika. The initiative by the São Paulo State Health Secretariat (SES-SP) expands public awareness and strengthens vector surveillance and breeding-site elimination across the state. As of 2026, São Paulo reports 64,998 dengue cases and 45 deaths. A web seminar opens the program on Monday, 9:00–12:00, live on the SES-SP CCD YouTube channel, with experts outlining the urban arboviruses scenario and updated vector-control technologies. Regional data are available on the state government arboviruses page. Prevention guidance includes regular yard inspections, eliminating water-collecting containers, keeping water tanks sealed, cleaning gutters, and proper disposal of unused materials to reduce Aedes aegypti breeding.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Bafwasende : une mission conjointe évalue les conditions de reprise de la riposte - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Bafwasende: a joint mission assesses the conditions for resuming the outbreak response.
article.articleSummary: A joint mission in Bafwasende, Tshopo Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, assessed conditions to resume Ebola virus disease response after a suspension of about one month due to vandalism and insecurity. Led by Michel Bakay (provincial Interior Minister) with the Health Minister and humanitarian partners (OCHA, UNICEF, IOM, WHO) alongside the provincial health division, the team aims to restore trust with communities and restart outbreak activities, including surveillance and treatment. The security incident killed two responders and damaged vehicles, equipment, a community relay center, and the Ebola treatment center in Bomili, prompting closures and fear among staff. As of 19 November, Bafwasende reported 20 confirmed Ebola cases and 10 deaths, contributing to a provincial total of 109 cases and 49 deaths. The mission continues consultations to address violence drivers and re-establish safe operations for the response.}

article.articleHeadline: Schaltzentrale des Pockenvirus: Forschende am ISTA entschlüsseln zentrale molekulare Komplexe im Viruskern
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Control Center of the Poxvirus: Researchers at ISTA Decipher Central Molecular Complexes in the Viral Core.
article.articleSummary: Mpox remains a risk with recent local clusters in Brazil, Thailand, and Austria and recurring outbreaks across several African countries, alongside other poxviruses such as Vaccinia and Lumpy Skin Disease. A Nature-published study from the ISTA group led by Florian Schur elucidates the Vaccinia virus core, its transcriptional startup, and a gate-like complex in the core wall that interfaces with the genome. The researchers find two viral RNA polymerases pre-positioned as paired motors, often with additional proteins anchoring them to viral DNA, ready for rapid activation after infection. When the core enters a host cell, these ignition switches release the pairs, initiating transcription of viral genes into mRNA, which is exported through the core wall gates to drive protein synthesis. These insights reveal antiviral targets and enhance the potential to repurpose poxviruses as biomedical tools, including cancer therapies, using Vaccinia as a model.

article.articleHeadline: Kinshasa : environ 200 élèves d'une école sensibilisées à la prévention contre le paludisme - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kinshasa: about 200 students from a school sensitized to malaria prevention - ACP
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo — About 200 students from Institut Bobokoli were sensitized to malaria prevention by the Corps des jeunes dans la lutte contre le paludisme (CJP-Asbl) under the Voix EssentiElles-Paludisme (VE-PALU) project, funded by the Global Fund via Speak-Up Africa. The National Malaria Control Program (PNLP) participated, with messages on transmission, symptoms, and prevention. Emphasis was on proper use of insecticide-treated nets, environmental management, and promptly seeking care for fever, while avoiding self-medication. Students were urged to share messages with families and communities. The session marks the final VE-PALU activity and strengthens youth engagement in malaria prevention. CJP-Asbl, also called the Army of Youth against Malaria, began in June 2022 and officially launched in Kinshasa on 27 November 2023, aiming to mobilize youth (15–35) against malaria, NTDs, HIV/AIDS, and TB, and to promote universal health coverage across 16 provincial coordinations.

article.articleHeadline: Global spread of Ebola virus with no cure is 'still possible', WHO chief warns
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo worsens, with cases exceeding 11,000 and deaths over 5,500, as the WHO Africa regional director warns international spread remains possible. Declared in May after beginning earlier in the year, the outbreak has reached France, Uganda, and Nigeria, and a UK healthcare worker was evacuated after treatment. The outbreak is concentrated in hard-to-reach, conflict-affected Bunia, where transmission surged; authorities report over 3,000 discharged and more than 40 treatment centres now active, though insecurity has hampered response and led to more than 100 attacks on aid workers. There is currently no vaccine for Bundibugyo, though trials are underway; vaccines must be accessible and affordable for low-income countries. The UK has pledged about £78.7 million; calls for fast, flexible funding, capacity building, and safe humanitarian access to about one million displaced in Congo. Global risk remains low but could rise if spread continues.

article.articleHeadline: Animal Husbandry Department steps up vigil at border checkposts in Coimbatore in view of bird flu cases in Keralam
article.articleSummary: Bird flu surveillance intensified along the Tamil Nadu–Keralam border as confirmed cases emerge in Alappuzha district, Keralam. In Coimbatore district, the Animal Husbandry Department has intensified round-the-clock surveillance at 12 major checkposts—Anaikatti, Walayar, Velandavazham, Melbavi, Mulli, Meenakshipuram, Gopalapuram, Semmanampathy, Veerappagoundanpudur, Nadupuni, Zamin Kaliapuram, and Vadakkukadu. Vehicles carrying poultry-related items from Keralam are not permitted; poultry farmers are asked to report any unusual bird deaths. Each field team comprises a Veterinary Assistant Surgeon, a Livestock Inspector, and two Animal Husbandry Assistants. Disinfection is being sprayed on goods carriers entering Tamil Nadu from Keralam, and livestock-feed shipments from Tamil Nadu to Keralam are inspected and disinfected before movement. Advisories have been issued to over a thousand poultry farms in Coimbatore district.

article.articleHeadline: Африка намерена укрепить самостоятельность в борьбе с эпидемиями
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa intends to strengthen its autonomy in the fight against epidemics.
article.articleSummary: At CPHiA 2026 in Addis Ababa, Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya urged African states to assume leadership in continental health security, boosting domestic health financing, building local manufacturing of medicines and equipment, and strengthening national public health institutes. He argued for medical sovereignty: independence from external assistance, accountable governance, and autonomous outbreak response, including emergency preparedness. Africa has progressed: national public health institutes rose from seven to 42, and genomic sequencing capacity expanded from seven to 52 countries. Uganda and Nigeria were cited as examples of rapid Ebola responses—help on the next day after the May 15 outbreak in Uganda, and within two hours of contact from Nigeria's health minister. Ongoing challenges remain in the Democratic Republic of Congo due to instability and safety concerns. Africa CDC is also tightening resource transparency for Ebola funding in DRC and promoting digital transformation and youth involvement.

article.articleHeadline: В РСТ рассказали о ситуации с лихорадкой Денге во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RST briefed on the dengue fever situation in Vietnam
article.articleSummary: As of 23 November 2026, the Russian Union of Travel Industry (RST) reports no data of a mass dengue fever outbreak among Russians in Vietnam. RST official Kirill Sgibnev says there is no confirmation that at least 30 Russians sought medical help with dengue symptoms in Vietnam; according to available information, no requests from tour operators about cases among organized tourists. However, this does not rule out sporadic infections among independent travelers. By contrast, the Telegram channel SHOT Checking claimed a dengue fever outbreak among Russian tourists, reporting at least 30 Russians with dengue-like symptoms in Vietnam since the start of the year, with local doctors noting a sharp rise in patients and bed shortages in some hospitals. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes; there is no specific antiviral therapy, and complications can occur after fever subsides. Earlier, a Russian tourist contracted a dangerous infection in Vietnam.

article.articleHeadline: 23.11.26 - Vietnam: Dengue-Ausbruch in Da Nang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 23.11.26 - Vietnam: Dengue outbreak in Da Nang.
article.articleSummary: Da Nang, Vietnam reports a dengue outbreak, with 2,219 new cases in the week of 16–22 November, a 15% rise from the prior week. Since January 2026, more than 12,500 dengue infections have been recorded, about 3.7 times higher than the same period last year. The hardest-hit area is the Ngu Hanh Son district, accounting for 1,363 cases this year, including 230 in the latest week; other affected areas include An Khe, Dien Ban Dong, and Son Tra. The number of outbreak clusters rose, with 86 new districts identified in the past week, bringing the yearly total to 796—roughly fivefold the previous year. The U.S. CDC warns travelers to the region about dengue; protection relies on avoiding mosquito bites. Vietnam has faced dengue for decades, with major nationwide epidemics in 2019 and 2023, and cycles roughly every 3–4 years.

article.articleHeadline: WHO Sounds Alarm As Fighting Disrupts Ebola Response In Eastern DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Violence near a hospital in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, forced Ebola responders to shelter inside a maternity ward for more than 24 hours. The World Health Organization appealed for an immediate end to fighting that disrupts the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in the country, now spreading across Ituri and North Kivu. As of November 17, the outbreak had 11,613 cases and 5,678 deaths. Ongoing hostilities hinder hospital operations, treatment, contact tracing, and the safe movement of patients, undermining containment efforts. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said arrangements were being made for a safe exit for the medical team and called for guarantees of protection for the hospital, staff, and patients. The security crisis compounds a response already strained by years of conflict, including clashes with the Rwanda-backed M23 group and ISIL-affiliated attacks in North Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが警鐘：コンゴ民主共和国東部で戦闘がエボラ対応を妨害
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大・最も致死率の高いエボラ流行（11,613症例、5,678死亡）が継続中で、武力紛争により対応が妨げられWHOが警鐘を鳴らしており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ルワンダは発生地域として付与されているが、記事本文はDRC（イトゥリ州・北キブ州）での流行とそこでの紛争による対応妨害を主題としており、ルワンダでの発生は言及されていないため除外。ルワンダは対象国リストにも含まれない。致死率は約49%と極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Contre le virus Ebola, un essai évalue l'efficacité de médicaments pour empêcher la contamination chez les personnes contacts à haut risque
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Against the Ebola virus, a trial evaluates the effectiveness of drugs to prevent infection among high-risk contacts.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo species began in May 2026 in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with spread to Nigeria and Kenya. By early October 2026, the epidemic had surpassed 8,000 confirmed cases and 4,000 deaths. Unlike Ebola Zaïre, Bundibugyo currently lacks approved vaccines or specific treatments. In response, the EBO-PEP trial was launched in the DRC on July 16, 2026 to test whether the antiviral obeldesivir can prevent infection if given immediately after high-risk exposure, i.e., post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP). The trial targets protecting highly exposed contacts, interrupting transmission, and strengthening future outbreak response. High-risk contacts include those with direct contact to symptomatic patients, contact with Ebola-deceased bodies, or needle-stick exposure. Concurrent vaccine and therapeutic trials for patients are also underway. Obeldesivir is developed by Gilead Sciences. The outbreak is designated a WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern and an Africa CDC continental emergency.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスに対し、高リスク接触者への感染を防ぐための薬剤の有効性を評価する試験
triage.triage_reason: WHO PHEICおよびアフリカCDC大陸緊急事態に指定された大規模エボラ（ブンディブギョ種）アウトブレイクであり、複数国に拡大、8000例超・死者4000人超と深刻な公衆衛生インパクトを有するためフルRRAへ進むべき案件。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC、ウガンダ、ナイジェリア、ケニアへの拡大を報じているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないブンディブギョ種によるアウトブレイクで、曝露後予防薬（obeldesivir）の臨床試験がDRCで実施されている点が記事の主題。

article.articleHeadline: Affenberg-Chef reist trotz Ebola in den Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Affenberg director travels to the Congo despite Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Despite an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, primatologist and director of Affenberg Salem Bonobos, Roland Hilgartner, plans a January expedition to photograph bonobos in the Congo. The initial two days in Kinshasa—where supplies and gear must be secured—are described as the riskiest phase, including potentially chaotic cash exchanges. Once a mission aircraft transports him to the expedition site, he says he will feel safer. He is traveling in a region of the country with fewer Ebola cases. He cites family as a motive to return safely. He spoke about his plans at the Long Night of Books in Überlingen, presenting his book Das Geheimnis der Tränentrinker and his multimedia show Dschungelwelten, which recounts expeditions in world rainforests and the fragility of ecological balance.

triage.headline_ja: アフェンベルク園長、エボラ流行にもかかわらずコンゴへ渡航
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行自体は既知の事象であり、本記事は個人の渡航計画を扱う人間関心記事で新たな疫学情報（症例数・拡大状況等）を含まないため、現時点ではフルRRAに進むだけの具体的シグナルは不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はドイツの霊長類学者の個人的渡航計画に関する人間関心記事であり、DRCのエボラ流行自体についての新規疫学データ（症例数、致死率、地理的拡大等）は含まれていない。ドイツ・インドの地名は発生地域データのノイズと判断し除外。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Bird flu prompts Hong Kong ban on poultry products from multiple overseas regions
article.articleSummary: Bird flu (avian influenza) prompts Hong Kong to suspend imports of poultry meat and products, including eggs, from areas in Canada, the United Kingdom, the United States, and Japan due to avian influenza outbreaks. Affected locations: L'Ile-d'Orleans Regional County Municipality, Quebec, Canada; Breckland District, Norfolk County, United Kingdom; Placer County, California; Pierce County, Washington; Gooding County, Idaho; Clackamas County, Oregon, United States; and Aichi Prefecture, Japan. The Center for Food Safety of the Hong Kong SAR government's Food and Environmental Hygiene Department ordered immediate suspension to protect public health. The report does not provide case counts or laboratory confirmations. The measure reflects Hong Kong's precautionary controls to prevent introduction of avian influenza via imported poultry products.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザを受け、香港が複数の海外地域からの家禽製品輸入を禁止
triage.triage_reason: 香港自体での鳥インフルエンザ発生ではなく、カナダ・英国・米国・日本での発生を受けた予防的輸入停止措置であり、対象国（中国/香港）における疾病発生情報ではないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 発生地域として香港・中国が付与されているが、記事の主題は香港による輸入禁止措置であり、実際の鳥インフルエンザ発生国はカナダ・英国・米国・日本（いずれも対象国リスト外）。香港・中国での発生事例ではないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Pesquisa identifica nova bactéria ligada a doença que ataca o milho
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Research identifies a new bacterium linked to the disease that attacks corn.
article.articleSummary: Candidatus Phytoplasma zeae is a new bacterium linked to maize red-stem disease, identified in Santa Catarina, Brazil, with samples from the United States (Oklahoma and Iowa). Reclassified from Candidatus Phytoplasma asteris after genome sequencing, the organism is not yet cultured in the lab, hence the 'Candidatus' designation; Zea mays is the only confirmed natural host. A Santa Catarina lineage, MBSP-BR, was selected as the global reference genome to standardize description and detection by laboratories worldwide. The disease spreads via two leafhopper species: Dalbulus maidis (present in Brazil) and Dalbulus elimatus (not recorded in Brazil). In a parallel study, researchers analyzed the microbiome of 171 leafhopper species across 13 countries, assembling 272 novel bacterial genomes from 264 datasets, revealing three major bacterial groups and co-occurrences with phytoplasma and spiroplasma, with implications for biocontrol and enhanced surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: トウモロコシを攻撃する病気に関連する新しい細菌を研究で特定
triage.triage_reason: これは植物病害（トウモロコシの赤茎病）に関する農業研究の記事であり、ヒトの公衆衛生に関する感染症イベントではないため、トリアージ対象外。
triage.notes: 本記事はヒト感染症ではなくトウモロコシの植物病原体（Candidatus Phytoplasma zeae）に関する研究報告であり、EBS対象の感染症イベントに該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫组织：伊图里省激烈交火致使刚果（金）埃博拉防疫人员受困
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Fierce fighting in Ituri Province traps Ebola response personnel in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Fierce fighting near a hospital in Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, has trapped Ebola response personnel for more than 24 hours, forcing them to shelter in the hospital’s maternity ward. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus called for immediate safe passage and protection of health facilities, staff, and patients as responders seek to evacuate the trapped team. The violence adds to security barriers hindering outbreak control; 87 attacks on healthcare facilities were documented since January 1. The outbreak remains centered in Ituri, where Bundibugyo ebolavirus is circulating; eight provinces have been affected across 68 health zones, with 11,762 confirmed cases and 5,775 deaths as of November 20. Ituri accounts for the majority: over 8,000 cases and 3,791 deaths (case fatality rate ~47%). In the latest update, 39 new cases were reported, 23 from Ituri, underscoring ongoing challenges for contact tracing and care.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:イトゥリ州での激しい戦闘によりコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対応要員が孤立
triage.triage_reason: 進行中の大規模エボラ流行（11,762症例、致死率約47%）に加え、武力紛争により対応要員が孤立し医療施設への攻撃も頻発しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と対応の異常性・困難性が認められるためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が安全な通行と医療施設・要員・患者の保護を要請。8州68保健地帯に拡大し、紛争による治安悪化が流行制御を阻害している。

article.articleHeadline: Divinópolis entra em situação de alto risco para dengue, aponta 4º LIRAa de 2026 - Portal MPA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Divinópolis enters a high-risk situation for dengue, according to the 4th LIRAa of 2026 - Portal MPA.
article.articleSummary: On 23 November 2026, Divinópolis reported a 4.7% Aedes aegypti infestation index, placing the city at high risk for a dengue epidemic per the 4th LIRAa 2026. The Central region leads with 6.5%, followed by Nordeste 6.0% and Sudeste 5.7%; Norte 4.1%, Oeste 3.5%, Sudoeste 3.2% (Oeste and Sudoeste remain medium risk). Highest infestation neighborhoods include Prolongamento Icaraí (50%), Nossa Senhora das Graças (40%), Esplanada (35.1%), Grajaú (30.8%), and Prolongamento Bom Pastor (25%). About 90% of breeding sites are inside residences; 10% in vacant lots. Breeding sites: 44.1% in movable containers (pet bowls, plant dishes) and 35.5% in discardable containers (bottles, cans, plastics, tires), totaling 79.6%. With the rainy season approaching, residents are urged to spend at least 10 minutes weekly inspecting homes to eliminate standing water, cover water tanks, clean pet bowls, and clear gutters and drains to curb dengue.

triage.headline_ja: ディヴィノーポリス市、2026年第4回LIRAa調査でデング熱の高リスク状態に突入
triage.triage_reason: これはAedes aegypti蚊の生息指数（LIRAa）に基づく高リスク警告であり、実際の患者数・死亡者数などの発生データが示されていないため、感染拡大の実態は不明。季節性のベクター管理情報として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は蚊の生息密度調査（LIRAa）に基づくリスク評価であり、実際のデング熱症例数や死亡者数の報告はない。雨季を前にした地域保健当局による予防喚起が主旨。

article.articleHeadline: Sesau alerta para sintomas e orienta como prevenir a sarna humana - Boca do Povo News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Municipal Health Secretariat warns about symptoms and advises on how to prevent human scabies - Boca do Povo News
article.articleSummary: As of 23 November 2026, Campo Grande, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, reports more than 45 suspected scabies cases across three institutions, with 14 confirmed seeking care. The Municipal Health Secretariat (Sesau) emphasizes early symptom recognition and proper treatment to prevent spread. Typical signs are persistent nocturnal itching and skin lesions, especially between fingers, wrists, armpits, abdomen, waist, groin and buttocks; in children, palms, soles and scalp may be involved. Transmission occurs by prolonged direct skin contact or via contaminated clothing, linens, or objects; mere shared spaces do not transmit. Prevention focuses on not sharing items, regular cleaning, washing bedding above 55°C and ironing; non-wash items should be sealed for seven days. Treatment of infected individuals and evaluation of close contacts are essential; asymptomatic contacts may require treatment. In schools, return after 24 hours of effective treatment; suspensions are not automatic. No vaccine; antiparasitics are provided by SUS; surveillance continues.

triage.headline_ja: 保健局、疥癬の症状について警告し予防方法を助言 - Boca do Povo News
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は国内で管理可能な軽症の皮膚疾患であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 疥癬は接触感染する皮膚疾患であり、地域の保健当局が予防啓発を行っている段階。重症例や死亡の報告はなく、治療薬もSUS（公的医療制度）で提供されており管理可能。

article.articleHeadline: Comitê de Porto Velho reforça ações para evitar transmissão de doenças de mães para bebês
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Porto Velho Committee strengthens actions to prevent mother-to-child transmission of diseases.
article.articleSummary: Porto Velho's Municipal Health Secretariat (Semusa) held the second Ordinary Meeting of the Municipal Committee for Investigation of Vertical Transmission (CMITV). Initiated in August, the group updated its composition and internal regulations to bolster preventive actions against vertical transmission of infections from mother to child during pregnancy, delivery, or breastfeeding. The committee tracks diseases including syphilis, HIV, HTLV, hepatitis B, and Chagas disease. In sessions, teams review cases, assess the public health network, and discuss referrals to strengthen care for pregnant women, the puerperal period, and newborns. A Department of Primary Care briefing outlined services, programs, and upcoming commitments. The aim is integrated health-team collaboration to identify pregnant women early and ensure closer, preventive follow-up. Participating entities include Primary Care, Epidemiological Surveillance, SAE, Maternidade Mãe Esperança, Social Work, Laboratory Division (DIL), Lacen, the Child and Adolescent Rights Council, Coren, and the Medical Council.

triage.headline_ja: ポルトベーリョ委員会、母子感染予防対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 通常の行政委員会活動に関する記事であり、新規の異常な感染症発生や急性の公衆衛生リスクを示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ポルトベーリョ市の母子垂直感染（梅毒・HIV・B型肝炎・シャーガス病等）予防のための定例委員会活動を報じるもので、アウトブレイクや異常事態の発生は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: नालंदा में बर्ड फ्लू की पुष्टि के बाद पटना में अलर्ट, अच्छी तरह पकाकर खाएं अंडा-चिकन
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza confirmed in Nalanda; Patna on alert, eat eggs and chicken that are well-cooked.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza A(H5N1) confirmed in Nalanda, India; Patna on alert with enhanced surveillance. No cases in Patna district yet. The Animal Husbandry Department will test any dead birds and has stockpiled potassium peroxymonosulfate for disinfection. If infection is confirmed, a 1 km infected zone will be declared and 9,662 eggs and 530 kg poultry feed culled in Nalanda previously; the response increased monitoring within a 9 km radius, and Patna Zoo was closed for seven days as a precaution. Historical outbreak at Chitkohara Kaushal Nagar poultry center saw 4,575 chickens infected. Migratory waterbirds along the Ganges and water bodies in winter raise risk, as crows may feed on carcasses. Public should not touch dead birds and should report to authorities; poultry farmers should take reporting seriously and seek medical care if fever, cough, or breathing difficulty after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: ナーランダで鳥インフルエンザ確認後、パトナで警戒態勢—卵・鶏肉はよく火を通して食べるよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ビハール州ナーランダで家禽のH5N1感染が確認され当局が警戒態勢を敷いているが、現時点でヒトへの感染事例は報告されておらず、渡り鳥による継続的な曝露リスクはあるものの緊急のフルリスク評価が必要な段階ではない。
triage.notes: 疾患名はヒトH5N1感染と分類されているが、記事本文はビハール州ナーランダにおける家禽（動物）感染と地元当局の防疫対応（移動制限区域設定、殺処分、動物園閉鎖等）を中心に報じており、ヒト感染の確定事例は記載されていない。渡り鳥（ガンジス川流域）による継続曝露リスクには留意が必要。カナダ（British Columbia）の地名が発生地域に含まれるが記事の主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 新興變異株PJ.2.1傳播迅速 WHO列入監測 | 感染力 | 致病力 | 封鎖消息
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Emerging PJ.2.1 variant spreading rapidly; WHO lists it for surveillance | Infectivity | Pathogenicity | Containment News
article.articleSummary: As of 23 November 2026, the World Health Organization designated SARS-CoV-2 variant PJ.2.1 as a Variant Under Monitoring (VUM). The article reports PJ.2.1 is spreading rapidly worldwide, with claimed dominance in North and South America and substantial spread in southern China. Shenzhen wastewater surveillance reportedly shows PJ.2.1 accounting for over 65% of recent samples. Huashan Hospital Infectious Diseases Department (Fudan University) reportedly detected PJ.2.1 in several fatal COVID-19 cases, though not publicly disclosed. Laboratory data cited indicate PJ.2.1 binds ACE2 more strongly and infects kidney cells more efficiently, implying broader tissue tropism and potential multi-system disease, with irreversible kidney injury suggested. The piece notes rising infection rates, southern regions peaking earlier and the north following, alongside concurrent influenza/H1N1 activity. Antigen false-negative rates are claimed to be elevated and hospital testing considered imprecise. Recurrent infections are linked to long-term complications such as cardiovascular disease, kidney failure, diabetes, and cancer, amid alleged information suppression.

triage.headline_ja: 新興変異株PJ.2.1が急速拡大、WHOが監視対象に指定｜感染力｜病原性｜情報封鎖のニュース
triage.triage_reason: WHOが新変異株PJ.2.1をVariant Under Monitoring(VUM)に指定したとされ、中国南部（広東・深圳）での急速拡大や重症化・多臓器障害の可能性が主張されており、IHR基準（異常性・国際拡大）およびWPRO基準（重症度・流行性）に複数該当するためフルRRAでの検証が必要。ただし情報源の信頼性（政治的バイアスのあるメディア）には留意。
triage.notes: 情報源はNTDTV（政治的バイアスを持つとされるメディア）であり、『情報隠蔽』『死亡例の非公開検出』など未検証・扇情的な主張を含む。WHOによる実際のVUM指定の有無や科学的根拠（ACE2結合性増強、腎細胞指向性等）は公式情報源での裏付けが必要。フルRRAにおいて一次情報（WHO公式発表、中国CDC等）の確認を優先すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Com mais de 556 casos, SES-MS confirma 31 surtos de sarna em 12 municípios
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 556 cases, SES-MS confirms 31 scabies outbreaks in 12 municipalities.
article.articleSummary: As of 9:00 a.m. on Nov 23, 2026, SES-MS reports 31 scabies outbreaks across 12 municipalities in Mato Grosso do Sul, with 556 total cases between Oct 20 and Nov 23. Outbreaks were notified in Dourados, Itaporã, Douradina, Batayporã, Campo Grande, Jardim, Aparecida do Taboado, Paranaíba, Angélica, Inocência, São Gabriel do Oeste and Fátima do Sul; Nova Andradina is due to notify. Jornal Midiamax corroborates 97 cases in Aparecida do Taboado, 87 in Dourados, 45 in Campo Grande, 40 in Angélica, 38 in Batayporã, 34 in Itaporã, 16 in Jardim (prison) and 5 in Douradina; Rio Brilhante has 40 and Nova Andradina 148, though SES-MS notes these cities have not officially notified outbreaks yet. Dourados closed the Ceim Mario Kumagai; Ceim Recanto Raízes remains closed. Dourados reports 87 cases. Other municipalities suspended creche/school activities for cleaning. Transmission is via prolonged direct skin contact; symptoms include itchy lesions and skin tunnels; crusted (Norwegian) scabies can occur in immunosuppressed individuals; prevention involves hot-water laundering and rigorous hygiene; treatment targets mite elimination.

triage.headline_ja: 556例超、MS州保健局が12市町村で31件の疥癬アウトブレイクを確認
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は公衆衛生上重篤な疾患ではなく、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当せず、国際的拡大リスクも低いため見送り。
triage.notes: 疥癬は致死率が低く、保育園・学校の一時休園など地域レベルでの対応で管理可能な事案。国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 40 пассажиров самолетов пожаловались на симптомы норовируса
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Forty airline passengers reported norovirus symptoms.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-23, forty passengers on two airplanes arriving in Europe reported norovirus symptoms. In Germany, authorities declared an emergency at the airport, and medical teams provided care; two passengers required hospitalization as responders acted rapidly. Preliminary data suggest the outbreak may be linked to a cruise ship, with many of the ill travelers having been aboard that vessel. The incident highlights travel-associated transmission of norovirus in international flight hubs. The report also notes that previous coverage denying an 'unknown virus' in Vietnam was corrected; experts emphasize that tourists often fall ill on holidays, including cases of acute respiratory infections (ARVI).

triage.headline_ja: 飛行機の乗客40人がノロウイルスの症状を訴える
triage.triage_reason: ノロウイルスのクラスターはドイツ（対象国外）で発生しており、ベトナムへの言及は過去の『未知のウイルス』報道の訂正に過ぎず、実際の発生国ではないため対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域としてドイツとベトナムが付与されているが、実際のノロウイルスクラスターはドイツの空港・クルーズ船関連であり、対象国リストに含まれない。ベトナムは『未知のウイルス』報道訂正の文脈でのみ言及され、本イベントの発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Com 31 surtos registrados, sarna já atinge 12 municípios de Mato Grosso do Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With 31 outbreaks recorded, scabies has already reached 12 municipalities in Mato Grosso do Sul.
article.articleSummary: 31 scabies outbreaks have been recorded in 12 municipalities of Mato Grosso do Sul since Oct 20, including Dourados, Itaporã, Douradina, Batayporã, Campo Grande, Jardim, Aparecida do Taboado, Paranaíba, Angélica, Inocência, São Gabriel d'Oeste, and Fátima do Sul. In Campo Grande, over 45 suspected cases were identified in three institutions, with 14 confirmed. Angélica reported five days of creche closures. In Campo Grande’s Casa da Criança Meimei, 21 people were diagnosed (14 children and 7 staff). Transmission is by close contact and sharing used items; symptoms include intense nocturnal itching and small red lesions, with adults on hands, wrists, armpits, waist, groin, and children on palms, soles, and scalp. Prevention: avoid sharing personal items, wash linens at >55°C, and iron; seal non-washables for seven days. Return to activities after 24 hours of effective treatment; SES is notified when three or more cases occur in the same setting, not individual cases.

triage.headline_ja: 31件の発生が記録され、疥癬がマトグロッソ・ド・スル州の12市町村に拡大
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は重症度が低く国際的拡大リスクも小さいが、複数市町村・施設での集団発生が継続しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 疥癬は接触感染で重症度は低いが、学校・保育施設での集団発生が継続しており、地域保健当局（SES）への報告基準も設けられている。国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは評価されないが、地域内での拡大状況を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Сателитски снимци открили да је епидемија еболе однела више живота него што се пријављује
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Satellite images have revealed that the Ebola epidemic has claimed more lives than have been reported.
article.articleSummary: Satellite imagery analyzed by Reuters shows the Ebola outbreak in the DRC may claim more lives than official counts. In Bunia, eastern DRC, cemetery data show >1,000 excess deaths by early November, vs 707 official Ebola deaths. Many burials occurred without testing as the outbreak spread undetected. At Nyamurungo Cemetery, burials rose from 2–3 daily pre-outbreak to up to 15; about 600 burials since April, while Bunia's official deaths remained under 200. By end-June excess deaths exceeded 580 (sevenfold). By September, about 950 (roughly twice). A similar pattern appeared in Mongbwalu, north of Bunia, where a cemetery showed August excess deaths about 25% higher than official Ebola deaths. Bundibugyo strain confirmed mid-May; WHO warned it could be 2–4x larger than reported. Nov 5 data show >11,500 cases and >5,500 deaths; >60% of deaths outside facilities; <15% of new cases linked to known contacts; no approved vaccine or specific therapy.

triage.headline_ja: 衛星画像により、エボラ流行の死者数が報告より多いことが判明
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行で公式発表を大幅に上回る超過死亡が衛星画像分析で判明し、感染追跡が困難でヒト-ヒト感染の継続が懸念されるため、IHR基準2つ以上・WPRO基準複数該当でフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はロイターの衛星画像分析報道で、DRC東部Bunia・Mongbwalu等での墓地データに基づく超過死亡の推計。公式死者数（5,500人超）を大きく上回る可能性が指摘されており、感染追跡の失敗（新規症例の60%以上が既知接触者と無関係）も懸念材料。Ugandaは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では発生国として言及されておらず（Bundibugyo株という名称のみ）、verified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Escolas de Cordeiro passam por higienização após casos de escabiose | Cordeiro | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cordeiro Schools Undergo Sanitization After Scabies Cases
article.articleSummary: Scabies cases in Cordeiro's municipal schools prompted sanitization of several campuses and temporary suspensions, but officials report no outbreak as of 23 November 2026. A parent posted concerns on social media about prior cases in two other schools and urged longer closures until cleaning is complete; the Education Secretariat says return requires medical clearance. Secretary Alessandra Salgado told O DIA that some cases triggered cleaning and suspensions, with symptomatic students withdrawn per medical guidance. No school remains closed. Education and Health departments hold lectures for parents and staff on symptoms, treatment, and prevention, while local Family Health Unit teams provide care to nearby campuses. Scabies, caused by a mite, presents with intense nocturnal itching and small lesions and is transmitted mainly by prolonged skin-to-skin contact; diagnosis and treatment are by health professionals.

triage.headline_ja: コルデイロ市の学校、疥癬症例発生後に消毒作業を実施
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬はありふれた皮膚寄生虫症で、当局も『アウトブレイクではない』と明言しており、重症度・国際的拡大リスクともに低い。
triage.notes: ブラジル国内の一地方都市（コルデイロ）の学校における局地的な疥癬症例であり、公衆衛生上の重大性は低い。当局は既に対応（消毒・衛生指導）を実施済み。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de COVID-19 voltam a crescer no Brasil e alta dura seis semanas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases rise again in Brazil, and the surge lasts six weeks.
article.articleSummary: Fiocruz reports six weeks of rising COVID-19 activity across Brazil, with more severe cases climbing in populous states including São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Distrito Federal, Bahia, Paraná and Minas Gerais. Since the start of the year, Brazil has recorded over 118,000 influenza-like illness cases linked to COVID-19. In the last week of October, positive test results rose 35% compared with the same period in 2025, which also saw a disease surge. Despite the overall low risk assessment by the Health Ministry, older adults and the immunocompromised remain at higher risk and are advised to take precautions. The ministry authorized sending additional vaccine doses to states. People with outdated COVID-19 vaccination cards are urged to get updated; standard hygiene measures, including handwashing and masks, are recommended in areas with rising cases.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでCOVID-19症例が再び増加、流行は6週間続く
triage.triage_reason: 季節的なCOVID-19症例増加であり、保健省は全体的リスクを低いと評価している。異常性や国際的拡大の懸念はなく、既存の医療体制（ワクチン追加配布等）で対応可能とされている。
triage.notes: 前年同時期にも同様の流行があったとされ、COVID-19の季節性変動の範囲内と考えられる。保健省は低リスクと評価しており、ワクチン追加配布など国内対応で管理可能。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : Ebola gagne Rutshuru, les soignants de l'Ituri piégés par les combats
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Ebola reaches Rutshuru, Ituri health workers trapped by the fighting.
article.articleSummary: On 22 November, the DRC confirmed the first Ebola case in Kanyabayonga, Rutshuru, North Kivu; the patient, a woman from Mwendabandu, died at the health center after lab confirmation. This is the first case in Kibirizi health zone and expands the outbreak south from Lubero. In Ituri, responders are trapped for a second day inside a hospital maternity ward amid fighting; WHO is coordinating a safe exit for staff. Attacks on health care have surged since January, undermining the response. By 20 November, WHO reports 11,762 confirmed cases and 5,775 deaths across 68 zones in eight provinces; Ituri remains the epicenter with more than 8,000 cases and 3,791 deaths (47% CFR). The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; no strain-specific vaccine exists; MSF urges broader use of Ervebo. Containment relies on isolation and contact tracing; evacuation depends on combat conditions.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラ出血熱がルチュルに拡大、イトゥリの医療従事者が戦闘に巻き込まれ身動きできず
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の大規模エボラ流行（確定11,762例、死亡5,775例、致死率47%）が新たな保健地域（ルチュル/キビリジ）に拡大し、武力紛争により対応が困難化している重大な公衆衛生危機。
triage.notes: 株特異的ワクチンが存在しないBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行。武力紛争により医療従事者の安全確保・封じ込め活動が阻害されており、国際支援（WHO調整、MSFによるワクチン使用拡大の要請）が継続的に必要とされている。ルワンダは位置情報に含まれるが記事上で感染確認の記載はなく、対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Sarna humana acende alerta em MS - Boca do Povo News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Human scabies raises alarm in Mato Grosso do Sul - Boca do Povo News
article.articleSummary: Human scabies is raising alarm in Campo Grande, the capital of Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, with more than 45 suspected cases across three institutions and 14 confirmed to date seeking care. Key symptoms include intense nighttime itching and red lesions, typically on fingers, wrists, armpits, waist, and groin. Transmission occurs mainly through prolonged close contact, and can also occur via shared clothing, towels, or bed linens that are contaminated. Health surveillance has alerted authorities. Home disinfection is not required beyond standard hygiene; affected individuals should wash clothes and linens, avoid sharing objects, and seek evaluation at a health unit if symptoms appear. Effective control relies on medical treatment and assessment of close contacts; cleaning alone cannot halt transmission without proper treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 人獣共通疥癬がマットグロッソ・ド・スル州で警戒を引き起こす - Boca do Povo News
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は一般的に重症度が低く、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも低い地域的な皮膚感染症であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当性が乏しい。
triage.notes: 疥癬（ヒゼンダニによる皮膚感染症）はヒト-ヒト感染するが重症度は低く、通常の公衆衛生対応で管理可能な疾患。地域の保健当局が注意喚起している程度で、国際的な懸念事項ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Covid: variante PJ.2.1 é maioria em amostras no Rio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19: PJ.2.1 variant is the majority among samples in Rio de Janeiro.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in Rio de Janeiro state is driven by PJ.2.1, a SARS-CoV-2 lineage. IOC/Fiocruz sequencing for the city found PJ.2.1 in 96 of 167 samples (58%) from Oct 17–Nov 6, 2026. By Nov 23, the capital reported 9,882 COVID-19 cases in 2026. The World Health Organization categorized PJ.2.1 as a variant under monitoring on Nov 19, with global health risk deemed low but with uncertainties. Virologist Paola Resende notes this variant shows mutations possibly increasing human transmissibility, reinforcing the need for global sequencing. Vaccination remains crucial: Rio reports >95% of the population completed primary vaccination, with more than 22.1 million doses administered since the campaign began. Public health measures include continued vaccination for priority groups and testing for respiratory illness at care entry points; boosters are recommended for elderly and immunocompromised every six months.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19：リオデジャネイロの検体でPJ.2.1変異株が過半数を占める
triage.triage_reason: WHOが監視下変異株に分類し伝播性増加の可能性が指摘されているが、世界的リスクは低いとされ重症度や国際的拡大の情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: WHOはPJ.2.1を監視下変異株(VUM)に分類し世界的リスクは低いと評価。ワクチン接種率は高く(95%超)、管理体制は整っているとみられるが、変異株の伝播性増加の可能性があり続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: OMS monitora variante PJ.2.1 após avanço de casos de Covid no Rio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO monitors PJ.2.1 variant after surge in COVID-19 cases in Rio de Janeiro
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro city reports 9,882 COVID-19 cases in 2026 amid a surge linked to the PJ.2.1 coronavirus variant. Sequencing of 167 samples between Oct 17 and Nov 6 found PJ.2.1 in 96 (58%). The state of Rio de Janeiro remains the only Brazilian state with SRAG (severe acute respiratory syndrome) incidence at alert and rising over six weeks, driven by multiple respiratory viruses including SARS-CoV-2, influenza, and metapneumovirus. The World Health Organization classified PJ.2.1 as a variant under monitoring on Nov 19; global risk is considered low, though its behavior remains uncertain and requires broader sequencing. IOC/Fiocruz virologist Paola Resende notes potential increased transmissibility due to receptor changes. Vaccination remains central: over 95% of the population completed primary vaccination; more than 22.1 million doses administered. Priority groups should stay up to date; no new doses for non-priority groups at this time; ongoing surveillance and testing at primary care facilities.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがリオデジャネイロでのCOVID-19症例増加を受けて変異株PJ.2.1を監視
triage.triage_reason: WHOが新変異株PJ.2.1を監視下に置き、リオ州でSRAG発生率が警戒水準にあるが、グローバルリスクは低いと評価されており国際的な制限等には至っていないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: WHOはPJ.2.1を『監視下の変異株』に分類し、グローバルリスクは低いとしているが、伝播性増加の可能性が指摘されており、今後のシーケンス結果や症例動向の続報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: Ribeirão Preto alerta para alta da covid-19 no fim de ano e pede reforço na vacinação de idosos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ribeirão Preto warns of a rise in COVID-19 at year-end and calls for booster shots for the elderly.
article.articleSummary: Ribeirão Preto, Brazil, warns of rising COVID-19 transmission in December and January as year-end gatherings boost spread. Health surveillance reports 51 severe acute respiratory syndrome (SARS) cases caused by coronavirus through November 13, 2026, with 38 involving people aged 60 and older (74.5% of severe hospitalizations); January registered the year's peak with 11 cases. Subsecretary Luzia Márcia Romanholi Passos emphasizes falling booster uptake among seniors, urging vaccination every six months for those over 60. Under the National Immunization Program, COVID-19 vaccination is free at 39 vaccination centers in Ribeirão Preto. Recommended schedules: seniors (60+) and immunocompromised—two annual doses, six months apart; children 6 months to under 5 years—three doses; pregnant/puerperal—one dose per pregnancy; priority groups—annual dose including those with comorbidities, permanent disabilities, health workers, Indigenous, riverine, quilombolas, incarcerated individuals, and people experiencing homelessness. Symptoms resemble flu or cold; testing available at Basic Health Units and urgent care facilities.

triage.headline_ja: リベイロンプレト、年末のCOVID-19増加を警告し高齢者へのワクチン追加接種を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のCOVID-19増加と高齢者へのワクチン接種呼びかけに関する通常の公衆衛生広報であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地域の保健当局による季節性流行への注意喚起とワクチン接種推奨の記事であり、既知の疾患の通常の季節変動を扱っている。

article.articleHeadline: Philippines: Central Visayas dengue death toll up 5x 2025
article.articleSummary: Central Visayas, Philippines reports dengue fatalities rising to 119 as of November 14, 2026, with 21,357 dengue cases through morbidity week 45 (Nov 8–14) and a 0.6% case fatality rate, per a November 23 DOH briefing by Dr. Van Phillip Baton. Regional breakdown: Cebu Province 7,816 cases/40 deaths; Bohol 5,623/42; Cebu City 4,732/22; Lapu-Lapu City 1,968/8; Mandaue City 1,218/7. Infections nearly double the 10,881 cases recorded in all of 2025, which had 23 dengue deaths. Officials urge stronger community-level interventions and improved case management, while the DOH reviews reported deaths to confirm direct dengue causation. The ongoing outbreak underscores widening transmission in Central Visayas and a pressing need for public-health measures to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピン:中央ビサヤ地方のデング熱死者数が2025年の5倍に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常な増加傾向の2つに該当し、WPRO基準でも重症度・流行継続性など複数該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 中央ビサヤ地方（セブ州、ボホール州、セブ市、ラプラプ市、マンダウエ市）で2025年通年の症例数をすでに上回る規模の流行が継続中。DOHは死因確認の精査中であり、今後の推移と対応状況の続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Com 14 casos confirmados, Campo Grande monitora surto de sarna humana em escolas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With 14 confirmed cases, Campo Grande monitors an outbreak of human scabies in schools.
article.articleSummary: Campo Grande, the capital of Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, reports an outbreak of human scabies in three schools, with 14 laboratory-confirmed cases and more than 45 suspected as of 23 November 2026. Ongoing surveillance and investigations are underway, alongside suspicions of hand-foot-mouth syndrome in the same settings. Scabies is caused by a skin mite that causes intense itching and small lesions; transmission occurs mainly through prolonged close skin contact and sharing contaminated items, not by mere co-location. Prevention centers on not sharing clothing or towels, washing bedding above 55°C, and ironing, with non-washable items sealed for seven days. Treatment of infected individuals and evaluation of close contacts are essential to prevent reinfestation; family members may require treatment even if asymptomatic. In schools, affected students and staff should be evaluated and may return after 24 hours of effective treatment; no vaccine exists in Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: 確認症例14件、カンポグランデで学校における疥癬アウトブレイクを監視
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は軽症で局所的な学校内アウトブレイクであり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、社会的関心も限定的と判断される。
triage.notes: 手足口病（エンテロウイルス71）の疑いも同じ学校で報告されているが、現時点では主症例は疥癬であり重篤性は低い。続報があれば手足口病の動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Amambai divulgou boletim com 52 casos confirmados de dengue e 236 de chikungunya em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amambai released a bulletin with 52 confirmed dengue cases and 236 chikungunya cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Amambai municipality’s health department reports dengue and chikungunya activity for January 1–November 19, 2026, using SINAN data. Dengue: 1,242 notified; 1,139 discarded; 52 confirmed; 1,191 closed. Chikungunya: 1,240 notified; 941 discarded; 236 confirmed; 1,177 closed; 0 deaths. Zika: 8 suspected cases, none confirmed to date. The bulletin indicates ongoing circulation of dengue and chikungunya in Amambai. Public health guidance emphasizes vector-control measures: eliminate containers that collect standing water, keep water tanks sealed, clean gutters and yards, and properly discard materials that can serve as mosquito breeding sites.

triage.headline_ja: アマンバイ市、2026年のデング熱確定52例とチクングニア熱確定236例に関する報告書を公表
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル地方都市での定例的な感染症サーベイランス報告であり、死亡者なし・重症例報告もなく、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱・チクングニア熱は当該地域で毎年流行する風土病的な蚊媒介感染症であり、本記事は定例の地方自治体による疫学週報・月報の一種。死亡者ゼロ、ベクターコントロールの通常の公衆衛生対応のみが言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: São Carlos intensifica ações de combate à dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Carlos intensifies dengue control efforts.
article.articleSummary: São Carlos, Brazil, launches a week-long dengue-control mobilization through 27 November to curb Aedes aegypti. Activities include house-to-house visits, distribution of informational materials, removal of water-holding containers, and public education citywide. On 23 November, agents served properties in major commercial corridors; 24 November covers Vila Prado and Jardim Bela Vista; 25 November targets Miguel Petroni and Santa Felícia; 26 November includes visits to Vila Brasília and Vila Costa do Sol with material-recovery support. On 27 November, three fronts operate: 8–11h a street outreach at Geminiano Costa/São Carlos; 8–16h guidance at the Bus Terminal on the mosquito lifecycle and arboviruses (dengue, chikungunya, Zika, yellow fever); and a full-day educational tent at Praça Coronel Salles promoting prevention and the '10 minutes weekly' home checks. Tire collection intensifies in high-dumping areas, with outreach to tire shops. Health Secretary Leandro Pilha calls for year-round, community-led prevention.

triage.headline_ja: サンカルロス市、デング熱対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の自治体による通常のデング熱予防・啓発活動の報道であり、異常な流行拡大や重症例急増等の報告はない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節的な蚊媒介感染症対策キャンペーンの紹介であり、感染拡大や重症化に関する具体的データは含まれていない。
