article.articleHeadline: हॉन्ग कॉन्ग बर्ड फ्लू के चलते चार देशों से पोल्ट्री आयात पर प्रतिबंध | Hong Kong: Bird Flu prompts ban on poultry imports from four nations (Photo: IANS)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ban on poultry imports from four countries due to bird flu in Hong Kong.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 November 2026, Hong Kong bans poultry meat and related products from specified areas in Canada, the United Kingdom, the United States, and Japan following confirmed avian influenza outbreaks. The Food Safety Centre under the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department issued the immediate import restriction to safeguard public health. Affected regions: Canada—Île-d’Orléans Regional County Municipality, Quebec; United Kingdom—Breckland district, Norfolk; United States—Placer County (California), Pierce County (Washington), Gooding County (Idaho), Clackamas County (Oregon); Japan—Aichi Prefecture. The ban covers all poultry meat and related products from these areas. The decision follows notices from international animal health bodies about new highly contagious avian influenza cases. HK authorities have contacted the respective officials and will monitor the global situation, reviewing updates from international health organizations to decide on any further import adjustments or preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザの影響で香港が4カ国からの家禽輸入を禁止
triage.triage_reason: 香港による家禽輸入禁止措置の報道であり、対象国（中国含む）内での鳥インフルエンザ発生事実は確認されず、人への感染拡大や重大な公衆衛生影響も言及されていないため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 実際の鳥インフルエンザ発生地はカナダ・英国・米国・日本であり、いずれも対象国リストに含まれない。香港（中国）は輸入禁止措置を実施した側であり、発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。家禽間の感染のみで人への感染事例の言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ceará chega a 188 casos de mpox em 2026; Fortaleza concentra 159 registros
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ceará reaches 188 mpox cases in 2026; Fortaleza accounts for 159 cases.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) in Ceará, Brazil, reached 188 confirmed cases in 2026 as of 23 November, with Fortaleza accounting for 159 cases (about 84% of the state total). The November rise—175 cases on 19 November, increasing to 188 four days later—has led health authorities to describe the pattern as a reemergence rather than a surge or epidemic. Fortaleza harbors the majority of infections, though transmission may occur across municipalities. Symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, fatigue, lymphadenopathy, and skin or mucosal lesions appearing on the face, hands, mouth, or genital/anal regions; transmission occurs via close contact, including sexual contact, shared objects, and prolonged exposure to respiratory secretions. Diagnosis is via SUS-provided testing. Vaccination is not for the general population; eligibility targets recent exposure to suspected/probable/confirmed cases, people living with HIV meeting criteria, and laboratory workers handling MPXV.

triage.headline_ja: セアラ州、2026年のmpox症例が188件に到達；フォルタレザが159件を占める
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・セアラ州でmpox症例が増加しているが、当局は『再興』であり急増・流行ではないとしており、重症度や国際拡大の情報もないため継続的な経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・セアラ州における地域的なmpox症例報告。保健当局は『再興』と表現しサージ・エピデミックではないと明言。性的接触を含む人-人感染経路やHIV陽性者等のリスク集団への言及があり、流行しやすさの基準に該当。死亡例や重症例の情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: راجکوٹ میں ایک ہفتے کے دوران نزلہ، کھانسی اور بخارکے 1,634 مریض
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 1,634 patients with cold, cough and fever in Rajkot during one week.
article.articleSummary: Rajkot, Gujarat reports 1,634 patients with cold, cough and fever during 16–22 November: 874 cold/cough, 760 fever, 204 diarrhoea and vomiting, and 1 typhoid case. Year-to-date totals: cold/cough 36,676; fever 34,408; diarrhoea/vomiting 11,789; typhoid 41; jaundice 44. Dengue added five new cases in the week, bringing total dengue to 73 for the year; no new malaria or chikungunya. Vector-control efforts included eliminating mosquito larvae in 106,695 households, fumigation in 1,009 households, and fogging with machines in high breeding areas. Notices were issued to 362 owners/occupants for mosquito-breeding sites. Health authorities urge residents to maintain cleanliness around their premises to curb mosquito proliferation.

triage.headline_ja: ラージコートで1週間に風邪・咳・発熱患者1,634人
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の風邪・デング熱等の定例報告であり、症例数も例年範囲内で公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による定例の感染症モニタリング報告で、ベクターコントロール対策も通常の活動範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: GCC to identify locked houses to assess risk of mosquito breeding
article.articleSummary: Greater Chennai Corporation (GCC) identifies locked houses as dengue-breeding sources in Chennai, alongside 24,389 vacant plots and 8,594 new construction sites at high risk. It will check poorly maintained wells in locked houses and, after mapping high-risk sites, begin mosquito-control measures to prevent a dengue surge. Dengue cases in Chennai have declined in November after rising in September and October: 1,293 in September, 1,174 in October, 375 in November. Of 10.83 lakh houses checked for larval density, 7,498 were positive; 41.95 lakh containers checked, 9,408 positive. GCC plans drone-sprayed biolarvicide along Adyar, Cooum and Buckingham Canal from Napier Bridge to Ennore (Buckingham), Napier Bridge to Maduravoyal (Cooum), and Patinapakkam to River View Colony (Adyar). Residents report stagnant water in storm-water drains; about 40% of drains are blocked, prompting calls for engineering solutions to curb breeding and public health risk.

triage.headline_ja: GCC、蚊の繁殖リスクを評価するため施錠された家屋を特定へ
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例数は11月に減少傾向にあり、地域の通常の媒介蚊対策活動を報じる内容で、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威や異常事態とは言えない。
triage.notes: チェンナイ市当局による季節性デング熱対策（防蚊活動）の通常業務に関する記事。症例数は減少傾向であり、特段の異常性は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Էբոլայի բռնկումը Կոնգոյում․ Բունիայի գերեզմանատները հուշում են ավելի մեծ կորուստների մասին
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo. Bunia's cemeteries hint at greater losses.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Bunia, Democratic Republic of Congo. Official Ebola-attributed deaths stood at 707 by early November. Satellite imagery of Bunia’s three main cemeteries, analyzed by Reuters, indicates more than 1,000 deaths in the city, reflecting all-cause mortality increase during the outbreak rather than solely confirmed Ebola fatalities. The discrepancy arises from unregistered infections and indirect losses, as people with other illnesses avoid hospitals due to fear of infection. Reuters’ investigation was published on November 23. The report underscores that official figures may underestimate the outbreak’s true toll and highlights broader health-system impacts in Bunia during this period. This suggests a substantial undercount and broader public health implications.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、ブニアの墓地はより大きな損失を示唆
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は公式死者707人超、衛星画像分析で実際の死者数が1000人超と推定され過小報告の懸念があり、公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常事態としてIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: Reuters報道に基づく衛星画像分析により、公式統計を大幅に上回る死者数が示唆されている。医療忌避による間接的死亡増加も指摘されており、流行の実態把握と対応強化が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Zambia : Govt. Encourages Cholera Vaccination Amid Rising Cases
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Zambia as of 23 November 2026: 3,584 cases and 81 deaths across seven provinces, Lusaka Province accounting for 2,652 cases. Over the past seven days, daily new cases averaged 69; in the last 24 hours, 60 new cases were reported, including 49 in Lusaka, 7 Copperbelt, 2 Southern, and 2 Northern. Since the outbreak was declared on 30 September 2026, 3,004 patients have recovered and been discharged. About 78% of cases were unvaccinated. In response, the government activated the Public Health Emergency Operations Centre and deployed rapid response and emergency medical teams; vaccination campaigns are encouraged in communities with new infections, with support sought from cooperating partners and stakeholders. Ongoing transmission remains very high, underscoring vaccination and public health measures as central to control.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビア：症例増加の中、政府がコレラワクチン接種を推奨
triage.triage_reason: ザンビアで7州にわたり3,584症例・81人死亡の大規模コレラ流行が継続しており、IHR基準2項目以上及びWPRO基準の大半に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年9月30日の流行宣言以降、未接種者が症例の78%を占め、ヒト-ヒト感染の継続が示唆される。政府は緊急事態運営センターを稼働し国際パートナーへの支援要請を行っている。

article.articleHeadline: Zambia Records 60 New Cholera Cases, Two Deaths - ZNBC
article.articleSummary: Zambia reports 60 new cholera cases and two deaths in the last 24 hours across four provinces, bringing the total to 3,584, with Lusaka Province accounting for 2,632 cases and forming the outbreak epicentre. Infections continue in Lusaka districts including Mandevu, Kanyama, Munali, Lusaka Central and Chawama. Health authorities warn of deaths in communities due to late treatment. Government actions are led by the National Disaster Management and Mitigation Unit to mobilise resources and coordinate response. The Ministry of Health and ZNPHI will strengthen case management and accelerate vaccination; the Ministry of Water will ensure safe water and sanitation; Education will bolster hygiene screening in schools; Local Government will improve waste collection and close food premises not meeting health standards; efforts include emptying pit latrines and burying shallow wells. At Kafue College of Nursing, 11 cases have been identified, four in the last 24 hours. Public urged to observe hygiene guidelines.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビアでコレラ新規60例、死亡2例を記録 - ZNBC
triage.triage_reason: ザンビアでコレラが複数州に拡大し死亡例も継続発生しており、政府が複数省庁を動員して対応している進行中のアウトブレイクであるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ルサカ州を中心に4州でコレラ拡大中、累計3,584例・継続的な死亡報告あり。水衛生インフラ対応（井戸埋没・トイレ処理等）が実施されており、長期的な水系感染リスクが示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Fiocruz promove 18º Simpósio Internacional sobre Esquistossomose | Portal Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz promotes the 18th International Symposium on Schistosomiasis | Fiocruz Portal
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro hosts the 18th International Symposium on Schistosomiasis (Nov 22–25, 2026), organized by Fiocruz under the theme Global Health and Schistosomiasis. The biannual event gathers 80 speakers, half international, to foster South-South cooperation, SUS training, and policy dialogue on control, diagnosis, treatment, vaccination, and public health. The focus centers on Schistosoma mansoni, the parasite behind schistosomiasis (xistose, barriga d’água). The disease occurs in 54 countries across Africa, the Eastern Mediterranean, the Caribbean, Venezuela, and Brazil; in Brazil about 1.5 million people are at risk, especially in the Southeast and Northeast. From 2010–2023 (SINAN) data show: parda 48.27%, white 29.74%, black 8.86%, yellow 0.97%, indigenous 0.28%, unknown 11.88%; men 58.6%, women 41.68%; urban 78.35%, rural 15.97%. WHO aims to eliminate schistosomiasis as a public health problem by 2030, aligning with the SDGs. The program emphasizes sanitation, clean water, vector control, education, primary care, and epidemiology mapping via biological collections.

triage.headline_ja: フィオクルス、第18回住血吸虫症国際シンポジウムを開催
triage.triage_reason: 学術シンポジウム開催の告知記事であり、新規の感染症発生や異常事態を示す情報ではないため、トリアージ対象外とする。
triage.notes: 本記事は住血吸虫症に関する国際学会（シンポジウム）開催の告知であり、流行や新規症例の発生を報じるものではない。地域リストに含まれるブラジルは既存の流行状況の背景説明として言及されているのみで、新規イベントの発生地点ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Nova Santa Rita faz operação de combate à dengue nesta semana; confira | abc+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nova Santa Rita carries out a dengue-control operation this week; check it out.
article.articleSummary: Three dengue cases confirmed in Nova Santa Rita, Rio Grande do Sul, in 2026; no deaths. Aedes aegypti control operation, Operação Vira Aí, runs Nov 23–26 with school activities, inspections, and a traffic blitz to curb transmission ahead of summer rains. Most recent case: October, woman 30–39; other two: men 40–59 earlier in 2026. The municipality reports three dengue cases in 2026; no fatalities per RS Panel. Preventive actions focus on removing standing water, keeping water tanks closed, screening drains, drying tires, cleaning gutters, weekly washing of pet dishes, and using personal and environmental repellents and nets; doors and windows should be screened. Since 2024, dengue vaccination is available: SUS offers a two-dose schedule for ages 10–14; private network extends to 4–60 with restrictions. Nova Santa Rita reports 627 doses in 2026, mostly for 10–14-year-olds (Ministry of Health data).

triage.headline_ja: ノヴァ・サンタ・リタ市、デング熱対策作戦を今週実施
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の一自治体で2026年にデング熱3例（死亡なし）が確認され、通常の予防啓発活動が行われているのみで、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱は対象国リストに含まれるブラジルで発生しているが、季節的な通常の予防活動の一環であり、死亡例もなく小規模な症例数（3例）にとどまる。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : la Belgique déploie un laboratoire mobile pour soutenir la recherche d'un vaccin contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Belgium deploys a mobile laboratory to support the development of an Ebola vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Belgium has dispatched a mobile laboratory to Bunia in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo to support clinical trials for a vaccine against Bundibugyo Ebola virus. The deployment, announced on X by Foreign Minister Maxime Prévot, is part of the B-FAST emergency intervention mechanism with Belgian Defense support, enabling on-site analysis of samples to advance the Tumaini vaccine trial coordinated by the DRC’s INRB and the University of Antwerp; the Antwerp Institute of Tropical Medicine contributes laboratory analysis and immune-response assessment. The effort seeks a licensed vaccine for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no vaccine is yet approved. The DRC outbreak, declared May 15, has reached 11,613 confirmed cases and 5,678 deaths as of 17 November, across 68 health zones in eight provinces, notably Ituri and North Kivu. On 18 November, WHO kept the outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; insecurity in the east hampers response.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:ベルギーがエボラワクチン研究支援のため移動検査ラボを派遣
triage.triage_reason: DRCのブンディブギョ種エボラアウトブレイクはWHOによりPHEICと認定され、11,613例・5,678死亡という大規模な公衆衛生危機であり、国際的な支援（ベルギーのB-FAST派遣）が動員されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にBelgium・Antwerpenが含まれるが、これはワクチン研究支援のための人員・機材派遣元であり、感染症の発生国ではないため除外した。実際のアウトブレイク発生国はDRCのみ。既にWHOによりPHEICとして継続認定されている進行中の大規模流行であり、続報としての重要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Systematic Review Finds CTX-M Resistance Genes Pervasive Across South
article.articleSummary: CTX-M-type extended-spectrum beta-lactamase (ESBL) genes conferring broad beta-lactam resistance were found to be pervasive in Escherichia coli across South American food-animal systems, companion animals, synanthropic rodents, and retail meat, based on 36 peer-reviewed studies published Jan 2020–May 1, 2024. Brazil accounted for 50% of eligible research (18 studies), followed by Peru (5), Ecuador (4), Argentina and Chile (3 each), Colombia (2), and Uruguay (1). The review encompassed multiple matrices, with multi-matrix studies (12, 33.3%) dominating; retail chicken meat and domestic dogs each studied in 6 papers (16.6%). ESBLs, including CTX-M, TEM, and SHV families, were detected via combined methods; 100% used more than one diagnostic technique. Phenotypic screening (disc diffusion) used in 26 studies (72.2%), with confirmatory double-disc synergy tests in 17 studies (47%). Resistance compromises common veterinary antibiotics (ceftiofur, cefovecin) and poses exposure risk along the human food chain.

triage.headline_ja: 系統的レビューにより南米全域でCTX-M耐性遺伝子が広範に蔓延していることが判明
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクや急性感染症イベントではなく、薬剤耐性遺伝子に関する系統的レビュー論文であり、IHR・WPROいずれの基準にも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、2020-2024年に発表された36の査読済み研究を対象としたAMR（薬剤耐性）に関する系統的レビューである。ブラジルが研究の50%を占めるが、これは発生事例ではなく研究対象地域としての言及。他の言及国（ペルー、アルゼンチン、チリ、エクアドル、コロンビア、ウルグアイ）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: SES-MG divulga registros de tuberculose no Sul de Minas e orienta sobre vacinas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SES-MG releases tuberculosis records in southern Minas Gerais and provides guidance on vaccines.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis in southern Minas Gerais, Brazil, is reported by the Minas Gerais State Health Secretariat (SES-MG) for regional offices of Alfenas, Pouso Alegre, Passos, and Varginha: 566 cases and 23 deaths (Alfenas 68/2; Pouso Alegre 119/4; Passos 201/11; Varginha 178/6). The BCG vaccine is recommended as a single dose for children 0–4 years, 11 months and 29 days, to prevent TB and its severe forms (miliary TB, tuberculous meningitis). COVID-19 seasonality runs October to mid-March, with state monitoring to guide municipalities. SES-MG advises updating vaccination for eligible groups: children up to 5 years, immunocompromised individuals, pregnant people, and adults 60+, underscoring vaccination as most effective against severe disease and death. Non-pharmaceutical measures include frequent handwashing, respiratory etiquette, masking in closed or crowded spaces or when symptomatic; those with symptoms should seek a Basic Health Unit (UBS) and follow isolation guidance.

triage.headline_ja: SES-MGがミナスジェライス州南部の結核症例を発表、ワクチン接種を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 通常の地域保健当局による結核症例報告とワクチン接種啓発であり、異常性・国際的拡大リスク・社会的関心の高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。定例的な公衆衛生情報であり、結核の既知流行地域における通常の症例報告とワクチン啓発活動。

article.articleHeadline: Nova variante da Covid é detectada no Rio e já representa 58% das amostras
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New COVID-19 variant detected in Rio de Janeiro and already represents 58% of samples.
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro detects the SARS-CoV-2 lineage PJ.2.1, now accounting for 58% of samples (96 of 167) analyzed between Oct 17 and Nov 6, 2026. The finding, by Instituto Oswaldo Cruz (IOC/Fiocruz) with the Municipal Health Secretariat, coincides with rising respiratory illness activity and ongoing severe acute respiratory syndrome (SARS) surveillance, though the global health risk is deemed low by the World Health Organization (WHO). WHO added PJ.2.1 to the variants under monitoring list on Nov 19. PJ.2.1 was first identified in Canada in May and reached Brazil by late August. In Rio, 9,882 COVID-19 cases have been reported in 2026 as of Nov 23. Other circulating respiratory pathogens include influenza and metapneumovirus. Despite the variant, prevention measures remain unchanged; vaccines are available for defined groups per the Ministry of Health (children, pregnant women, elderly, immunocompromised, those with comorbidities, and health workers).

triage.headline_ja: リオで新型コロナウイルスの新変異株を検出、すでにサンプルの58%を占める
triage.triage_reason: WHOが監視下系統に追加した新変異株(PJ.2.1)がリオで急速に拡大しているが、WHOはグローバルリスクを低いと評価しており、現時点で重症度増加や対策変更の情報もないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: WHOは本変異株(PJ.2.1)を監視下系統に追加したがグローバルリスクは低いと評価。カナダは初検出地として言及されているのみで、発生の主体はブラジル(リオデジャネイロ)。

article.articleHeadline: Dia D contra a dengue em Goianésia convoca moradores a receber os agentes de endemias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: D-Day against dengue in Goianésia calls on residents to receive vector-control agents.
article.articleSummary: Goianésia launches Day D mobilization against arboviruses focusing on dengue transmitted by Aedes aegypti. On Tuesday, Nov 24, 2026 at 7:30 a.m., at Feirão do Nova Aurora, a task force begins and runs through Friday, Nov 27, expanding door-to-door visits by municipal health and vector-control teams. The effort aims to educate households on prevention and, with resident participation, identify and eliminate mosquito breeding sites in yards and other water-collection areas. Health Secretary Marina Batista emphasizes daily vigilance and instructs residents to maintain yard hygiene and remove standing water after visits. No confirmed dengue cases or outbreaks are reported; the article describes a preventive community outreach initiative.

triage.headline_ja: ゴイアネジアでデング熱対策の「D-Day」、住民に防疫担当者の受け入れを呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 確認された症例やアウトブレイクの報告はなく、単なる予防的な地域啓発活動に関する記事であるため。
triage.notes: 記事は確認された症例がない予防キャンペーンの報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Aumentos dos casos de mpox no Brasil pode estar relacionado à circulação de nova variante do vírus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Increases in mpox cases in Brazil may be related to the circulation of a new variant of the virus.
article.articleSummary: Mpox cases in Brazil rose in 2026, potentially linked to circulation of a new mpox variant, clade 1B, genetically distinct from the 2022 clade 2B. Brazil has more than 1,300 confirmed mpox cases in 2026, already surpassing the full 2025 total, though well below the 2022 peak of around 10,000. Infectologist Carolina Lázari notes ongoing transmission and predicts further increases in the coming weeks as holiday travel and social contact rise. Mpox spreads via direct person-to-person contact with skin and mucosal lesions. Symptoms include skin lesions containing fluid, fever, swollen lymph nodes, and malaise. Public guidance urges medical evaluation for diagnosis and isolation upon confirmation; general prevention includes avoiding contact with infected individuals and vaccination targeted to high‑risk groups, such as people living with HIV or those on PrEP.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでのmpox症例増加は新変異株の流行と関連か
triage.triage_reason: 2022年流行株とは遺伝的に異なるclade 1B変異株の出現が疑われ、症例数が前年を上回るなど異常な増加が見られるため、IHR基準（異常性・国際拡大リスク）を満たしフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: clade 1B変異株の遺伝的特徴や重症度に関する詳細情報が不足しており、続報での確認が必要。HIV感染者等高リスク群への影響にも注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Urban Density and Subway Flow Drove Hong Kong SARS-CoV-2 Variant Spread
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 SARS-CoV-2 spread in Hong Kong across five waves (2020–2022) was shaped by dense urban cores and subway mobility. A genomic-spatial analysis of 1,725 genomes linked to residential addresses found within-district transmission exceeded inter-district spread, with high-density districts acting as persistent exporters. Waves 3–5 originated in core districts—Wong Tai Sin (wave 3), Yau Tsim Mong (wave 4), and Sham Shui Po and Kwai Tsing (wave 5)—before broader spread. Wave 3 and 4 were driven by B.1.1.63 and B.1.36.27; wave 5 by Omicron BA.2.2, infecting roughly 45% of residents and causing substantial elderly mortality. Hong Kong reported over 2.6 million cases and more than 11,000 deaths by December 2022; initial waves were ~67% imported, then community transmission dominated. Subways and Octopus card flows were key predictors in a Bayesian GLM.

triage.headline_ja: 都市密度と地下鉄利用が香港のSARS-CoV-2変異株拡散を促進
triage.triage_reason: 2020〜2022年の過去流行(第3〜5波)に関する学術的・回顧的分析であり、現在進行中の公衆衛生上の脅威や新規性はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2020-2022年の過去のCOVID-19流行波に関する遺伝子疫学的・空間解析研究であり、現在の新規感染症イベントではない。香港はChina(1814991)に含めて集計。

article.articleHeadline: Boletim InfoGripe da Fiocruz aponta aumento nos casos confirmados de Covid-19
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz's InfoGripe Bulletin Indicates an Increase in Confirmed COVID-19 Cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 November 2026, Fiocruz's InfoGripe bulletin reports an uptick in confirmed COVID-19 cases in Brazil, reflecting renewed activity within the country's respiratory-syndrome surveillance system. The bulletin tracks the epidemiological landscape of respiratory illnesses nationwide and serves as a warning to health managers and the public. With rising case counts, experts urge keeping vaccination records up to date, increasing precautions in indoor environments, and seeking medical care for respiratory symptoms. The update underscores Brazil's ongoing monitoring of COVID-19 and other respiratory diseases and reinforces public-health messages to prevent transmission and ensure early treatment. These findings inform policymakers and healthcare providers in Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: フィオクルスのInfoGripe速報、COVID-19確定症例の増加を指摘
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は既知の流行病であり、通常のサーベイランス報告の範囲内で異常性や重大な公衆衛生インパクトを示す情報がないため。
triage.notes: 通常の季節性呼吸器疾患サーベイランス報告であり、重症度や死亡者数の増加、医療逼迫等の具体的データは記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Presos do Instituto Penal enfrentam surto de sarna há 14 dias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Inmates at the Penal Institute face a scabies outbreak that has lasted 14 days.
article.articleSummary: Inmates at Campo Grande's Instituto Penal de Campo Grande, located in the Jardim Noroeste penitentiary complex, are experiencing a human scabies outbreak for at least 14 days. The first case was recorded on 9 November. As of 23 November, only detainees show symptoms; there are no suspected staff cases. Agepen says health authorities are monitoring the situation, and a unit-wide outreach clinic is conducting assessments with support from the complex's health module; the State Health Secretariat (SES) has been alerted. Medications are being distributed to inmates, with treatments organized by housing blocks to reduce reinfestation risk. Movement between cells is restricted to limit spread. Educational actions on personal hygiene and prevention of new cases are planned. Ongoing assistance and sanitary control measures continue.

triage.headline_ja: 刑務所の収容者が14日間疥癬の集団発生に直面
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は公衆衛生上の重大性・国際拡大リスクが低く、刑務所内に限局した事案で管理体制も機能しているため、IHR・WPRO基準いずれも該当性が低い。
triage.notes: ブラジルで発生しているが、対象国リストにブラジル（3469034）が含まれるため確認。ただし事案は刑務所内に限局し、スクリーニング基準の該当は1つのみで社会的関心も低いためDISMISS。

article.articleHeadline: Divinópolis registra alta de casos de Covid-19 e Prefeitura alerta para vacinação - Portal MPA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Divinópolis reports a surge in COVID-19 cases and City Hall warns about vaccination - Portal MPA
article.articleSummary: Divinópolis, Minas Gerais, Brazil, reports a COVID-19 surge in 2026 with 406 confirmed cases through November 19 (101 in October, 231 in November), about 82% of the year’s total; no deaths in 2026. Statewide patterns show an October-initiated seasonal uptick with more mild/moderate influenza-like illness and no significant rise in severe illness or hospitalizations. Vaccination remains the most effective protection against progression to severe disease and death. Priority groups and schedules: 6 months–<5 years (up to three doses); pregnant people (one dose per pregnancy); 5–59 years never vaccinated (one dose); 60+ (one dose every six months); immunocompromised (semiannual); and special groups (health workers, Indigenous, quilombolas) for annual boosters per Ministry guidance. Check vaccination status at health units; reinforce prevention: hand hygiene, alcohol gel, ventilation, respiratory etiquette, masks for symptomatic individuals in enclosed or crowded spaces. Seek care for fever, cough, sore throat, or fatigue; urgent care for dyspnea, chest pain, or confusion.

triage.headline_ja: ディヴィノポリス市、COVID-19症例の増加を報告し、市当局がワクチン接種を呼びかけ - Portal MPA
triage.triage_reason: 季節的なCOVID-19症例の増加だが、重症例・死亡者の増加はなく、公的なワクチン接種広報の範囲内であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列。季節性のCOVID-19増加で重症化・死亡例なく、通常の公衆衛生対応（ワクチン接種呼びかけ）の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: Picos: Casos de hanseníase já superam total de 2025; veja sintomas e como tratar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Picos: Leprosy cases have already surpassed the 2025 total; see symptoms and how to treat.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 November 2026, Picos, Brazil, has diagnosed 21 leprosy (hansen’s disease) cases in 2026, three more than all of 2025 (18). Brazil recorded over 301,000 cases between 2015 and 2024, according to the Ministry of Health Epidemiological Bulletin. Leprosy is a bacterial infection primarily affecting skin and peripheral nerves; typical signs are skin lesions with altered sensation, though nerve involvement can occur without visible lesions. Delayed diagnosis can cause nerve damage, leading to weakness and loss of movement in hands and feet; incubation can extend for years. Transmission occurs from prolonged close contact with an untreated person; isolation in health facilities is not required. Treatment is free via SUS, using a three-drug regimen (rifampicin, dapsone, clofazimine) as PQT-U, for six months (paucibacillary) or twelve months (multibacillary). Early treatment stops transmission; contacts should be evaluated. Local officials project 15–25 cases annually, and 21 in 2026 falls within that range.

triage.headline_ja: ピクォス市:ハンセン病の症例数が2025年の年間合計を既に上回る;症状と治療法について
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病はブラジル国内で既知の風土病であり、報告数も想定範囲内（年間15〜25件）であるため、異常性や緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体の年次統計報告であり、予測範囲内の件数。ハンセン病は長期潜伏・緩徐進行性の慢性感染症で、急性の公衆衛生危機を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de sarna atinge internos do presídio no Jardim Noroeste
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scabies outbreak hits inmates at the prison in Jardim Noroeste.
article.articleSummary: Scabies outbreak among inmates at Instituto Penal de Campo Grande (IPCG) in Jardim Noroeste, Campo Grande, Brazil, has persisted for at least 14 days. Since identifying suspected scabies cases on 9 November, the State Penitentiary Administration Agency (Agepen), in coordination with the Secretaria de Estado de Saúde (SES), has implemented sanitary and clinical measures. There are no suspected cases among staff. A health mutirão is underway with the complex's health module to evaluate inmates and provide treatments as indicated. Actions include distributing medications, organizing treatment by gallery to reduce reinfection risk, and restricting inmate movement between cells. Educational efforts on personal hygiene and prevention are planned. Measures remain in place under SES supervision to monitor and control transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ジャルジン・ノロエステの刑務所で疥癬の発生、収容者に拡大
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は重症度・国際的拡大リスクが低く、刑務所内で既に対策が講じられており管理可能であるため、シグナルとして取り上げる必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 刑務所という閉鎖環境での集団発生だが、疥癬は一般的に重症度が低く、地元当局（Agepen・SES）により既に管理されている。国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクはない。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de catapora acendem alerta para vacinação no Piauí
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chickenpox cases spark vaccination alert in Piauí
article.articleSummary: Chickenpox (varicella) cases in Lagoa do Piauí, Piauí, Brazil, led to school suspension as adolescents were affected; the state Health Secretariat ruled out mpox contagion. In Teresina, 128 varicella cases have been reported this year. The Municipal Health Foundation urged vaccination against chickenpox, with immunization delivered by the SUS under the National Immunization Program. People are advised to bring their vaccine card, ID, and CPF or SUS card; if unavailable, SAME can issue a SUS card, but CPF aids record accuracy. Infectious disease physician Luciano Mourão cautioned that varicella symptoms resemble other illnesses (fever, headache, malaise) but skin lesions are characteristic, and patients should isolate until resolved.

triage.headline_ja: ピアウイ州で水痘症例が増加、ワクチン接種への警戒呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 水痘（varicella）はありふれた疾患で、サル痘との関連も当局が否定しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は水痘（Varicella）の流行とワクチン接種呼びかけが主題。Mpoxは当局により否定的に言及されているのみ。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列。

article.articleHeadline: As Ebola spreads in Congo, Anglican, faith leaders reach communities health workers struggle to access
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-virus Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is the world’s second-largest on record, affecting eight provinces including North Kivu (Beni, Goma). As of Nov 9, 2026, DRC reported 11,042 confirmed cases and 5,387 deaths. The virus has crossed borders to Uganda (20 cases, 2 deaths) and Kenya (9 cases, 2 deaths); Uganda has since controlled the outbreak, and Kenya discharged its last patient in November with a 42‑day monitoring period to declare Ebola-free. In conflict-affected eastern Congo, health workers face access barriers, prompting faith leaders to go door-to-door to secure cooperation, facilitate testing, and advocate safer burials. Anglophone and evangelical leaders, including Patrick Lokombe (Anglican, Beni) and Francis Mbombo (Goma), highlight training from the African Christian Health Associations Platform that aids symptom recognition and referrals. WHO (Nov 6) notes declines in some areas but ongoing high transmission, emphasizing community engagement amid M23 violence.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱が拡大する中、聖公会・信仰指導者がコミュニティにアクセス、医療従事者はアクセス困難に苦慮
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去2番目の規模のエボラ流行が継続中で、国境を越えてウガンダ・ケニアにも感染が拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境感染が報告されているが両国とも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。紛争（M23武装勢力）が医療アクセスを阻害している点も注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Bahia tem novo caso de Mpox confirmado e investiga nova suspeita da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bahia has a new confirmed mpox case and is investigating a new suspected case of the disease.
article.articleSummary: Bahia reports a confirmed monkeypox case in Vitória da Conquista, with a second probable case under investigation. The confirmed patient is a man aged 40–49 who developed symptoms on Oct 30; Lacen-BA confirmed the diagnosis on Nov 21. He remains in home isolation, with improvement. Epidemiological tracing links the case to prolonged intimate contact with a person residing abroad who briefly visited Vitória da Conquista; the infection site is under investigation. A close contact who developed compatible symptoms is a suspected case; both cases are in home isolation awaiting test results. Bahia now has six confirmed monkeypox cases in 2026; two prior infections were likely acquired in Bahia (Salvador, Mata de São João) and three in other states (Osasco, SP; Maceió, AL). Transmission is mainly through contact with lesions, mucous membranes, or secretions; intimate contact carries higher risk. Symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, lymphadenopathy, and skin or mucosal lesions.

triage.headline_ja: バイーア州でMpoxの新たな確定症例が発生、疑い例を調査中
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・バイーア州で散発的なMpox症例が継続確認されているが、重症度や急速な拡大の兆候はなく、既知の流行パターンの範囲内であるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 2026年にバイーア州で6例目の確定症例。親密接触による感染拡大が続いており、散発的な国内伝播パターンとして経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: MS registra 31 casos de sarna humana em 12 municípios
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health reports 31 cases of human scabies in 12 municipalities.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 November 2026, 31 human scabies cases have been reported in 12 municipalities of Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, including Dourados, Angélica, Campo Grande, Itaporã, Douradina, Fátima do Sul, Batayporã, Inocência, Jardim, Paranaíba, Aparecida do Taboado, and São Gabriel do Oeste. Scabies is caused by Sarcoptes scabiei and presents with intense nocturnal itching and skin lesions. Transmission occurs via prolonged direct skin contact, sharing clothing or bedding, and close contact in communal settings. The SES-MS notes scabies is not on the National List of Notifiable Diseases; outbreaks are defined locally as three or more cases in one location, with municipal health secretaries leading investigations and the SES providing technical support. Some outbreaks led to temporary school suspensions in Dourados, Itaporã, and Campo Grande, but the capital reports no outbreak. Prevention emphasizes hygiene and avoiding sharing personal items.

triage.headline_ja: MS州、12市町村で疥癬（人間）31例を報告
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は軽症・局所限定の皮膚疾患であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、国の届出対象疾患にも含まれていないため、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 疥癬は重症度が低く、学校の一時休校はあったが大規模な公衆衛生上の脅威には至っていない。地域の技術支援のみで対応可能なレベル。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 volta a crescer em seis estados, mas não é momento para pânico - Conexão Tocantins - Portal de Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 is rising again in six states, but it's not the time to panic - Conexão Tocantins - News Portal
article.articleSummary: COVID-19–related SRAG cases have risen in São Paulo, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, Paraná, Federal District and Bahia, Brazil, per Fiocruz’s InfoGripe bulletin, November 12, 2026. Hospitalizations remain low, and SRAG from all respiratory viruses is falling nationwide. The Omicron-derived lineage XFG and descendants now account for about 90% of sequenced samples in 2026. With year-end travel, vaccination should be reviewed; protection includes influenza and RSV vaccines where available, plus precautions. Common symptoms resemble a cold or flu: sore throat, runny nose, nasal congestion, cough, fever or chills, fatigue, headaches, and sometimes loss of smell or taste. Alarm signs include dyspnea, chest pain, cyanosis, confusion, fever >3 days, or deterioration after improvement. Testing confirms COVID amid other viruses; early antivirals benefit high-risk groups. On SUS, vaccination is advised for elderly 60+, immunocompromised 5+, pregnant people, children 6 months–<5, and high-risk groups; healthy adults with prior vaccination have no routine booster.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19が6州で再び増加、しかしパニックになる時ではない - Conexão Tocantins - ニュースポータル
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19のSRAG症例増加だが入院率は低く、全呼吸器ウイルス由来のSRAGは全国的に減少傾向。既知のOmicron系統（XFG）が主体で、季節性の通常範囲の変動とみられ、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列。既知の変異株による季節性の軽度な増加であり、ワクチン接種呼びかけなど通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: UK Study Identifies 38 Percent Error Rate in Malaria Prescriptions
article.articleSummary: Two UK secondary-care hospitals (Queen Elizabeth Hospital Birmingham; Birmingham Heartlands Hospital) conducted a retrospective quality‑improvement study of adult imported malaria diagnosed Jan 2023–Dec 2025, including 91 patients with laboratory-confirmed malaria. Nigeria accounted for 35% of travel-associated cases, followed by Congo, Sudan, Sierra Leone; Pakistan 15%, India, Bangladesh, with 38% reporting mosquito bites. Malaria was the initial working diagnosis in 64% of presentations. Rapid diagnostic testing was positive in all cases; peripheral blood films failed to visualise parasites in three. Plasmodium falciparum predominated (66%), P. vivax 27%; 12% had parasitaemia >2%; two required ICU. Time from laboratory diagnosis to the first antimalarial dose was seven hours, driven by drug stock issues and prescribing inaccuracies. Length of stay 3 days. Authors propose standardised malaria pathways, mandatory infectious diseases consultation, electronic prescribing with dose validation, improved pharmacy stock governance, and multidisciplinary audits to reduce delays and errors in imported malaria care.

triage.headline_ja: 英国の研究、マラリア処方における38%のエラー率を特定
triage.triage_reason: 英国の2病院における輸入マラリア症例の診療プロセス改善に関する後ろ向き研究であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威や異常な感染拡大を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は英国国内の医療の質改善研究であり、輸入マラリアの感染元としてナイジェリア・コンゴ・スーダン・シエラレオネ・パキスタン・インド・バングラデシュが言及されているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCとインドのみ。これらの国で新規の流行が発生しているわけではなく、単に渡航者の感染元として言及されているに過ぎない。

article.articleHeadline: Estas son las restricciones en México, EU y Canadá por Ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: These are the restrictions in Mexico, the EU, and Canada due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Mexico, the European Union, and Canada tighten travel restrictions amid the Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in Africa, with over 5,000 deaths. Mexico's preventive notices (Oct 21) urge avoiding travel to the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, Kenya, and South Sudan due to active Bundibugyo outbreaks; risk depends on 21-day exposure and contact with infected fluids. Since Oct 22, the U.S. CDC requires travelers to declare no recent presence in DRC or ties to the U.S. within 21 days before boarding. Canada suspended immigration documents for travelers from affected African countries through Nov 29. WHO, as of Nov 15, 2026, reports high, sustained Bundibugyo transmission in DRC; week 46 records 442 confirmed cases and 239 deaths (week 45: 458/228). Ebola viruses are Filoviridae; Bundibugyo virus was described in 2007 after a Ugandan outbreak near the DRC border. Transmission is zoonotic, then human-to-human via blood, secretions, or contaminated materials.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、EU、カナダがエボラ出血熱により実施している渡航制限について
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスの持続的な人-人感染と高い致死率（週単位で400例超・200例超の死亡）が確認され、複数国が渡航制限を導入しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、南スーダンも記事中に言及されるが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。米国・メキシコ・カナダは渡航制限実施国であり発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases pass 11,700, but the CDC says the risk to Americans remains low
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has 11,712 confirmed cases and 5,720 deaths (CDC update, data through Nov 18; published Nov 23, 2026). Nearly all cases are in DRC: 11,680 cases and 5,715 deaths. No US cases; risk to Americans remains very low and Congo travel restrictions stay in place. Outside Congo, Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths; Kenya 9 cases and 2 deaths; Nigeria and France 1 case each. The toll is likely higher due to suspected cases not counted. About 400–500 new cases weekly across 67 health zones in eight provinces. Two-thirds of deaths occur in communities; over 80 attacks on health care have been recorded. Children under 18 account for 28% of cases but 35% of deaths; under-5 fatality about 72%. Bundibugyo virus has no licensed vaccine or specific treatment; isolation, contact tracing, and safe burials remain core measures. Green-card travel rule expires Nov 27; no extension notice as of Nov 23.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染者数が11,700人を超えるも、CDCは米国民へのリスクは依然として低いとしている
triage.triage_reason: DRCで11,700件超・死者5,720人の大規模エボラ(ブンディブギョ型)アウトブレイクが継続中で、既にウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランスへ拡大、ワクチン・治療法未承認かつ渡航制限も実施されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUS, France, Kenya, Uganda, Nigeriaが含まれるが、いずれも対象国リスト外のため除外。感染の中心はDRCであり、同国のみverified_locationsに計上。ワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しないブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスである点、医療従事者への攻撃が80件超発生している点も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Piauí tem dois casos confirmados e dois suspeitos de Mpox
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Piauí has two confirmed cases and two suspected cases of Mpox
article.articleSummary: Two confirmed mpox cases and two suspected in Piauí, Brazil, per the Ministry of Health’s Disease Monitoring Panel. This marks the state's first mpox activity in two years (last case in 2024). Confirmations occurred in weeks 41 (Oct 11–17) and 45 (Nov 8–14). Among the confirmed, one patient is male and the other’s gender is unreported; ages 30–39 and 40–49. Since 2022, Piauí has 39 mpox cases (32 in 2022, 3 in 2023, 2 in 2024, 0 in 2025). In the Northeast, Ceará leads with 189, followed by Piauí, with Sergipe at 1 and Alagoas at 0. Transmission is mainly via close contact in urban centers; symptoms include skin lesions, fever, lymphadenopathy, headache, body aches, chills, and weakness. Vaccination is targeted (two doses, 28 days) and given intradermally to expand coverage; not mass vaccination and requires registration at a reference service, not UBS.

triage.headline_ja: ピアウイ州でMpox確定症例2件、疑い症例2件
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ピアウイ州における小規模なMpox症例報告であり、過去から散発的に発生している既知の状況で、重大性・異常性・国際拡大リスクはいずれも低い。
triage.notes: ピアウイ州では2022年以降累計39例、2025年は0例だったが2026年に再発。地域の疾病監視パネルによる定例報告の範疇であり、ターゲット接種で対応中。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: une équipe de riposte à Ebola évacuée en raison de l'insécurité au nord de Bunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: an Ebola response team evacuated due to insecurity north of Bunia
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak under pressure as security incidents force evacuation of an Ebola response team north of Bunia, Ituri. As of 23 November 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports over 11,300 confirmed Ebola cases and 5,568 deaths. WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus said the response team was trapped for about 48 hours in a hospital due to nearby fighting, and had to be evacuated to Bunia on the evening of 23 November. The incident occurred in Mangala health zone near Fataki, north of Bunia. Since Sunday, heavy clashes between the Congolese army and the armed group CRP (Convention révolutionnaire populaire) in Djugu territory have intensified, triggering large population displacements. Although a ceasefire had been announced in May, CRP renewed offensives, severely hampering outbreak response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：ブニア北部の治安悪化によりエボラ対応チームが避難
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の大規模エボラ流行（確定症例11,300例超、死亡5,568例）が武装勢力との衝突により対応活動に支障をきたしており、国際的な公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念と緊急の国際支援の必要性がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域に含まれるState of South Australia/Commonwealth of Australiaは記事の主題と無関係なため除外。治安悪化（CRPとの戦闘）により対応チームの退避・住民の大規模避難が発生しており、アウトブレイク制御への深刻なリスクとなっている。

article.articleHeadline: दिल्ली में मलेरिया ने बढ़ाई टेंशन, डेंगू की रफ्तार हुई धीमी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria in Delhi heightens tensions; the pace of dengue slows.
article.articleSummary: Post-COVID, malaria, chikungunya, and Japanese encephalitis rose in Delhi-NCR, while dengue's growth slowed but viral evolution alarms researchers. A January 2026 study by ICMR Vector Control Research Centre analyzes five mosquito-borne diseases from 2014–2024, excluding 2020 pandemic-year data to compare pre- and post-pandemic trends. In the National Capital Region during 2023, 4,045 samples were tested; 3,702 (91.5%) harbored dengue virus serotype 2. CSIR-IGIB reported mutations in dengue genes that may be linked to severe disease. Public awareness helped cut household mosquito larvae by 21.65% to 4.45%. Delhi’s sanitation drives and campaigns reduced breeding potential, with Safdarjung Hospital correlating dengue incidence with monsoon-related temperature, rainfall and humidity; September–October are peak months as standing water around homes fosters vector proliferation. An AIIMS-Delhi/PGI-Chandigarh study of 44 children indicated a possible but not conclusive link between COVID infection signs and severe dengue. Prevention remains focused on elimination of standing water and cleanliness.

triage.headline_ja: デリーでマラリアが懸念を高める一方、デング熱の拡大ペースは鈍化
triage.triage_reason: 蚊媒介性疾患の長期的トレンド分析であり、急性の公衆衛生危機ではないが、デング熱の遺伝子変異や重症化リスクなど継続的な監視が必要な情報を含む。
triage.notes: 研究レビュー・疫学トレンド分析記事であり、特定の急性アウトブレイクの報告ではない。デング熱ウイルスの変異や重症化との関連性については継続的な観察が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : une équipe de riposte contre Ebola évacuée après près de 48 heures bloquée
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: an Ebola response team evacuated after nearly 48 hours of being blocked.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola response team in the Democratic Republic of the Congo was evacuated to Bunia after nearly 48 hours blocked at a hospital in the Mangala health zone near Fataki, Ituri, on the night of 23 November 2026. The delay underscores ongoing insecurity in eastern DRC that WHO chief Tedros Ghebreyesus says hampers outbreak response. Fighting between the Congolese army and the armed group Convention révolutionnaire populaire (CRP) in Djugu north of Bunia has intensified. Attacks on responders have cost lives: on 5 November, an assault by the Allied Democratic Forces at Cantine-Aloya killed 66 civilians, including three health workers. In August, attackers in Aru vandalized vehicles and an ambulance was burned in Biringi, disrupting surveillance of suspected cases. Since May 2026, WHO warned of a potential collision between virus spread and insecurity as the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak advances, with a ceasefire collapsed and CRP offensives renewed.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラ対応チームが約48時間拘束された後、避難
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに対する対応活動が治安悪化により妨げられており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当し、WHOも懸念を表明していることから、フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部イトゥリ州における治安悪化（武装勢力CRP・ADFの攻撃）がエボラ対応活動を妨げている状況を報告。2026年5月以降継続中のブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスのアウトブレイクに関連する続報であり、既存の危機の深刻化を示す情報として評価。

article.articleHeadline: പക്ഷിപ്പനി:​ അണുനശീകരണം കഴിഞ്ഞു,​ ഇനി നിരീക്ഷണം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza: Decontamination completed, monitoring underway.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 November 2026, avian influenza (Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza Type A) has been confirmed in Alappuzha district, Kerala, affecting Ampalapuzha North, Chennithala, and Thrippunithura panchayats. Decontamination of affected zones is complete; 18,620 poultry within 1 km of source centers have been culled, including 7,331 birds in Ampalapuzha North and 11,289 in Chennithala–Thrippunithura, covering farmed and household birds. A 10 km monitoring belt around source centers will run for three months, with biweekly sampling sent to NIHSAD (Bhopal) for testing; declaration of disease-free requires three consecutive negative months. Authorities cite migratory birds as the introducers, with water bodies facilitating spillover to local birds. In the 10 km radius, poultry, eggs, meat, and related trade/movement are banned for one week to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ：消毒作業完了、現在は監視中
triage.triage_reason: 家禽における高病原性鳥インフルエンザ（H5）の発生で、殺処分・消毒は既に完了し監視体制に移行しているが、渡り鳥由来の感染拡大経路や今後のヒトへの波及可能性について情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。

article.articleHeadline: Equipes percorrem bairros do Rio para prevenção de arboviroses - Prefeitura da Cidade do Rio de Janeiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Teams patrol Rio's neighborhoods to prevent arboviral diseases - Rio de Janeiro City Hall
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro's City Hall reports that 16 additional neighborhoods will be covered by the SVS na Rua initiative, run by the Municipal Health Secretariat's Health Surveillance Superintendency, to inspect homes for Aedes aegypti and mobilize residents against arboviral diseases (dengue, Zika, chikungunya). Inspections are scheduled for November 25–27, targeting Santa Teresa, Leme, Penha, Bancários, Barra da Tijuca, Praça Seca on 25; Tijuca, Maracanã, Ramos, Engenho de Dentro, Pavuna, Colégio, Realengo, Inhoaíba, Campo Grande, Guaratiba on 26; and Guaratiba again on 27. As of November 14 this year, 10,634,095 property visits were conducted for prevention/control of Aedes aegypti, and 1,454,024 potential breeding containers were treated or eliminated. In 2025, 12,297,072 property visits and 1,684,674 containers were treated/eliminated. Educational actions are priorities; residents can request inspections or report breeding sites via Central 1746.

article.articleHeadline: INSA confirma: nova variante do SARS-CoV-2 foi detetada em Portugal em outubro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: INSA confirms: a new SARS-CoV-2 variant was detected in Portugal in October.
article.articleSummary: Portugal detected SARS-CoV-2 variant PJ.2.1 in October 2026. PJ.2.1 is in the Omicron family, linked to lineage JN.1; first identified in Ontario, Canada in May 2026, later found in the United States, Brazil, and Europe (United Kingdom, Spain, France, Netherlands). INSA states PJ.2.1 warrants scientific follow-up but does not imply higher transmissibility, greater severity, or increased population risk. Since September 2026, COVID-19 cases have risen; ENCLAI.net reports Portugal with 1,925 cases in 2026 through November 9 (2025 total: 869; 2026 notifications place Portugal 24th among 55 countries). The variant carries several Spike protein mutations; laboratory data suggest potentially easier cell entry with possibly lower immune escape, but not proven to be more transmissible or more severe. Vaccination—specifically the XFG-adapted vaccine for 2026/2027—appears to neutralize PJ.2.1. Continuous surveillance for subvariants is urged. A concurrent Influenza A H1N1 mutation (G155E) is contributing to early flu activity in some countries, underscoring vaccination importance.

triage.headline_ja: INSA（ポルトガル国立保健研究所）が確認：新たなSARS-CoV-2変異株が10月にポルトガルで検出
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株PJ.2.1はオミクロン系統で複数国に拡大しているが、INSAは伝播性・重症度の増加を示すエビデンスはないとしており、現時点では通常の変異株サーベイランスの範囲内と判断されるため。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はポルトガルでの新変異株PJ.2.1検出だが、ポルトガルは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブラジルは変異株が実際に検出された国として記載されているため含めた。カナダ・米国・欧州各国も言及されているが対象国リストに該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: Sabesp: bactéria aparece em 137 amostras de água de 68 cidades de SP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sabesp: Bacteria detected in 137 water samples from 68 cities in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: Escherichia coli bacteria were detected in 137 Sabesp-distributed water samples from 68 municipalities in São Paulo, Brazil, between January and September 2026, per NC News citing Health Ministry data. São Paulo city led with 21 positives, followed by São José dos Campos with nine; Sabesp says subsequent recoletas were negative and the water is fit for consumption. Data come from Sisagua; Portaria 888/2021 bans E. coli in treated water. A positive result signals possible fecal contamination and prompts investigation, not necessarily illness. In São José dos Campos, nine detections occurred Jan–Jun in districts including Jardim Aquarius, Jardim Satélite and Jardim Telespark, with two at school collection points. The city logged 411 out-of-spec results Jan–Sep from 5,737 analyses; Arsesp will require preventive measures. In Itapeva, Cryptosporidium was found in 4 of 10 samples; 4,767 diarrhea-related visits occurred Sep 13–Nov 7 and a 180-day calamity was declared. Sabesp plans about R$50 million in countermeasures; Arsesp fined R$700k.

triage.headline_ja: サベスパ：サンパウロ州68都市の水道水サンプル137件で細菌を検出
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州68都市の水道水から広範囲にE. coli汚染が確認され、一部地域ではCryptosporidiumも検出、下痢症急増により180日間の非常事態宣言に至っており、IHR基準2項目・WPRO基準複数に該当するためフルリスク評価が適切。
triage.notes: イタペヴァ市では下痢関連受診が4,767件(9/13-11/7)発生し180日間の非常事態宣言が出されている。サベスパは約5,000万レアルの対策費を計画、Arsespは70万レアルの罰金を科した。国内対応中心で国際的な拡大や渡航制限の兆候はないが、公衆衛生上のインパクトと異常性からピックアップ相当と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Onchocerciasis Antibody Levels Decrease With Distance From Blackfly
article.articleSummary: Onchocerciasis transmission around the Simulium damnosum s.l. breeding site near Asubende, Ghana, shows spatial heterogeneity in anti-Ov16 IgG4 seroprevalence. A Sept–Nov 2024 cross-sectional survey across 30 settlements (n=2,479 participants aged ≥3 years) used Ov16 rapid diagnostic tests on dried blood spots to assess exposure. Overall seroprevalence was 10.0% (95% CI 8.9–11.3%), with seropositivity increasing with age and varying by location (0–24.4%). Among 584 children under ten, seroprevalence was 1.5% (95% CI 0.7–2.9%), and after adjusting for test performance, estimated at 0.7% (95% CI 0–2.4%). Seropositive children were detected up to 18 km from the breeding site, but none were found directly at the breeding site. Spatial modeling indicates higher exposure near river habitats. Authors recommend broader spatial sampling beyond riverbank settlements to robustly inform stopping criteria for ivermectin MDA per WHO guidelines.

triage.notes: 本記事はガーナ・アスベンデ地域でのオンコセルカ症（河川盲目症）に関する学術的な血清疫学調査結果を報告するもの。既存のWHOイベルメクチンMDAプログラムの停止基準を検討するための研究であり、新規アウトブレイクや緊急事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird Flu: Surveillance at Checkposts Including Walayar.
article.articleSummary: As of 24 November 2026, Tamil Nadu's Animal Husbandry Department has set up surveillance at 12 checkposts along the Coimbatore border to inspect goods vehicles from Kerala in response to avian influenza reports in Kerala and Tamil Nadu. Checkposts include Walayar, Velanthavalam, Anakkatti, and nine others. Vehicles transporting poultry are being disinfected, with inspections led by Joint Director Chitra at Walayar. Following recent avian influenza reports in Kerala's Alappuzha district and in Tamil Nadu, the Namakkal region faces an egg-export disruption. Authorities fear spread and have strengthened control measures. Goods vehicles from Kerala are halted at borders and logged by origin district; vehicles carrying chickens are disinfected before crossing.

article.articleHeadline: Bactéria Escherichia coli é identificada em amostras de água da Sabesp em cidades paulistas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Escherichia coli bacterium identified in Sabesp water samples in cities in the state of São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: Escherichia coli detected in 137 Sabesp water samples across 68 municipalities in São Paulo state between January and September 2026. São Paulo city led with 21 positives, followed by São José dos Campos with 9. Under Portaria 888/2021, E. coli is strictly forbidden in any treated drinking water. A positive result signals possible fecal contamination but does not by itself prove population exposure or disease outbreaks. In São José dos Campos, positives clustered in residential areas and at public-school collection points, with hundreds of deviations in potability parameters like turbidity and chlorine; Sabesp reported thousands of analyses with subsequent re-sampling showing negative results for E. coli, and Arsesp will pursue additional preventive actions. In Itapeva, Cryptosporidium was detected in the distribution network, with thousands of acute diarrheal cases reported in recent months; the municipality declared a calamity. The concessionaire announced investments in filtration, while regulators issued sanctions.

article.articleHeadline: Meta-Analysis Reveals Substantial Hepatitis B and C Burdens Across Indian
article.articleSummary: India-wide meta-analysis estimates pooled seroprevalence of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) at 3.0% (95% CI 2.0–4.0) across 693,879 participants, and anti-HCV positivity at 4.0% (95% CI 2.0–7.0) across 1,079,706 individuals. HBs prevalence is highest in Northern and Western India at 3.0%. HCV seroprevalence shows regional divergence, with Eastern India at 10.0% (highest) and Northern India at 6.0%, with high-risk populations reaching 11.0%. The review included 87 studies (61 HBV, 69 HCV) from 1999–Sept 2024; heterogeneity is extreme (I^2 > 99%). Only 19 studies (21.8%) used molecular confirmation (RT-PCR or HBV DNA/HCV RNA); many relied on serology. Authors call for expanded community screening, decentralization of molecular testing, and stronger linkage-to-care to advance India’s National Viral Hepatitis Control Programme and WHO 2030 elimination targets.

article.articleHeadline: IIT, ILS secure patent for homegrown TB vaccine
article.articleSummary: TB vaccine KochVac advances in India as IIT Bhubaneswar and ILS Bhubaneswar secure a patent for a protein subunit vaccine against Mycobacterium tuberculosis. The patent 'A Protein Subunit Vaccine Composition Against Mycobacterium tuberculosis' was granted on Nov 16, 2026. The vaccine candidate, developed by Ashis Biswas's team at IIT Bhubaneswar, shows protective efficacy in mouse models, particularly when administered with the existing BCG vaccine. Sunil Raghav’s ILS team evaluated immunogenicity and protection in mice. The candidate has been selected by Tuberculosis Vaccine Initiative and is undergoing further preclinical evaluation in the UK. A four-party technology transfer and commercialization agreement links IIT Bhubaneswar, ILS Bhubaneswar, NRDC, and Techinvention Lifecare Limited of Mumbai. Techinvention Lifecare has begun preclinical animal studies for KochVac, aiming human trials in H2 2027. The program targets enhanced humoral and cell-mediated responses beyond BCG, addressing WHO’s 2024 TB toll of 1.23 million deaths.

article.articleHeadline: Computational Study Identifies Potential Host Furin Cleavage of Toxoplasma
article.articleSummary: Computational study investigates whether Toxoplasma gondii exploits human furin to process invasion-related proteins during entry into intestinal epithelial cells. T. gondii causes toxoplasmosis, infecting roughly one-third of humans globally; congenital toxoplasmosis in India affects about 56,737 infants annually, with 22% of pregnant women infected. The parasite invades via moving junction after secreting microneme and rhoptry proteins, forming a parasitophorous vacuole. The study screens 15 parasite proteins from ToxoDB for furin-like motifs using ProP 1.0 (threshold 0.50), classifying motifs into high (≥0.70), moderate (0.60–0.69), and low (0.50–0.59). Five targets underwent 3D modeling with I-TASSER: TgAMA1, TgRON4, TgMIC8, TgGRA21, TgROP11. Structural validation used Ramachandran plots, ProSA Z-scores, and energy profiling. High-confidence furin motifs were found in ROP11, AMA1, and RON4; MIC8 and GRA21 were moderate. The results suggest host furin could cleave invasion factors, warranting further experimental validation.

article.articleHeadline: Brasil teve mais de 600 casos de Mpox em novembro; SP lidera disparada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil had more than 600 Mpox cases in November; São Paulo leads the surge.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (Monkeypox) in Brazil: 627 cases in November 2026, raising the year total to 1,479—up 103.6% from October’s 308. Four states reported no Mpox cases in 2026: Acre, Alagoas, Amapá, and Tocantins. São Paulo State leads with 533 confirmed cases in 2026, followed by Rio de Janeiro (432) and Ceará (189). On November 23, the São Paulo Health Secretariat began distributing 1,000 Mpox vaccine doses to municipalities via Groups of Epidemiological Surveillance, prioritizing HIV/AIDS patients with greater immunosuppression, PrEP users, laboratory professionals, and individuals with medium/high‑risk exposure after health service assessment. Mpox is caused by an Orthopoxvirus and transmits through close contact with skin lesions, body fluids, respiratory secretions, and sometimes sexual contact. Symptoms include fever, malaise, muscle pains, lymphadenopathy, and evolving skin lesions to crusts. Clade 1 is more transmissible/severe than Clade 2; treatment is supportive, with prevention emphasizing hygiene, isolation, and avoiding shared items.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで11月にMpox感染者600人超、サンパウロ州が急増をリード
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内でMpox症例が前月比103.6%増と急増しており、WPRO基準（異常性・継続的曝露・流行しやすさ）に複数該当し、政府によるワクチン配布対応など社会的関心も確認されるため。

article.articleHeadline: Botucatu tem 1° caso confirmado de Mpox
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Botucatu has its first confirmed Mpox case.
article.articleSummary: Botucatu, São Paulo, Brazil, reports its first confirmed mpox case for 2026. The patient, a man aged 40-44, presented skin lesions with fever and lymphadenopathy; diagnosis confirmed last week and he remains at home under treatment. The CIEVS-SP panel lists two suspected cases under investigation and one discarded in Botucatu's GVE. Nationwide in São Paulo, 508 mpox cases have been confirmed in 2026 up to 23 November, with no deaths; the Bauru region has no confirmed cases. A new Ministry of Health batch of 1,000 vaccine doses arrived; Botucatu GVE received 8 doses and Bauru 12. Vaccination targets include people living with HIV/AIDS with greater immunosuppression, PrEP users, lab professionals exposed to the virus, and contacts of cases at medium/high risk. Transmission occurs mainly via direct contact with lesions/secretions and contaminated objects; symptoms include skin/mucosal lesions and fever.

article.articleHeadline: World Health Organization Warns Rebels and Jihadis Are Making Ebola Worse
article.articleSummary: Over 11,000 Ebola cases and 5,678 deaths have been recorded in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Ituri province at the center of the outbreak. Satellite imagery and gravedigger testimony suggest deaths may be undercounted by as much as 50%, raising concerns the outbreak could be two to four times larger than official tallies. The World Health Organization notes that heavy fighting since yesterday near a hospital in Ituri has disrupted care and forced health workers to shelter, hindering the response across eastern DRC. More than 87 attacks on healthcare have been confirmed, blocking contact tracing and treatment. The ADF (ISIS-linked jihadi group), CRP, and M23 are active; they obstruct medical access and drive civilian displacement into crowded camps. The outbreak was declared May 15 but began weeks or months earlier, with many deaths outside treatment centers, especially among young children.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、反政府勢力とジハード主義者がエボラ出血熱を悪化させていると警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州での大規模エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（11,000例超、死者5,678人、過小報告の懸念）に加え、武装勢力による医療妨害・攻撃が対応を著しく阻害しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 死亡数が公式統計の2〜4倍に達する可能性が示唆されており、武装勢力（ADF、CRP、M23）による医療施設攻撃が87件以上確認され、接触者追跡と治療が妨げられている。避難民キャンプの過密状態も感染拡大リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: PJ.2.1: Desde Canadá llegó a Río de Janeiro la nueva variante de Covid-19
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PJ.2.1: From Canada, the new COVID-19 variant arrived in Rio de Janeiro.
article.articleSummary: Originating in Canada, PJ.2.1 is a SARS-CoV-2 lineage designated a variant under surveillance (VUM) with rising global proportions, driven by detections in the Americas—especially Canada and the United States. It arrived in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, identified by IOC/Fiocruz with the Municipal Health Secretariat. In 96 of 167 sequenced samples (58%) from Oct 17 to Nov 6, the variant was detected; appearance in Brazil dates to late August amid a surge in respiratory illnesses. The WHO added PJ.2.1 to the VUM list on Nov 19, assessing global public-health risk as low with low confidence. Lab data indicate increased ACE2 binding and limited immune escape; boosters designed to XFG neutralize PJ.2.1. Clinical data are insufficient to confirm greater severity. By Nov 23, 2026, Rio reported 9,882 COVID-19 cases in 2026; vaccines remain available for defined groups and prevention guidance is unchanged.

triage.headline_ja: PJ.2.1：カナダからリオデジャネイロに新型COVID-19変異株が到達
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株PJ.2.1はWHOにより監視対象変異株（VUM）に指定されたが、公衆衛生リスクは「低い」と評価されており、重症度増加の確証もないため、現時点ではフルRRAより継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: WHOは2026年11月19日にPJ.2.1をVUMに追加し、グローバルリスクを低（低信頼度）と評価。ブラジル・リオデジャネイロでは8月下旬から検出が始まり、10月17日〜11月6日の検体の58%で検出。臨床的重症度増加の確証なし。カナダ・米国由来とされるが、ブラジル（リオ）が主要な発生地として記事の主題であるため、Brazilのみをverified_locationsに計上。

article.articleHeadline: Comitê reforça ações para evitar transmissão de doenças de mães para bebês
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Committee Reinforces Actions to Prevent Mother-to-Child Transmission of Diseases.
article.articleSummary: Porto Velho reinforces actions to prevent mother-to-child transmission of infections during pregnancy, delivery, and breastfeeding. At the Second Ordinary Meeting of the Municipal Committee for Investigation of Vertical Transmission (CMITV), held last week, the group continued measures started in August, updated its composition and internal rules, and convened technical and care teams to strengthen attention to pregnant women, puerperae, and newborns. The committee addresses vertical transmission of syphilis, HIV, HTLV, hepatitis B, and, now, Chagas disease, reviewing cases, assessing scenarios, and coordinating referrals to minimize congenital infections in the public network. Mayor Léo Moraes highlighted integrated health work to ensure timely tests, treatment, and safe births in Porto Velho. The session included a DAB briefing on services and upcoming commitments, aiming to identify pregnancies early and maintain close preventive follow-up. Cemiremes Silva Parente Fernandes, coordinator of Viral Hepatitis Surveillance, stressed solving real network situations to protect families.

triage.headline_ja: 委員会、母子感染防止のための対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ポルトベーリョ市の既存の母子感染（垂直感染）予防体制強化に関する行政的な活動報告であり、異常な公衆衛生事象や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は地方自治体レベルの既存プログラム（母子感染防止委員会）の定例会議報告であり、新規アウトブレイクやシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: தமிழகத்தில் 574 இடங்களில் டெங்கு கொசுக்கள் உற்பத்தி: சுகாதாரத் துறை
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue mosquitoes breeding in 574 locations in Tamil Nadu: Health Department.
article.articleSummary: As of November 24, 2026, Tamil Nadu Health Department reports dengue-fever mosquitoes breeding at 574 locations across the state. In a statewide surveillance, mosquitoes and larvae were collected from 13,148 sites across all health districts and sent for testing; 574 sites yielded dengue-capable mosquitoes. The rise in influenza and dengue is linked to recent heavy rainfall, with increased hospital admissions for related symptoms. The department is expanding treatment infrastructure and preventive measures statewide and intensifying surveys to identify breeding sites. Each health district must send at least seven samples every 15 days for analysis; if dengue virus is detected, it will be isolated and identified among the four dengue serotypes to guide targeted interventions. Last year, samples from over 15,000 sites found dengue mosquitoes in more than 400 areas, informing preemptive control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州574カ所でデング熱媒介蚊が発生:保健局
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱・インフルエンザ増加で入院も増えているが、現時点では通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。
triage.notes: 季節性降雨に伴うデング熱・インフルエンザの増加。州保健局が監視・対策を強化中だが、例年と比較して大きく逸脱した規模ではない模様（前年は15,000カ所中400カ所以上で検出）。

article.articleHeadline: 扼住病毒入侵"命门"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Choking Off Viral Invasion at the Mingmen Gate
article.articleSummary: HBV (hepatitis B virus) entry into hepatocytes is mediated by the NTCP receptor, a gateway identified after 18 years of work by Li Wenhui and Su Jianhua’s team in Beijing. Using tree shrews as the infection model, they mapped hepatocyte gene expression to isolate NTCP as the viral entry portal for the PreS1 domain. Through extensive antibody engineering and screening, lead human monoclonal antibody 2H5-A14 showed strong neutralization and could recruit macrophages and natural killer cells to clear infected cells. The antibody drug Libevita (立贝韦塔) advanced from target discovery to clinical translation, and in October 2024 secured conditional approval in China for hepatitis D virus (HDV) therapy, based on a multinational trial enrolling over 100 patients in China, Pakistan, and Mongolia. The program also established a reusable platform for NTCP research, infection models, and antibody engineering, with next-gen formats including subcutaneous antibodies, oral NTCP inhibitors, and a new core molecule SCARF2.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス侵入の「命門」を扼する
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はB型・D型肝炎ウイルスの受容体研究と抗体医薬品開発に関する科学・医療ニュースであり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態やアウトブレイクに関する情報ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は新規抗体医薬品（Libevita）の開発経緯と臨床試験成功に関する科学報道であり、疾病アウトブレイクのシグナルではない。発生地域として挙げられた国々は臨床試験の実施国であり、感染症発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 被鱼刺扎伤别不当回事 感染创伤弧菌可能致命
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't underestimate a fishbone puncture wound; Vibrio vulnificus infection can be fatal.
article.articleSummary: Vibrio vulnificus infection from a fishbone puncture in Shenzhen, China, led to rapid, life-threatening illness. A 69-year-old man’s small hand wound after handling tilapia progressed within 12–72 hours to high fever, spreading redness, swelling, and painful blisters; he required intensive care at Shenzhen Third People’s Hospital. Laboratory testing confirmed Vibrio vulnificus, a halophilic marine bacterium living in warm seawater and salted water, commonly found in shellfish and shrimp. Transmission occurs via wound contamination from seawater or contaminated seafood, or by consuming raw or undercooked seafood (notably raw oysters). Wound infection can worsen quickly with necrosis; foodborne illness causes fever, chills, nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea, and may lead to necrotizing fasciitis or septicemia with high mortality. Prevention includes avoiding seafood handling with open wounds, wearing waterproof gloves, sanitizing tools, cooking seafood thoroughly, and seeking urgent care if symptoms worsen.

triage.headline_ja: 魚の骨の刺し傷を軽視するな 創傷弧菌感染は致命的となる可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: 単発の個人症例報告であり、人人感染や集団発生の証拠はなく、公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: Vibrio vulnificusは環境水中に常在する病原体で、ヒト-ヒト感染はしない個別曝露事例。深圳での単一症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の注意喚起記事としての性格が強い。
